name: Tallowpup
concept: A stumpy wax-coated pup whose stubby tail is a flickering tallow candle that warms everything it curls against.
visual: Chunky cream-and-butter-yellow puppy body, ink nose, a single pale candle-flame tail with a soft wax drip; big round eyes; reads as one warm blob at 32px.
hook: The single candle-tail is irresistibly cute — kids will want to protect the little flame.

name: Tallowcrest
concept: A mid-sized candle-hound with a crown of five dripping tallow flames that shift colour depending on its mood.
visual: Robust tawny dog silhouette, wax-drip markings down the haunches, a starburst of five pastel-hued candle-flames crowning the head; distinct and bold at 48px.
hook: The mood-colour flames make it feel alive — a warm ally that visibly cares.

name: Chandrek
concept: A great candlewood hound whose entire mane is a cathedral of living candles, radiating warm golden light that soothes nearby kin.
visual: Large, dignified canine silhouette; back and mane bristle with tall tapers in cream, gold, and amber; pooling light halos the outline; dramatic yet soft at 64px.
signature_idea: Warm Vigil — buffs allies' Special Defense for two turns
hook: An apex hound made of living light — the kind of kin you want walking beside you in the dark.

name: Wickmoth
concept: A small ember-winged moth that navigates by following warm light and scorches anything it bumps into by accident.
visual: Tiny round fuzzy moth body in ash-grey, wings tipped in orange-to-yellow ember gradients, two long antennae with spark-dot tips; reads as a fluttering silhouette at 32px.
hook: The classic 'dangerous but clumsy' charm — a burny little moth you can't help but root for.

name: Scorchwing
concept: A magnificent ember-moth with broad, vein-lit wings that trail blazing filaments and leave a shower of sparks with every wingbeat.
visual: Wide, spread-wing moth silhouette; upper wings are deep charcoal laced with bright ember veins, lower wings trail glowing filaments; menacing and beautiful at 64px.
signature_idea: Flare Scatter — hits all opponents with low-power fire sparks
hook: From clumsy little Wickmoth to this gorgeous blazing terror — one of the most satisfying glow-ups in Vesperholm.

name: Ignibble
concept: A chubby ember-sprite that looks like a floating coal with tiny limbs; constantly nibbles on flammable things and hiccups smoke.
visual: Near-spherical dark-grey body with orange cracks like cooling lava, stubby arms and legs, beady white eyes; very simple shape that reads perfectly at 32px.
hook: The hiccuping coal-sprite that accidentally sets things on fire — pure early-game comedy gold.

name: Cindrok
concept: A squat obsidian-plated bruiser whose body is a mass of cooling magma-rock ridged with glowing orange fissures; slow but unstoppable.
visual: Broad low-slung boulder-kin silhouette, black basalt plating with lava-orange glowing cracks along every joint, heavy limbs; reads as a tank at 64px.
signature_idea: Magma Crush — slow but devastatingly powerful physical Ember move
hook: A living volcano that waddles — the comedy of something so slow being so terrifying.

name: Embrix
concept: A quick little ember-lizard that skitters across warm stones, leaving tiny scorch marks with each foot that briefly spark and fade.
visual: Slim, quick-looking lizard in rust-orange with a glowing stripe down the spine, small bright eyes, long tail with an ember tip; lithe silhouette reads fast at 32px.
hook: Fast and feisty — the scrappy little lizard that always seems one step ahead.

name: Scaldrak
concept: A sleek, long-bodied fire-drake that races along the ground and leaves a searing trail wherever its belly grazes the earth.
visual: Elongated low-slung drake silhouette, deep ember-red scales with bright gold underbelly, swept-back horns, a whip-like tail; long horizontal read at 64px.
signature_idea: Searing Trail — sets the field terrain on fire, damaging switch-ins
hook: The satisfying payoff of that little scorch-lizard — now a ground-scorching drake.

name: Fluffern
concept: A fluffy round fire-sparrow that puffs up when alarmed and releases a burst of hot air and downy embers in all directions.
visual: Plump round bird, warm amber-orange fluff, tiny beak, stubby wings with flame-tips, huge bright eyes; a perfect round silhouette at 32px.
hook: Unbearably poofy and warm — it looks like a flying coal-furred pillow.

name: Cindervane
concept: A swift, sleek fire-bird that dives at speed and uses the friction of the air to fan its own plumage into a brilliant living corona.
visual: Streamlined bird silhouette, deep red-orange body, long swept tail-feathers with flame tips, talon-streaks glowing gold; fast and elegant at 64px.
signature_idea: Tailspin Blaze — speed stat boosts after using a fire move
hook: The transformation from poofy ball to this sleek racer is a true delight.

name: Ashlette
concept: A tiny ash-fairy that drifts on warm updrafts, trailing grey motes; when it sneezes, it blasts a puff of concentrated fire-dust.
visual: Near-translucent teardrop fairy body in pale smoke-grey with a tiny ember core, gossamer ash-wings, two stub arms; minimal but charming at 32px.
hook: The sneeze that accidentally launches a fireball — endearingly powerful.

name: Embrift
concept: A swirling ash-sprite that has grown a permanent vortex of superheated cinders around its body, moving like a living dust-devil.
visual: Hovering humanoid silhouette ringed by a spinning debris-halo of cinders, orange core glowing at the heart, long wispy arms; dynamic at 48px.
hook: A tiny fairy has become a swirling pillar of flame — awe-inducing mid-stage transformation.

name: Pyriven
concept: A towering cinder-wraith whose body is a column of black smoke wreathed in fierce orange-white flames, haunting the ruins of old hearths.
visual: Tall ghostly pillar silhouette: smoke-black upper body fading into blazing fire-orange lower half, spectral arms, hollow bright eyes; striking contrast at 64px.
signature_idea: Charcoal Hex — special Dark move that also applies a burn
hook: The ash-fairy grew into a ghost made of fire — spooky, beautiful, and unforgettable.

name: Blazethorn
concept: The final form of the starter Vulpyre: a proud, sleek fire-fox whose mane erupts into a blazing crown of tall flame-spines, channelling its hearth-bond into devastating focused special blasts.
visual: Upright fox silhouette, deep ember-red coat, cream underbelly, mane erupting upward in a spike-crown of orange-to-white flames; regal and fast at 64px.
signature_idea: Crown Blaze — channelled fire beam boosted by bond strength; Blazethorn exclusive
hook: The Vulpyre you picked as a tiny cub grew into this gorgeous, powerful guardian — the payoff of your whole journey together.

name: Glowder
concept: A squat cave-slug that secretes a thick luminescent slime insulating it from heat; it cheerfully eats warm coal and glows a faint amber.
visual: Wide low oval slug body in orange-brown, glossy slime sheen, two blunt eyestalks with tiny white pupils, short stubby tail; simple low silhouette at 32px.
hook: The brave little coal-eater that refuses to be moved — a tiny defensive powerhouse hiding in the mine.

name: Emburge
concept: A barrel-bodied magma-snail whose shell has hardened into a volcano-cone of solid obsidian, with a permanent lava-flow vent at the peak.
visual: Massive round body, jet-black volcanic shell with a glowing lava vent at the crown, short powerful limbs; slow-but-indestructible silhouette at 64px.
signature_idea: Obsidian Shell — reduces incoming physical damage significantly for one turn
hook: A slug became a living volcano — the most satisfying defensive transformation in the mine.

name: Sparrig
concept: A frantic little mine-rat whose static-charged fur crackles with tiny sparks whenever it gets excited — which is basically always.
visual: Wiry round-headed rodent, singed orange-brown fur that stands on end, bright static-spark wisps around the body, big ears; active and messy at 32px.
hook: An anxious little spark-rat that can't help but zap things — chaotic and loveable.

name: Voltfur
concept: A bristling fire-and-lightning beast whose pelt is permanently lit by plasma-channels, able to trigger burn and paralysis simultaneously.
visual: Robust hunched predator silhouette, ember-red coat streaked with bright blue-white lightning channels, mane of standing spark-tipped quills; electric-dangerous at 64px.
signature_idea: Plasma Coat — chance to burn and paralyse attacker on contact
hook: The chaotic spark-rat grew into the one kin that makes opponents afraid to touch it.

name: Scorchite
concept: A marble-sized wandering coal-sprite with a single bright eye; it rolls into warm crevices in Cinderhead Mine and hums contentedly.
visual: Near-perfect sphere, dull black coal texture with a single amber-glow eye, two tiny round feet; the simplest possible round silhouette at 32px.
hook: The smallest, round-est creature in the mine — impossibly cute in its simplicity.

name: Coalump
concept: The little coal-sprite has absorbed enough heat to grow limbs and a second eye; its body now cracks open in starbursts of orange light when it attacks.
visual: Lumpy rounded torso, short sturdy limbs, two glowing eyes, body covered in expanding crack-pattern glow lines; reads as power building at 48px.
hook: Watching those cracks spread as it gets stronger makes every battle feel like building toward an explosion.

name: Pyrolith
concept: A crystallised magma-titan whose body has solidified into angular obsidian with a blazing reactor core visible through the translucent chest-plate.
visual: Tall imposing angular silhouette, jet obsidian faceted body, a glowing diamond-orange core blazing through a transparent chest section, jutting shoulder-spurs; monolithic at 64px.
signature_idea: Core Breach — massive single-hit fire blast; user loses some HP as recoil
hook: A tiny coal rolling in the dark became this godlike obsidian titan — the mine's final secret.

name: Hearthkit
concept: A small round hearth-fox kitten that nests inside unused fireplaces and glows soft amber when it purrs; it smells permanently of woodsmoke and cinnamon.
visual: Round-bodied kitten, deep apricot coat with cream markings, curled ember-glow tail, closed-eyed happy expression; warm and cosy silhouette at 32px.
hook: The kitten that lives in the fireplace and purrs — every kid wants one as a bedroom companion.

name: Warmantis
concept: The hearth-kitten has grown into a luminous fire-cat that forms a bond so deep it can project its warmth as a visible golden aura shielding its trainer.
visual: Elegant long-bodied cat silhouette, warm gold-and-cream coat, a soft luminous aura halo, ember-tip tail; graceful and glowing at 64px.
signature_idea: Hearth-Oath — dramatically raises ally's Defense and Sp.Defense for 3 turns; usable once per battle
hook: The bond evolution payoff — it literally becomes an aura of love around you.

name: Clucker
concept: A strutting ember-chick with a bright red comb and scorching tiny talons; it challenges anything twice its size and somehow always survives.
visual: Plump round chick silhouette, orange feathers, oversized fiery red comb, tiny defiant wings, bold dark eyes; ridiculous confidence at 32px.
hook: The ridiculous bravado of a tiny chicken challenging the world — endearing and hilarious.

name: Infernock
concept: A blazing rooster whose tail-feathers are literal pillars of fire and whose battle-crow shakes dust from ceilings; genuinely terrifying in a fight.
visual: Tall proud rooster silhouette, deep crimson-and-gold feathers, a massive fan of burning tail-plumes, fierce eyes; dramatic and imposing at 64px.
signature_idea: War Crow — physical Ember move that lowers the opponent's Attack
hook: That gobby chick grew into this — a fire-tailed colossus that commands respect.

name: Smoldrop
concept: A sentient teardrop-shaped ember that rolls and bounces around hearths, carrying warmth to cold corners; fragile but fast.
visual: Smooth teardrop shape, warm orange with a bright white-hot core, tiny face near the rounded top, no limbs; pure shape at 32px.
hook: A tiny droplet of pure fire with a face — the sweetest possible thing.

name: Tindrix
concept: A spindly stick-insect made of living tinder and dry-wood whose whole body crackles when it rubs its forelegs together like a living matchstick.
visual: Thin angular stick-bug silhouette, bark-brown body with bright orange ember-glow at every joint, antennae tipped with sparks; distinctive angles at 32px.
hook: A walking match-stick that ignites itself — a genius little design that rewards a second look.

name: Blaztwig
concept: A tall, graceful fire-mantis sculpted from charred heartwood, whose folded arms snap open like igniting kindling when it attacks.
visual: Elongated bipedal silhouette, charcoal-black hardwood body, swept-back flame-spike head-crest, glowing orange joint-orbs, long praying arms; elegant and dangerous at 64px.
signature_idea: Kindling Strike — special fire move with bonus damage on first use each battle
hook: A twig became a charcoal deity — unexpected, beautiful, surprising.

name: Cinderveil
concept: A ghost-like ember-kin found in the burned-out lower galleries of Cinderhead Mine — a smear of dark smoke held together by a single stubborn coal.
visual: Tall wispy smoke-form silhouette, charcoal-dark body with orange coal burning at the chest-centre, tattered veil-like edges; ghostly and moody at 48px.
signature_idea: Smoke Screen — Dark-typed status move that lowers accuracy and applies confusion
hook: The haunted air of the mine made visible — the dread of dark corners hiding old fire.

name: Glowtoad
concept: A plump hot-spring toad that absorbs heat from warm mineral pools in the mine and radiates it back as a soothing amber glow from its warty skin.
visual: Squat toad silhouette, mustard-orange bumpy skin with glowing amber warts, wide flat mouth, stubby toes; reads as round and steady at 32px.
hook: The goofy friendly toad that happens to be an impenetrable warm wall.

name: Magmoad
concept: A massive mineral-crusted toad whose skin has hardened into crystallised magma-plate; it sits immovably in the mine's deepest hot springs and is nearly impossible to shift.
visual: Massive wide toad silhouette, black-and-orange crystalline plate-skin, lava-glow seams at the joints, deep patient eyes; supremely immovable at 64px.
signature_idea: Stone Soak — absorbs a super-effective physical hit, halving its damage
hook: The most serene and unstoppable kin in the mine — nothing moves this toad.

name: Ashwing
concept: A small ash-bird that inhabits the mine's ventilation shafts, riding the updrafts of hot exhaust and scattering fine cinders in its wake.
visual: Slim swallow-like bird, pale ash-grey body, ember-orange wing-tips, long forked tail with cinder motes trailing behind; reads as airborne and swift at 32px.
hook: A bird made of mine-exhaust — wild and surprising in the nicest way.

name: Pyrestrel
concept: A sweeping fire-hawk that rides superheated thermals out of the mine, its wing-trailing cinders forming a visible comet-arc across the sky.
visual: Wide-wingspan raptor silhouette, deep charcoal-and-orange feathers, dramatic swept-back crest-plume, trailing ember arc behind every wing-beat; majestic at 64px.
signature_idea: Cinder Dive — boosted speed-based fire attack after two turns of set-up
hook: The ash-bird became a comet — tracing that arc across the screen never gets old.

name: Embermite
concept: A tiny eight-legged ember-spider that weaves webs of hardened glassy char in warm corners and snares anything that blunders through.
visual: Small round body over eight delicate legs, amber-orange body with tiny coal-black markings, silken char-thread trailing behind; creepy-cute at 32px.
hook: Creepy spider plus warm fire equals unexpectedly adorable — a surprising keeper.

name: Charlock
concept: A large shadowy ember-spider that constructs vast web-traps of scorching char-silk in the dark; opponents who blunder in find themselves both burning and stuck.
visual: Large angular spider silhouette, black chitin with ember-orange leg-bands and glowing orange eye-cluster, trailing thick web-filaments; menacing at 64px.
signature_idea: Char Web — traps opponent for two turns; may inflict burn on entry
hook: The little creepy spider became a trap-master — the predator lying in the dark corners of the south.

name: Crumblix
concept: A craggy coal-mole that drills through the mine with superheated snout-plates, eating coal and iron ore; tiny but surprisingly hard-hitting.
visual: Stout rounded mole silhouette, coal-black fur, glowing orange snout-plate, oversized digging forelimbs; burly and cute at 32px.
hook: The scrappy little miner who headbutts through walls — small dog energy in a coal-digging body.

name: Bouldrel
concept: A hulking magma-mole encased in a fused suit of iron ore and molten rock, capable of boring through solid stone with a single headbutt.
visual: Wide boulder-armoured mole silhouette, slate-grey ore plating with lava-orange seams, massive rounded head, short powerful arms; an armoured ram at 64px.
signature_idea: Burrow Blast — builds power while underground for a devastating contact move
hook: The little coal-mole becomes an unstoppable living cannonball — utterly satisfying.

name: Lustorch
concept: A magnificent rare lantern-elk whose antlers are branching columns of pure white-hot fire, said to appear only on the night of a relit Ember constellation.
visual: Elegant stag silhouette, deep coal-black body, antlers erupting into brilliant white-fire branches, ember-glow hoofprints left at each step; stunning at 64px.
signature_idea: Luminary Charge — a sweeping physical-special hybrid Ember/Light attack; signature move
hook: An apex lantern-stag that only appears under the relighting sky — the south's hidden wonder, worth every chase.

name: Cindrake
concept: The apex beast of Cinderhead Mine — a colossal basalt-scaled worm-drake that carves new tunnels with its superheated body as it moves, leaving glowing bore-shafts in its wake.
visual: Long serpentine tunnel-beast silhouette, segmented jet-black basalt-scale plates, lava-orange between every segment, blunt wide drilling-head with four amber eyes; vast at 64px.
signature_idea: Tunnel Fury — bores underground and resurfaces to hit with an unblockable physical Ember/Stone strike
hook: The true master of the mine — the thing that made those deep tunnels, and you can add it to your team.

name: Embralion
concept: A legendary fire-mane predator of the southern warmlands — a great ember-lion whose mane is a permanent aurora of spiralling flame, appearing only as dusk deepens.
visual: Massive lion silhouette, deep amber-red coat, enormous swirling flame-mane with layered orange-to-yellow-to-white bands, heavy powerful paws; regal and immense at 64px.
signature_idea: Aurora Mane — raises all allies' Attack and sets a damaging fire field for three turns
hook: The lion of the eternal dusk — when it appears at sundown, everything falls quiet.

name: Cindle
concept: A small round ember-bear cub that curls into a warm ball when it sleeps and radiates steady heat all night, beloved by travellers sheltering from the cold.
visual: Compact round bear-cub silhouette, rich amber-brown fur, tiny round ears, warm glow emanating from the belly like a lantern; a perfectly cosy shape at 32px.
hook: The warmth-radiating sleeping ball of fluff you want camping beside — pure cosy comfort.

name: Brindlore
concept: A steady, barrel-chested ember-bear whose fur has darkened to brindled auburn and whose every exhale sends glowing motes drifting into the night air.
visual: Broad-shouldered bear silhouette, brindled auburn-and-black fur, warm amber underbelly glow, ember-mote breath cloud; powerful and gentle at 64px.
signature_idea: Ember Breath — AoE fire cone with guaranteed burn chance
hook: The safe, steady power of a campfire incarnate — you feel calmer just having it on your team.

name: Solderling
concept: A cheerful little solar-flame sprite that flits ahead of travellers on the Lanternway like a living lantern-guide, its warm glow lighting the road.
visual: Wispy small orb body, warm gold-and-cream colouring, a cheerful face, short trailing light-ribbon tail, nimble drifting posture; friendly and round at 32px.
hook: The little light-guide that runs ahead to show you the path — heart-warming and actually useful.

name: Glintara
concept: A graceful light-flame dancer who moves faster than the eye can follow, leaving a looping trail of golden light-ribbons that linger for a moment before fading.
visual: Slender ribbon-dancer silhouette, warm gold body, flowing light-ribbon trailing arms, starpoint face-markings, perpetually in mid-leap; elegant and airy at 64px.
signature_idea: Light Trail — sets a field effect that boosts allies' speed for three turns
hook: A living dance of warmth and light — watching it move is joyful all by itself.

name: Brinelet
concept: A tiny round tidepool creature that rolls with the surf, collecting trinkets in a dimpled shell-belly. Scouts ahead with quick darting bursts.
visual: Plump oval body, translucent blue-grey with a pale underbelly, two bright bead eyes, stubby flipper-feet, and a dimpled concave belly-shell that catches pebbles and seaweed bits. Readable at 16px.
hook: Endearingly pudgy and curious — kids love how it collects bits of the beach in its belly-dip.

name: Brineroll
concept: Brinelet has grown a proper ridged shell and longer fins, tumbling through shallows with surprising speed. It spins to deflect attacks.
visual: Rounder, smoother armadillo-ish shell with tidal spiral ridges in seafoam-blue and cream. Wide webbed paddle-feet, curious antenna-stalks with glowing tips, bright confident eyes.
signature_idea: Tidecurl — a rolling physical move that gains speed-boost on use
hook: The satisfying glow-up from its wobbly baby form — it's fast now and knows it.

name: Brinewrath
concept: The line's final form — a sleek armoured tidal-beast that rides currents at high speed, its shell now a hydrodynamic shield. Commands entire tidal zones.
visual: Streamlined low-slung body, swept-back shell ridges like breaking waves, twin luminous teal eye-stalks, long trailing fin-limbs. Seafoam-blue and deep indigo palette, white crest markings.
signature_idea: Rip Current — priority move that also sets a Hazard on the field
hook: From beach-trinket collector to tidal apex — the full transformation arc hits hard at its reveal.

name: Lumpin
concept: A limpet-kin whose flat shell glows with stored moonlight. It clings to coastal rocks and pulses a gentle beacon to guide lost kin home.
visual: Conical shell in deep blue-grey with a soft gold radiant glow from within; plump body underneath, two wide-set gentle eyes, four tiny suction-tipped feet. Bioluminescent ring pattern on shell rim.
signature_idea: Shell Glow — boosts own Special Defence and applies a mild dazzle to attacker
hook: A cosy little lighthouse-limpet — kids want one as a nightlight companion.

name: Lumplass
concept: Lumpin's shell has fused into a radiant broad disc; it now clings to sea-cliff faces and projects a beam of moonlit brine-light that disrupts approaching attackers.
visual: Wide flat disc-shell patterned with concentric gold-and-aqua rings, textured like hammered moonstone. The creature beneath is plump and soft-looking with a single large circular eye at the shell's centre aperture.
signature_idea: Moonglass Barrier — sets a Light-screen equivalent that also prevents stat-lowering moves from landing
hook: A gorgeous, bizarre disc-creature — its single-eye silhouette is instantly iconic.

name: Brinix
concept: The starter Tide kin — a stoic crested water-shelled kin that shields its allies with briny resilience. Already has art; this entry just anchors it in the line schema.
visual: Existing art (see assets/creatures/002_brinix/). Compact crested water-shelled body, seafoam palette, bold silhouette.
hook: The trusty starter — reliable, stoic, and grows into something formidable.

name: Brinarch
concept: Brinix's final kindled form. The brine-crest has broadened into a sweeping crown of sea-glass plating; its bulk and endurance are legendary on the southern coast. Becomes the region's apex defender.
visual: Tall, broad-shouldered, slate-blue shell plating crested with sea-glass spurs in translucent teal. Wide stance, deep chest, a calm but commanding gaze behind a brow-ridge. Dual water-crystal shoulder guards.
signature_idea: Brine Bulwark — sets a tide-flavoured reflect that scales with HP remaining
hook: The satisfying payoff of raising your starter — a true coastal fortress on the field.

name: Mooncatch
concept: A slender wading kin with a crescent-shaped beak that catches the moon's reflection in still harbour water. It uses moonlit currents to drag foes off-balance.
visual: Long-legged, heron-silhouette but smaller — pale silver-white with deep blue-grey wing-cloak, a crescent curved beak, and a single tufted moon-crest feather that glows faint silver. Still, watchful pose.
signature_idea: Moon Draw — inflicts confusion by reflecting the moon's pull; priority status move
hook: The elegant fisherman of Pearlmoor — quiet and mysterious, a fan favourite for its poised silhouette.

name: Moontrawl
concept: Mooncatch matured — now a full-sized sea-stalker whose beak-crescent spans the moonlit sky. It rides tidal swells and tangles opponents in current-woven nets.
visual: Large elegant wader, pure white with deep ocean-indigo markings, a dramatic swept crescent beak, broad flowing wings like a wave-mantle, tidal-spiral feather patterns. Commanding, almost supernatural grace.
signature_idea: Tide Tangle — inflicts Slow + Bound on target; Tide-type signature
hook: The majestic late-line reveal. Pearlmoor players brag about having one.

name: Glostern
concept: A small jellyfish-lantern drifting through Pearlmoor harbour. Its translucent bell glows with trapped moonlight, and it fires bioluminescent pulses at threats.
visual: Dome bell in soft aqua-blue with a warm gold luminescent core; four trailing tendril-ribbons with tiny pearl droplets at their tips, and a cluster of gentle light-spot eyes beneath the bell.
signature_idea: Pearl Pulse — special Light-attribute projectile that has a chance to blind
hook: A living lantern in the harbour — its gentle glow is the most iconic visual on the Pearlmoor loading screen.

name: Glostrael
concept: Glostern's kindled form — its bell has expanded enormously and its moon-glow fills the surrounding sea. A moving constellation-lantern.
visual: Vast translucent bell filled with golden light that fractures like stained glass, eight long trailing tentacles tipped with bright orbs like low-hanging stars. Deep navy outer bell, blazing gold interior.
signature_idea: Stellar Cascade — multi-hit Light/Tide combo that lowers target's Spd
hook: The biggest visual surprise on the southern coast — seeing one rise out of the harbour is awe-inspiring.

name: Pebrix
concept: A smooth coastal pebble-crab that wedges itself between rocks and refuses to budge. Its shell has the texture and colour of wave-worn stone.
visual: Oval, grey-blue body resembling a smooth beach pebble, stubby legs tucked underneath, two periscope eyestalks, tiny ridged claws. Almost invisible on a pebble beach.
hook: Kids hunt the beach for this one — it's basically camouflaged as nothing. Catching it feels like a discovery.

name: Cobblash
concept: Pebrix grown huge — now the size of a boulder, it sits in shallow water and lets waves wash over it. Its shell is virtually indestructible.
visual: Massive dome-shaped crab, shell textured like wave-smoothed granite with tidal barnacle-strip markings in cream and rust, heavy claw-pillars, deep-set luminous aqua eyes.
signature_idea: Granite Tide — Tide-type move that raises own Def on hit
hook: Boulders are catchable. Kids love the absurdity and the payoff.

name: Glintfin
concept: A small glinting schooling fish with a single prismatic scale that acts like a signal mirror. Groups of them communicate with flashes.
visual: Tiny silvery fish with oversized prism-scale fin fanning out like a tail-fan, blue-teal body, big friendly eye, subtle light-refracting markings.
hook: Cute little mirror-fish — the tutorial kin for Tide typing; appears in water as soon as the player gets Tidecall.

name: Shimmral
concept: The glintfin shoal has merged into a single larger fish with a spectacular prismatic fin-mantle. It blasts light-refractions as attack.
visual: Elegant mid-sized fish, iridescent blue-silver body, enormous fan-fin with rainbow diffraction pattern, graceful trailing fin-rays, bright intelligent eyes.
signature_idea: Prism Burst — high-power Light special move with a recoil-reduced spread effect
hook: The rainbow fin reveal mid-fight is a wow moment — fans debate the best name for the colour pattern.

name: Prismare
concept: The fully kindled form — a magnificent reef-fish whose entire body is a living prism. Light bends through it into weapons.
visual: Majestic, long-bodied fish with translucent crystalline fins that refract all light into dazzling arcs, pale blue-white body with thin crystalline armour plates, twin feeler-fins curled like antennae, piercing white eyes.
signature_idea: Wavelength — Tide/Light hybrid move that hits both types' super-effective targets
hook: The crystalline fish that turns any battlefield into a light show. Trainers use it for style points as much as power.

name: Saltwhip
concept: A fast-darting eel-kin that lashes out with its brine-slicked tail. It slips through rocks and ambushes prey from crevices.
visual: Sinuous, thin eel body in salt-blue and cream, vivid yellow stripe from snout to tail-tip, small front fins, whip-thin tail ending in a crest-spike, small triangular snout.
hook: Slippery speedster starter for Tide — its thin fast silhouette reads 'lightning-fast' even at rest.

name: Brinelash
concept: Saltwhip's grown into a powerful sea-eel, sinuous as a cresting wave. It breaches the surface and whips down with enough force to crack stone.
visual: Long powerful eel, deep ocean-blue upper body shading to silver below, a dramatic dorsal-fin crest like breaking surf, jagged tail-fin, fierce narrow eyes with yellow pupils.
signature_idea: Sea Lash — physical Tide move with high crit ratio
hook: The most physically powerful coastal kin — satisfying for players who want raw speed-and-strength.

name: Zapprey
concept: A spiny eel-kin whose dorsal fin crackles with static charged by swimming through salt-mineral currents. Shocks things it nudges.
visual: Stubby eel, amber-yellow with electric blue zigzag stripe down the side, three erect spiny fins crackling with tiny sparks, wide startled eyes, rounded snout.
hook: The goofy electric eel of the coast — it shocks itself sometimes. Kids find it hilarious.

name: Voltrun
concept: A thunderstorm eel that can discharge its full charge in one devastating burst. It swims faster than the eye can follow when fully charged.
visual: Sleek, muscular eel, deep charcoal-blue shading to amber-yellow along the underbelly, lightning-bolt dorsal spine array, crackling arc-markings on flanks, white-hot eyes.
signature_idea: Bolt Current — powerful Storm/Tide move that ignores resistances from grounded targets
hook: The electric eel's terrifying final form — it's the Dimglass Coast's danger-kin that older trainers warn about.

name: Coravel
concept: A small round reef creature covered in soft coral-nubs that absorb nutrients. It pivots between attack and support, sharing its stored nutrients with allies.
visual: Round-bodied small creature, soft rose-coral body studded with tiny rounded coral polyp bumps in cream and pink, wide curious eyes, four short paddle-hands, a short crown of taller coral spires.
hook: The cute pink-coral blob — it's huggable AND surprisingly versatile in battle.

name: Coravent
concept: Coravel's reef-colony has matured into a towering structure. It nurtures weaker kin in battle while still dealing significant damage.
visual: Upright, ornate creature whose body is a living reef column — cream and rose coral branches spreading from a central sturdy torso, with glowing polyp-clusters as hands and a staghorn crown. Warm dignified expression.
signature_idea: Reef Network — heals a small amount to all allied party members when it uses a move
hook: The team player of the Tide roster — the most reliable long-game partner for strategy-minded trainers.

name: Tidgull
concept: A scrappy seabird kin from the Gullcry Rock spur — it dives at incredible speed and rides updrafts with brash confidence.
visual: Compact gull-like bird, slate-blue wings with white flash markings, orange beak hooked at tip, bright yellow eyes ringed with dark storm-grey, webbed feet for water landings.
hook: Loud, brave, slightly chaotic — the perfect adventurous seabird companion for players who want speed.

name: Galecrest
concept: The storm-seabird apex — Tidgull kindled only by weathering a sea-gale. Galecrest commands the winds and dives with bone-cracking force.
visual: Large powerful seabird, deep charcoal-and-steel wings with electric teal edge-markings, swept-back crest plumes like lightning bolts, fierce amber eyes, a storm-cloud aura around the wingtips.
signature_idea: Gale Dive — Sky-targeting physical move with a Storm secondary effect that guarantees first strike in its speed tier
hook: The apex seabird of Gullcry Rock — the optional spur reward that makes coastal exploration worth it.

name: Sponglit
concept: A round sea-sponge kin that absorbs light and slow-releases it as radiant pulses. Passive and gentle, it sits on rocks and glows warmly.
visual: Perfect sphere, textured sponge-surface in warm sand-amber, dozens of tiny pore-apertures that each glow gold, two sleepy button-eyes, no visible limbs — it drifts.
hook: The perfect low-key companion — glowy, round, and peaceful. Irresistible to collectors.

name: Lumosponge
concept: The grown sponge-kin is enormous, filled with stored moonlight. In battle it erupts that stored radiance as high-powered blasts.
visual: Large organic sphere, textured like ancient coral, honeycomb-patterned pores that blaze with brilliant gold light. Two dignified knowing eyes, four stubby arm-ridges. Warm amber and bright white palette.
signature_idea: Radiance Surge — charges a turn then fires high-powered Light special that scales with Special Defence
hook: Squishy outside, blazing inside — the ultimate slow-burn tank.

name: Whelket
concept: A sea-snail kin with a spiral horn it uses to inject sleep-ink into foes. It moves patiently and methodically.
visual: Compact snail, pale lavender shell with spiral blue-grey stripes, a long curved horn on the front, soft body in cream-white, two droopy eye-stalks that hang sleepily.
hook: The most underrated early Tide kin — its sleep ability is a trainer's secret weapon.

name: Whelkspire
concept: The mature whelk-kin towers behind a tall spiralling shell-spire and injects potent venoms. Its patience is absolute.
visual: Tall impressive snail with a dramatic multi-spired shell in deep indigo and silver-grey, a broad ink-horn, muscular suckered foot, glowing purple-tipped mantle edges.
signature_idea: Ink Spiral — Tide status move that inflicts both Sleep and Poison with reduced durations
hook: Status players adore it — the two-condition specialist that makes opponents rage.

name: Sternox
concept: A stocky, bull-headed cephalopod kin that charges foes with its hard beak-ram. Aggressive but loyal.
visual: Squat cephalopod body, deep teal-grey, broad flat head with a reinforced beak, four thick tentacle-arms, glowing amber pupils set in wide white eyes. Chunky, aggressive silhouette.
hook: The Tide bruiser — players who want raw physical punch on the coast choose this one.

name: Sternarch
concept: A massive deep-water cephalopod that can crack ship hulls with its ram-head. It rarely surfaces but is feared across the south coast.
visual: Large upright cephalopod, dark midnight-blue with electric teal tentacle-rings, enormous armoured beak-skull, six thick tentacle-arms each with a gripping barb-row, massive barrel chest.
signature_idea: Depth Ram — physical Tide move that ignores half of the target's Defence
hook: The terrifying sea-giant hiding below the tutorial waters. Every coastal trainer wants one.

name: Tidmote
concept: A tiny darting water-sprite that skims the sea surface, trailing a thread of moonlit water behind it. So fast it appears to teleport between waves.
visual: Tiny sprite, blue-white water droplet shape with trailing wisps, two pinpoint bright eyes, a single glowing ribbon-tail. Appears as a moving sparkle on water surfaces.
hook: The impossible-to-catch tiny speedster — Glintfin's spiritual counterpart that players spend hours trying to lamp.

name: Tidmaren
concept: The water-sprite is now a swift silver shape that dances between moonbeams, spreading brief distraction-glimmers to cover allies.
visual: Slim, elegant aquatic sprite — silver with pale moonlight-blue highlights, long streaming water-veil wings, a crescent-shaped luminous head-marking, twin ribbon tails.
signature_idea: Moonveil — applies an Evasion buff and a Light-type reflect-burst to adjacent ally
hook: The support speedster that doubles as a gorgeous visual — its moonveil makes other kin look good.

name: Tidwraith
concept: The fully kindled water-light sprite — now a ghostly shining figure of pure tide-light that moves faster than the eye can track.
visual: Tall, translucent humanoid sprite of flowing water and moonlight — silver-white with luminous aqua veins, streaming ribbon-limbs, a face of pure calm radiance, and a cascading tail of moon-foam.
signature_idea: Phantom Current — Tide/Light priority move; phases through Shields and barriers
hook: The transcendent final form of the tiniest starter — trainers who raise a Tidmote are rewarded with the coast's most ethereal kin.

name: Noctidal
concept: A large, solitary moon-otter that surfaces only at high tide under a full moon. It absorbs lunar energy through the water and re-releases it as rolling psychic tides.
visual: Sleek, otter-shaped, deep midnight-blue fur with a white underbelly, crescent moon-shaped marking on the brow, long tapered tail that fans into a moon-sliver shape, luminous silver eyes.
signature_idea: Tidal Omen — Lunar/Tide move that applies an escalating Curse-like status based on the moon phase (number of turns since battle started)
hook: The solitary moon-otter you only see at very specific conditions — the most hunted single-stage kin on the south coast.

name: Pearlund
concept: A small oyster-kin that snaps shut around attackers. It generates a pearl inside itself when injured, which it uses as an emergency restorative.
visual: Rounded bivalve-body in salt-grey with cream interior lining visible at the shell lips, two soft stubby eyestalks, a hint of glowing pearl visible at the shell's edge.
hook: A tiny stubborn defender — the first kin a new player learns to respect.

name: Pearlwarden
concept: A mighty clam-kin that contains a pearl the size of a fist, radiating cold defensive energy. It can slam foes with its reinforced shell-halves.
visual: Massive bivalve upright on two thick shell-feet, ridged grey-white shell with iridescent pearl-sheen, a visible glowing pearl at chest-centre like a breastplate gem, hard eyes flanking it.
signature_idea: Pearl Shield — single-use super-hard Protect that also reflects physical moves at half power
hook: The unmovable clam fortress — the wall-type every team eventually needs.

name: Starkelp
concept: A sentient kelp-strand that drifts through the water column, wrapping around and stunning opponents. Its tips glow with cold star-light refracted from the surface.
visual: Long sinuous kelp strand with rubbery olive-blue fronds, glowing aqua tips, a small bright node-face at the base-cluster, trailing stars of bioluminescence along its length.
hook: A living hazard that wraps around opponents — players who understand its bind-moves tear through battles with it.

name: Starkelpis
concept: The star-kelp has formed a vast tangled colony that coordinates as one mind. It projects luminous nets of kelp-light that snare entire parties.
visual: Enormous tangled mass of luminous kelp in deep ocean-blue and green-gold, central cluster forming a vaguely humanoid torso with trailing frond-arms, a corona of glowing bulb-tips.
signature_idea: Kelp Constellation — sets a field hazard that damages and slows all non-Tide kin entering
hook: The Sunken Solarium's guardian — a terrifying tangled mass that rewards patience to navigate.

name: Abyssling
concept: A deep-sea kin from the flooded Sunken Solarium — it has adapted to immense pressure and fires pressurised water blasts.
visual: Lean, elongated body adapted for deep water — jet-black with bioluminescent blue-white patches along the flanks, wide transparent eyes to gather deep-sea light, feathery gill-plumes.
hook: The deep-sea discovery of the Solarium flood-dungeon — an exciting find in a late-game optional area.

name: Abyssworn
concept: The deep-sea apex — Abyssling fully adapted to the crushing pressure of the Solarium's flooded depths. It channels that pressure into apocalyptic blasts.
visual: Massive, menacing deep-sea predator — pitch-black body with veins of electric blue pressure-light, enormous pale eyes, a long lower jaw lined with pressure-fang ridges, four deep-keel fins.
signature_idea: Pressure Cannon — high-power Tide move that gains power based on how many turns both kin have been in battle
hook: The apex of the deep — optional, terrifying, worthy of legend. Trainers who surface with one have earned major respect.

name: Frothpup
concept: A small otter pup that lives in cold froth-surf where sea meets ice-runoff. Its fur is perpetually foam-white and its breath mists in the cold.
visual: Compact fluffy otter pup, stark white fur with pale icy-blue markings, round black nose, big trusting eyes, chunky little paws with light frost-crystals at the tips.
hook: Impossibly fluffy and cold-nosed — the coastal cuddle buddy that kids want immediately.

name: Floekin
concept: The cold-surf otter grown into a confident, frost-riding sea-swimmer. It summons ice-floes as both platform and weapon.
visual: Elegant mature otter, deep blue-white, a thick frost-crystal collar around the neck, long tapered body, ice-spike tail-fin, cool intelligent eyes rimmed with ice-blue.
signature_idea: Floe Launch — creates a persistent ice-field terrain; Tide/Frost combo move
hook: The cool-tempered final form of an adorable pup — the awe-curve in a single kindling.

name: Duskraft
concept: A stingray-kin that glides through Dimglass Coast shallows, collecting the dusk-light on its wide flat body and discharging it as pulses.
visual: Flat diamond-shaped ray body, deep twilight-blue upper surface, cream underside with faint tidal banding, gentle curved wingtip fins, twin eye-nubs, long tapering tail-whip.
hook: A graceful glider that haunts the beautiful dusk-light shallows — the most photogenic early encounter.

name: Duskreign
concept: A vast stingray-kin that dominates the open sea. Its body gathers the eternal dusk-light of Vesperholm's sky and releases it in sweeping wave-blasts.
visual: Enormous manta-like ray, deep midnight-blue upper with dusk-gold wing-tip filaments and a constellation-spotted pattern across its back, long elegant tail with a crescent tip-spine.
signature_idea: Dusk Mantle — Tide special wave that covers the entire field with dusk-light, boosting Tide and Light kin's Special Attack
hook: The sea-sky titan — its constellation pattern back is the most beautiful design in the Tide set.

name: Tideveil
concept: The Tide Constellation Warden — a vast, semi-transparent sea-spirit that dwells in the Tideglass Cavern landmark. When Reyl relights the Tide constellation, Tideveil surfaces to confirm the pact. It is the living embodiment of the moonlit sea.
visual: Enormous translucent whale-like form, body almost entirely composed of moon-on-water refraction — shifting aqua, silver, and pale gold layers visible within. No hard edges, no single colour — a living sea-mirror. Two vast luminous crescent eyes and trailing aurora-thread fins.
signature_idea: Tidal Crown — once per battle, raises all Tide-type kin's stats by one stage; cancels the opponent's weather/terrain effects
hook: The constellation kin of the sea — seeing it surface in the Cavern is the south coast's defining awe moment.

name: Leafkin
concept: A pudgy seedling with a broad leaf-cap helmet and thick stumpy limbs. Friendly and determined, it headbutts obstacles twice its size without hesitation.
visual: Round jade-green body, wide flat leaf as a hat, bark-brown stubby legs, single bold white eye-gleam on the leaf; reads as a tiny knight in plant armour.
hook: starter candidate — the 'tough little guy' every kid wants: tiny, fearless, charges into everything.

name: Boulderbloom
concept: A hulking plant-beast whose body has hardened into mossy stone over years of headbutting. Flowers burst from cracks in its rocky hide after each battle.
visual: Broad stone torso laced with glowing green moss-veins, thick slab limbs, large cracked-granite fists with flowers blooming from the knuckles; imposing but gentle eyes.
signature_idea: Stoneburst Bloom — physical move that scatters rock-and-petal shards, hits Stone/Verdant damage
hook: starter candidate — grows from adorable tank-bean into a walking stone fortress that still sprouts flowers; the payoff silhouette is unforgettable.

name: Glowsip
concept: A small nectar-moth larva that drinks bioluminescent glowmoss dew, storing liquid light in a translucent belly-sac. Its antennae drip soft cyan glow.
visual: Pale cream grub-body, faintly luminous belly like a nightlight, two feathery cyan antennae, soft compound eyes; round and huggable.
hook: starter candidate — glowing larva that looks like a living lantern; perfect for the lamplight aesthetic.

name: Lumournis
concept: A grand glowing moth whose wings are broad leaf-panels veined with bioluminescent channels. It radiates a healing aura that calms wild kin and soothes blight.
visual: Large moth form; four broad wings each shaped like a glowing leaf, veined in cyan and gold; soft downy body, feathered antennae, six slender legs; the whole silhouette looks like a living stained-glass window.
signature_idea: Dawnveil — special move that wraps an ally in luminous leaf-light, raising their special defence
hook: starter candidate — gorgeous moth finale that doubles as a mobile lantern; special tank role gives it defensive staying power, feels like a protector.

name: Budspring
concept: A sprightly grass-rabbit whose ears are furled flower-buds. Quick and curious, it scatters seeds wherever it runs.
visual: Slim sage-green rabbit, long curled bud-ears, white belly, bright quick eyes; stance is always mid-bound.
hook: starter candidate — speedy little flower-bunny that exudes pure cosy energy; the 'fast friend' pick.

name: Bloomvault
concept: A graceful deer-like creature with a full crown of blooming flowers where antlers would be. Its long legs carry it silently across forest floors; it acts as a woodland guardian.
visual: Tall slender deer, mossy flanks, great flower-crown of many colours, dainty hooves that leave glowing petal prints; elegant and quietly awe-inspiring.
signature_idea: Petal Pivot — status move that swaps the user's stat boosts to an ally
hook: starter candidate — transforms from a bounding bunny into a serene forest guardian; balanced role suits players who want flexibility.

name: Sporeling
concept: A tiny mushroom-cap sprite native to Lowleaf Hollow. Its cap glows faintly and pulses when excited. It releases a gentle sleepy spore mist when threatened.
visual: Round mushroom-cap head (pale lavender with white spots), two stubby legs, tiny arms, big innocent eyes; fits in a cupped hand.
hook: Canon atlas kin — the iconic Lowleaf mushroom sprite every new player meets. Adorable first-catch energy.

name: Sporemid
concept: A taller, more confident mushroom-kin with a fully developed cap and a ring of satellite cap-growths around its torso. It exhales layered spore clouds with varied effects.
visual: Human-height mushroom form, broader cap with bioluminescent gill-lines underneath, satellite caps on its shoulders, dusty mauve-green coloured; stance is wide and assured.
hook: The bridge form — visibly more capable than Sporeling but with that same odd-cute mushroom energy.

name: Mycelarch
concept: The ancient lord of the Spore Grotto, a towering fungal entity whose underground mycelium network spans the entire Hollow. Its spores can read the emotional state of any creature nearby.
visual: Massive pillar-like mushroom body with many layered caps in deep indigo and midnight-green; trailing root-tendrils like a cloak; eyes gleam with dim amber light in shadow.
signature_idea: Mycelweb — status move that links all wild kin in the area to the user, mirroring status conditions
hook: The awe pay-off at the end of the Sporeling line — gentle sprout becomes an ancient, eerie fungal elder that secretly controls the whole forest floor.

name: Fennlight
concept: A lithe glowing fern-serpent native to Lowleaf Hollow's bioluminescent undergrowth. Its body traces the pattern of fern fronds, and it darts through the dark emitting soft cyan pulses.
visual: Slender vine-serpent body, fern-leaf pattern along its sides that glows cyan, bright curious eyes, small frond-crown on its head; sinuous and quick.
hook: Canon atlas kin — the glowing fern-serpent, fast and magical. Hits Verdant/Light coverage and doubles as a moving lantern.

name: Fernlance
concept: A fully adult fern-serpent, now as long as a felled tree, wreathed in blazing bioluminescent fronds. It can launch focused beams of purified green-gold light. Revered by Lowleaf villagers as a forest guardian.
visual: Long undulating serpent, densely fringed with fern-fronds that blaze gold and cyan along their edges; head-crown has expanded into a full luminous halo; tail tapers to a glowing spike.
signature_idea: Frondbeam — special move, channels gathered forest-light into a single radiant strike
hook: The Lowleaf Hollow signature rare — seeing a Fernlance flowing through glowing ferns is the image on the east region's poster.

name: Mossmole
concept: A glow-snouted digging mole native to Lowleaf Hollow. Its velvety coat is woven through with living moss, and its luminous snout helps it navigate underground passages.
visual: Stout velvet mole, moss-green coat with tiny leaves growing from its back, oversized digging claws, a bright amber-glowing nose, tiny eyes.
hook: Canon atlas kin — the cosy underground digger of Lowleaf Hollow; the 'reliable friend' of the east team.

name: Mossthorn
concept: The adult form of Mossmole, now large enough to reshape the earth. Its body is encased in a shell of compressed root and stone. Ancient specimens become small hills in the forest.
visual: Broad-bodied beast, stone-and-root carapace on its back like a natural landform, massive stone-capped claws, glowing amber nose remains visible; low and heavy silhouette.
signature_idea: Rootquake — physical move that shakes the ground, hitting both Stone and Verdant types
hook: The Hollow's earthmoving tank — gentle giant that can literally make hills; defensive identity that patch-covers Verdant's fragility.

name: Dewling
concept: A droplet-shaped seedling that lives in pools of forest dew. It is translucent, with a single seed-core visible inside its water-plant body.
visual: Teardrop body of pale green water-gel, a tiny brown seed core at its centre, thin tendrils as limbs, enormous shiny eyes; ethereally small.
hook: Impossibly tiny and translucent — a glowing dewdrop with eyes. Players love hatching something this small.

name: Poolfrond
concept: A lily-pad kin that glides on still forest pools. Its broad flat body floats on the surface while long submerged fronds trail below, sensing disturbances.
visual: Flat circular green body like a great lily-pad, smooth emerald top, pale root-fronds hanging down, periscope eyes on short stalks, small trailing flowers at the rim.
hook: Satisfying mid-form — clearly more capable than a dewdrop yet still serene and a little absurd; slides elegantly on water.

name: Tidalarch
concept: A great water-plant entity that spans a pool entirely, raising arching vine-bridges of woven kelp. Rumoured to be a single kin or many acting as one.
visual: Long arching serpentine plant form, dark teal body, many tributary fronds like trailing ribbons, lotus blossom crown of bioluminescent petals; fluid and enormous.
signature_idea: Surge Canopy — special move raising a curtain of pressurised water-and-vine that damages on entry
hook: The spectacular pool finale — starts as something you could hold in one hand and becomes something you walk under.

name: Glintgrub
concept: A tiny glow-beetle larva that clings to the undersides of glowmoss leaves. Its body stores concentrated light and it discharges it in startling bright flashes.
visual: Tiny amber-carapace larva, six short hooked legs, a translucent abdomen full of glowing liquid-light, big startled round eyes.
hook: A creature that is genuinely insect-small — one of the smallest things in the dex; holding a tiny glowing larva is endearing.

name: Glintchrys
concept: The chrysalis phase of the glowbeetle line, but awake and mobile. Its jade-and-amber shell is partially sealed yet it still fights, firing light-lances from gaps in the casing.
visual: Oval jewel-green chrysalis with cracks of blazing amber-gold light, four narrow limbs visible at the base, single luminous slit-eye on the front.
hook: A chrysalis that fights — unsettling and fascinating in equal measure; the design provokes the question 'what comes out?'

name: Solascaith
concept: A magnificent glow-beetle with wing-cases of polished leaf-gold that act as solar collectors, amplifying bioluminescent energy into blinding short-range bursts.
visual: Sleek beetle body, wing-cases of deep forest-green edged with gold filigree, four prominent legs, two feathered antennae trailing light, abdomen lit like a captured star.
signature_idea: Luminance Burst — special Glass Cannon move: massive light damage, user spends 1/4 max HP
hook: The 'wait, that beautiful beetle is glass cannon meta?' surprise — elegant and fragile and dangerous.

name: Vinecoil
concept: A vine-sprout serpent that coils around branches to sleep. It springs open suddenly when threatened, using momentum as a weapon.
visual: Tightly coiled slim green vine-snake, thorny nubs along its length, leaf-tip tail, alert beady eyes; always looks like a compressed spring.
hook: A tiny coiled vine that literally springs at enemies — the visual gag of a living slingshot.

name: Thornlash
concept: A fast vine-serpent that hunts by lashing with thorned whip-strikes. It weaves between trees faster than the eye can follow.
visual: Long whip-thin green serpent, dense thornline ridges along its back, a barbed tail tip, narrow bright eyes; body curved in a mid-strike arc.
hook: Satisfying mid-form; the spring-loaded snake grows into a genuine physical threat.

name: Overgrowl
concept: A massive vine-dragon whose body has consumed an entire tree. It wears the hollow trunk as armour while trailing roots tear up the ground as it moves.
visual: Enormous serpentine body wearing a hollow log as thorax armour, mossy back, thorned head-crest of interlocked roots, glowing sap dripping from thorn-tips.
signature_idea: Forest Rend — physical move that tears up the terrain, lowers speed of all enemies
hook: The forest's apex predator — a vine that ate a tree and kept going. Awe guaranteed.

name: Pitchermaw
concept: A pitcher-plant lurker that mimics a decorative flower pot. It lures insects and small kin close with sweet nectar scent then traps them in its tubular body, digesting slowly.
visual: Squat tubular plant, deep purple-magenta pitcher with translucent walls showing dissolved 'material' inside, frilly lip, long sticky tongue-tendril, false eyes painted on its outer leaves to scare birds.
signature_idea: Sweet Ruse — status move that switches the target into the user's place, forcing them to face the next attack
hook: The forest creep — unsettling enough to be memorable, cartoony enough to be charming; it has painted fake eyes.

name: Barkhelm
concept: A sturdy tortoise-like creature whose shell is made of compressed bark and stone. It sleeps for weeks, growing new bark-rings like a tree.
visual: Tiny squat form, rounded bark-ring shell like a tree cross-section, four stubby rock-grey legs, a small snout peering out; looks like a living tree stump.
hook: A living tree-stump that turns out to be a baby — the double-take moment when it opens its eyes.

name: Stonebark
concept: A medium bark-golem that moves with deliberate slowness. Its bark-ring shell has mineralised completely, giving it near-impenetrable defences.
visual: Stocky upright tortoise-golem, concentric mineral-bark rings clearly visible on shell, mossy patches on flat back, two large stone-knuckled fists, calm half-lidded eyes.
hook: The middle of a great defensive line — growing visibly stronger while staying unhurried and serene.

name: Rootwarden
concept: An ancient bark-golem so old that saplings have begun growing from its back. It stands immobile as a boulder for centuries and only moves when the forest is threatened.
visual: Massive standing golem of layered stone-bark, a living forest growing from its shoulders (small ferns, mosses, a small sapling), deep carved-wood face half-hidden by roots, feet rooted into the ground.
signature_idea: Ancient Stand — ability: reduces all incoming damage by 20% while the user has not moved that turn
hook: A walking old-growth forest — the awe moment of realising the clearing you just walked through was a sleeping kin.

name: Blossomfae
concept: A flower-fae sprite that rides air currents between blossoms. Its wings are formed from living petals that change colour with its mood.
visual: Tiny winged humanoid form, four large petal-wings (each a different pastel colour), crown of small flowers, trails a mist of luminous pollen.
hook: A living flower fairy — magical and small; kids will adore hunting for something this delicate.

name: Verdae
concept: The adult flower-fae form, now tall enough to be mistaken for a person at a distance. Its petal-wings have grown large and radiant; it is said to tend the oldest glowmoss groves at night.
visual: Slender fae figure, elegant large petal-wings in deep rose-gold and cool blue gradients, trailing ribbons of luminous pollen, serene expression; the forest's living protector.
signature_idea: Pollen Drift — status move that spreads a healing spore field over the battlefield each turn
hook: The forest's spirit made visible — graceful and otherworldly, but with the same petal-wings it had as a tiny sprite.

name: Cupplemoss
concept: A bear-shaped moss-beast that keeps a perpetual smile. Its body is densely packed living moss that absorbs impacts; it traps water in cup-shaped mossy hands.
visual: Round ursine shape, deep-green moss body, no hard edges, acorn-cap ears, simple smile-crease face, cupped moss-hands holding tiny pools of water.
hook: Pure soft wholesomeness — a bear made of moss that cups water in its hands; the forest's comfort animal.

name: Verdulk
concept: A hulking moss-bear patriarch that has been growing for decades. Its pelt holds an entire micro-ecosystem; small glowing mushrooms ring its head like a crown.
visual: Very large upright bear-shape, damp forest-green moss over every surface, mushroom-crown around the head glowing faintly, kind heavy-lidded eyes; slow, warm, immovable.
signature_idea: Moss Mantle — passive ability: physical moves deal 15% reduced damage; status conditions on the user heal at end of each turn
hook: The forest's immovable elder — gentle and enormous, mushroom-crowned; the moss bear you'd trust with your life.

name: Saplance
concept: A sapling-deer fawn whose growing antlers are live branch-nubs. It charges recklessly, more enthusiastic than skilled.
visual: Spindly fawn, leaf-green hide, two fresh branch-nub antlers with tiny leaves, oversized knobby knees, bright eager eyes.
hook: Classic cute fawn energy but with leaf-antlers — the universally beloved spotted-deer charm in plant form.

name: Grovebrand
concept: A powerful forest stag whose antlers have grown into full branching oaks bearing leaves and small birds' nests. Its hooves crack stone as it charges.
visual: Muscular stag, dark moss-green hide, enormous crown of branching oak-antlers with full leaf coverage, birds nesting in the boughs, deep burning amber eyes.
signature_idea: Branch Charge — physical move that deals damage and scatters the opponent's stat boosts
hook: A stag with a living forest for antlers — big, noble, wild; the east region's iconic physical powerhouse.

name: Grottobug
concept: A rare armoured beetle from the depths of Spore Grotto. Its shell is layered with petrified fungal growth and cave crystal; it is near-impossible to dislodge once it braces.
visual: Broad beetle, carapace of layered stone-coloured fungal plates with faint crystal veins, heavy mandibles, six stone-grey legs ending in gripping hooks, dim amber eye-gleam.
signature_idea: Grotto Lock — status move that roots the user but halves all incoming damage and poisons the attacker
hook: Canon Spore Grotto kin — the rare armoured bug every collector hunts in the grotto; its unique defensive gimmick makes it mechanically interesting.

name: Patchwork
concept: A quilted-leaf construct animated by accumulated glowmoss. It appears to be made of stitched leaf-patches in different shades, each patch contributing a different glowing pattern.
visual: Humanoid stuffed-doll silhouette, body made of obvious leaf-patches in greens, golds, and russets, each patch glowing slightly differently, button eyes of gold and amber, thread-seam 'stitching' visible.
hook: A living patchwork doll made of leaves — instantly collectible for its unique look; the 'no, really, what is it?' kin.

name: Mireveil
concept: A shadow-fern that grows only in the darkest groves of Lowleaf Hollow, far from any glowmoss. Its fronds absorb light; standing near one makes the air noticeably cooler and darker.
visual: Asymmetric fern-form, very dark blue-green fronds with black undersides, no visible light emission, half-transparent to show the dark 'void' inside its leaves; trailing shadow-tendrils.
hook: The dark counterpart to all the glowing kin — a plant that eats light instead of making it; unsettling and collectible.

name: Umbravine
concept: The adult shadow-vine, now a canopy-covering mass of light-drinking fronds. Areas it spreads over lose their bioluminescence. Reviled by the Hollow's guardians and coveted by the Hollowing.
visual: Sprawling canopy-vine form, enormous arching dark-blue fronds, a central mass hiding within the foliage like a face barely visible, threads of absolute blackness where light has been fully consumed.
signature_idea: Lightdrain — status move that removes STAB benefits from Light-typed opponents for three turns
hook: The Hollowing's symbol in plant form — a living embodiment of what the villains want; dark and morally loaded, the collected kin that raises narrative eyebrows.

name: Tendril
concept: A tiny vine-salamander that skitters along the forest floor. It uses its four vine-limbs like grappling hooks, swinging more than running.
visual: Slim lizard body, verdant-green, four long whip-vine limbs that extend far beyond the body to anchor on trees, large agile eyes, leaf-tip tail.
hook: A lizard-vine that swings on its own limbs — amusing motion, easy to love, quick to catch.

name: Grapplevine
concept: A full-grown vine-salamander that uses the canopy as a highway. Its vine-limbs can span 12 metres and it travels at alarming speed by looping and releasing.
visual: Lithe, athletic lizard form, vivid emerald, extremely long trailing vine-limbs coiled like ropes, leaf-tufted tail acting as a rudder, sharp watchful eyes.
signature_idea: Canopy Rush — Speedster move that doubles the user's speed for two turns but leaves it tangled (speed drop) after
hook: The canopy acrobat — the kin that makes players wish they could swing through trees too; pure kinetic joy.

name: Sunsprout
concept: A sunflower-bulb kin that stores daylight in its swollen yellow head. Found in the Sunken Solarium where shafts of drowned sunlight still reach the floor.
visual: Plump bulb body, bright yellow sunflower crown (petals folded into a dome), small round body, stubby legs, radiant warm glow from the petals.
hook: Canon Sunken Solarium kin — the first Verdant/Solar the player can find; warm and cheerful, an antidote to the melancholy ruins.

name: Solanthus
concept: A towering sunvine colossus whose crown has blossomed into a great radiant disc. It can emit focused solar flares that can be seen across the Solarium's flooded halls.
visual: Tall elegant vine-being, spiralling sun-vine torso, enormous solar-disc flower crown blazing with multiple layers of yellow-gold petals, two long tendril arms, roots trailing like a train.
signature_idea: Solar Bloom — special move that charges one turn in sunlight then fires a huge burst of pure Solar-Verdant energy
hook: The Sunken Solarium's shining guardian — a flower that remembered the sun even when the water swallowed it.

name: Bloomshard
concept: A frost-crystal flower found on the edges of the Pale Vault Glacier where ice meets the final fern-line. Its petals are cold transparent crystal that refract pale aurora light.
visual: Flower form with six large crystal-clear petals edged in deep forest-green, a green gem-faceted core, two leaf-arms, dainty ice-root feet.
hook: The meeting point of two biomes in one kin — the last flower before the glacier; hauntingly beautiful.

name: Spindrift
concept: A wind-seed sprite born when a tree-seed is caught in a perpetual micro-storm. It crackles with plant-static and drifts on self-generated gusts.
visual: Tiny dandelion-seed form but armoured — small seed core with many crackling electric-green filaments instead of fluff, two sparky antennae, floats slightly above ground.
hook: A dandelion seed that's a storm — impossibly light and crackly; one of the game's most original silhouettes.

name: Galebloom
concept: The adult storm-blossom, a whirling flower-tornado entity that travels at hurricane speed. It scatters thunder-pollen that strikes root wherever it lands.
visual: Spinning flower form, petals swept back like a rotor in perpetual rotation, crackles of emerald-tinted lightning between petal-tips, central eye-like blossom calm amid the storm.
signature_idea: Thunder Pollen — special move that scatters paralysis-inducing pollen across the field
hook: A flower cyclone — the absurd beauty of a botanical object moving at storm speed; thrilling to encounter.

name: Hollowcap
concept: A mushroom-cap sprite that grows only in the drained parts of Lowleaf Hollow where the Hollowing has passed. Its cap is a deep inky-black rather than luminous, and it feeds on residual null-energy.
visual: Small mushroom sprite form, matte-black cap with a faint dark iridescence, pale wiry limbs, hollow socket eyes that show a dark void rather than pupils.
hook: The dark mirror of Sporeling — same shape but born in drained darkness; an unsettling collectible that tells the story of Hollow blight through its existence.

name: Nullshroom
concept: The fully grown null-mushroom, now a walking void-bloom whose cap radiates absolute darkness. Used by the Hollowing as a living null-lantern; it drains the glow from nearby kin.
visual: Tall twisted mushroom-form, cap of deep sable-black with thin dark-matter wisps trailing from it like inverted smoke, grey-bone body, eyes of cold dead-white; the shadows around it are always deeper.
signature_idea: Null Bloom — special move that deals Dark damage and removes all Light-type buffs from the target
hook: The Hollowing's kin — dark, morally complex, mechanically dangerous to Light teams; the rare that requires ethical consideration.

name: Glowloft
concept: A moss-bear cousin native to the upper canopy, where glowmoss grows thickest. Its dense moss-coat acts as a natural light-diffuser, scattering soft ambient glow through the forest.
visual: Wide round bear silhouette, vivid green moss-coat interspersed with tiny glowing fronds, wide placid face, two small cup-ears, heavy paws; moves like a slow warm lantern through the treetops.
signature_idea: Moss Glow — passive ability: all party members gain +10% special defence while this kin is on the field
hook: The living forest lantern that is also a wall — soft and round and helpful; your best friend in a grotto full of dark-type threats.

name: Sporevault
concept: The apex guardian of the Spore Grotto — a sub-legendary fungal titan. Its body has grown over tens of thousands of years, and the Grotto itself is said to be its dream. Found only once per save, deep in the Grotto's sealed chamber.
visual: Enormous billowing mushroom-titan form, cap spanning wall to wall in the Grotto, glowing spore-river cascading from its gills, a slow gentle face of pure bioluminescent amber set into the cap, tendrils like living tapestries.
signature_idea: Sporestorm — special signature that fills the field with a spore cloud for 5 turns; all kin take Verdant damage each turn and may fall asleep
hook: The east region's sub-legendary: the Spore Grotto's quiet dreaming god. The moment when you're exploring a mystery cave and discover the cave is alive.

name: Dewspark
concept: A common small glow-beetle whose shell crackles with static electricity built up from brushing through glowmoss. It fires tiny sparks when startled and can numb opponents with contact-static.
visual: Round iridescent beetle, emerald-green carapace with a sheen of blue-violet static, two stubby sparking antennae, six legs, small determined face.
signature_idea: Static Dust — contact move that has a 40% chance to paralyse the target
hook: The tiny sparky beetle that every kid catches on day one in the forest — common, charming, and surprisingly annoying in battle thanks to its paralysis chance.

name: Pebbit
concept: A round pebble-sprite no larger than a fist that clings to cave walls with adhesive stone-dust feet, bouncing away when startled.
visual: Almost perfectly spherical grey-brown body with two stub legs and wide amber eyes; tiny chip-marks on its shell like natural wear marks; silhouette reads as a rolling ball at 16px.
hook: Every kid will want to collect the round little pebble-thing first; it's adorable and bouncy.

name: Rubbol
concept: A stocky boulder-torso kin with a cracked surface revealing faint mineral veins; it rolls defensively when threatened.
visual: Squat, wide-shouldered stone body with visible grey-white mineral veins along arms; amber eyes now set in a craggy brow ridge; four sturdy legs planted firmly.
hook: The middle stage that looks like it means business — mineral veins hint at the spectacular final form.

name: Gravelo
concept: A broad, slow-moving tortoise whose domed shell is encrusted with genuine crystal growths from the mine, each facet catching the lamp-light differently. Canon Cinderhead Mine resident.
visual: Massive hexagonal-plated shell studded with diamond-crystal spires; four column-thick legs; small blunt head with half-lidded stone-grey eyes; walks with serene deliberateness; silhouette unmistakable at any size.
signature_idea: Crystal Rampart — raises Defense sharply while shedding crystal shards as a hazard.
hook: The iconic crystal-shelled tortoise of Cinderhead Mine; seeing it lumbering through the cave is an awe moment.

name: Crumblette
concept: A tiny cave-shrimp-like critter armoured in loose gravel scales that it sheds as a distraction when predators approach.
visual: Six-legged pale grey insectoid with overlapping pebble-scale armour; antennae tipped with tiny round stones; large compound eyes gleam amber in lamplight.
hook: The gravel-shrimp crawling across the mine floor — creepy-cute in the best way.

name: Granulisk
concept: A larger arthropod that has layered its armour into overlapping stone-plate segments; it can shed plates in bursts to blind and chip enemies.
visual: Long segmented body with thick stone-grey carapace plates; two curved forelimbs like stone hooks; compound eyes faceted like rough gems; imposing but not monstrous.
signature_idea: Gravel Burst — sprays stone chips at the whole field, hitting all opponents for light damage while lowering Accuracy.
hook: The cave arthropod that rewards status-move players — a different Stone feel.

name: Flickore
concept: A small static-furred rodent whose iron-ore-flecked pelt crackles with friction sparks as it scurries through the tunnels. Base form of the Sparkrat line.
visual: Rat-sized, wiry body covered in dark iron-grey fur with tiny amber sparks visible along the spine; prominent rounded ears; long thin tail tipped with an ore nugget.
hook: The classic small cave rodent — but charged. Kids will love the sparking fur.

name: Sparkrat
concept: A larger, more confident ore-rodent whose entire coat is threaded with conductive mineral filaments; static discharge is constant and audible as a faint hiss. Canon Cinderhead Mine kin.
visual: Medium-sized stout rodent; fur is dark grey-black with arcing amber-white spark threads woven through it; black iron-ore patches on shoulders and haunches; tail has two ore-bead segments that clatter together.
hook: The sparking mine-rat everyone wants to catch; its crackling silhouette is instantly recognisable in the cave dark.

name: Voltcrag
concept: A large, heavily-built ore-beast that acts as a living conductor; veins of metallic mineral run visibly beneath its hide, and static builds in the mine walls around it.
visual: Bear-sized quadruped; charcoal-black stone-dense hide with bright amber charge-lines tracing the mineral veins; mane of stiff iron-ore bristles along the neck; tail a coiled ore-spring that arcs sparks when lashing.
signature_idea: Ore Discharge — a powerful Stone/Storm special move that chains between nearby metal-bearing surfaces for bonus damage in caves.
hook: The terrifying final form of the mine-rat — it's become a living storm-generator buried in stone.

name: Slaggo
concept: A squat magma-crusted newt that crawls along the hotter tunnels near volcanic seams; its stone shell is still warm to the touch.
visual: Stubby four-legged lizard with a thick stone-crust shell cracked to show dull orange magma glow at the joints; blunt rounded head; wide orange eyes.
hook: Magma-rock newt — the warm-cave contrast to the cold crystal kin nearby.

name: Ignarok
concept: A massive magma-golem-lizard whose hardened lava plating is thick enough to serve as natural armour; heat radiates from it in visible waves, scorching the mine timbers.
visual: Broad-shouldered bipedal reptile; thick fractured obsidian-black plating with deep orange magma cracks at every joint; chunky fists; small cruel eyes burning ember-orange; plume of slow smoke from the neck ridge.
signature_idea: Magma Press — a slow but devastating physical Stone/Ember move that leaves a Burn status.
hook: The slow-moving demolisher of the deep tunnels — huge, hot, and terrifying to face.

name: Mosstub
concept: A round pebble-creature entirely colonised by cave-moss and pale fungi; so still it is easily mistaken for a rock until its eyes open.
visual: Roughly oval stone body carpeted in muted green cave-moss with white fungal nubs; two small round amber eyes that open slowly; four tiny stub legs barely visible beneath the moss.
hook: The moss-covered rock that turns out to be alive — every cave needs one.

name: Lichenmound
concept: A broad stone-crab creature whose carapace has grown a thriving ecosystem of cave-lichen, luminescent mushrooms, and pale roots; it absorbs nutrients from the rock and the life growing on it.
visual: Wide crab-like body with a domed shell entirely overgrown in layers of pale green lichen and glowing blue-white mushroom caps; six thick legs; face mostly hidden by overhang of moss except for two calm stone-grey eyes.
signature_idea: Stone Garden — passsive regeneration from the lichen; raises HP each turn in cave terrain.
hook: A living ecosystem in a cave — ecological wonder packed into a sturdy battler.

name: Icicrag
concept: A geode-shaped cave-creature that keeps its core temperature near freezing; hoarfrost forms on its outer surface and moisture crystals grow from its hide.
visual: Roughly spherical grey rock exterior with ice-crystal formations sprouting from cracks; when it opens up the inner surface is pale blue-white geode crystal; four stumpy ice-capped legs; cold blue eyes.
hook: A geode that's also frozen inside — the best of both mineral worlds.

name: Geodrake
concept: A large cave-drake whose cracked-open geode body is now a permanent structure of jagged blue-white ice crystals and frosted stone; it breathes cold mineral mist.
visual: Dragon-like silhouette; stone-grey body cracked open along the flanks to reveal blue-white crystal interior; ice-crystal wing stubs too small to fly; long neck, frost-breath visible constantly; pale glacial eyes.
signature_idea: Frost Geode — opens its body to unleash a shrapnel burst of ice-crystal shards that deal damage and may freeze.
hook: The geode-dragon — unforgettable silhouette and the perfect late-cave rare.

name: Dustmite
concept: A tiny cave-mite that coats itself in mineral dust for camouflage; extraordinarily fast for its size, darting between rocks in a blur.
visual: Tiny oval-shaped body, almost invisible — pale grey with mineral-dust speckles; eight tiny legs; two oversized orange compound eyes; barely 12px silhouette is just the eyes and dust cloud.
hook: The cave-mite you almost missed — blink and it's gone.

name: Quartzite
concept: A lithe, ferret-shaped cave kin with a body of smooth translucent quartzite; it moves through tunnels at startling speed, its crystalline body briefly refracting light as it passes.
visual: Sleek elongated ferret-like body in milky translucent white-grey; limbs tipped with sharp quartz points; tail a tapering crystal spike; eyes are faceted pale-amber gems; small head, aerodynamic outline.
signature_idea: Vein-Dash — charges through terrain at high speed, ignoring the first hit of the turn.
hook: The crystal ferret that blurs through the cave — fast Stone is surprising and satisfying.

name: Oreling
concept: A dumpling-shaped cave-grub with a body fused to a piece of raw iron ore; it headbutts walls to eat mineral flakes, slowly growing heavier.
visual: Chubby grub-like body wrapped around a dark iron-ore lump; tiny arms, vestigial; rounded head with a wide flat mouth for scraping ore; small black eyes; warm grey-brown colouring.
hook: The ore-grub that looks like it's been bolted to a rock — endearing clumsiness.

name: Orebound
concept: A stocky bipedal kin that has grown up around its ore core; fists and elbows reinforced with raw iron protrusions, and new ore deposits form on its shoulders.
visual: Short biped with a barrel chest; iron-ore growth on both fists and elbows like natural knuckledusters; shoulder ore-knobs; dark grey skin with metallic flecks; small determined face.
hook: The mid-form that looks like it means business — ore-plated and ready to brawl.

name: Ferrolith
concept: A massive iron-ore golem whose body is now a dense interlock of stone and metal; each strike sends shockwaves through the mine tunnel walls.
