visual: Imposing wide-shouldered biped; entire body studded with iron-ore protrusions and plates; massive stone fists each larger than a human torso; slow-burning orange eyes set deep in a craggy face; silhouette is pure power.
signature_idea: Ironclad Slam — a devastating physical move that ignores Defense-raising effects on the target.
hook: The iron golem that grew from a grub — the shock of scale makes its evolution line feel rewarding.

name: Grottip
concept: A cave-bat with wing membranes of thin stone-slate; it echo-locates by tapping stalagmites with its stone wing-tips.
visual: Small bat with thin translucent slate-grey wing membranes; body covered in dark pebble-scale fur; tiny pointed stone nubs on the snout for percussive echo-location; orange eyes.
hook: The stone bat — fluttering with wings made of slate, eerie and charming.

name: Slatewing
concept: A large cave-bat whose slate-stone wings have hardened into proper gliding surfaces; it can hurl razor wing-slates as ranged projectiles.
visual: Large bat with rigid swept-back slate wings that have a blue-grey iridescent sheen; horned head with prominent stone ridges above the eyes; clawed feet grip the ceiling; wingspan creates an impressive silhouette.
signature_idea: Slate Volley — throws wing-edge shards that lower opponent Speed.
hook: The stone bat grown giant — a satisfying cave-boss feel as a rare encounter.

name: Flintpip
concept: A sparrow-sized flint-bird that strikes its beak against stone to generate sparks; its feathers are hardened flint shards.
visual: Small bird with flint-grey body and wing feathers shaped like overlapping flint blades; beak is notched like a flint knapper's tool; eyes are tiny coal-black chips; tail fans into flat stone blades.
hook: The flint-bird that sparks when it moves — gorgeous visual and thematically on-point for a mine.

name: Embershard
concept: A larger raptor-form whose strike-and-spark technique has evolved to the point of producing small detonations; each wing-beat showers sparks and each dive leaves a scorch trail.
visual: Sleek raptor with ember-orange fire-glow visible along the edges of its flint-shard wing feathers; black-charcoal body with crackling lines of orange running down the throat; predator's posture — fast and dangerous.
signature_idea: Flint Dive — an aerial physical Stone/Ember strike that always crits on its first use in battle.
hook: The flint-raptor with fire in its wings — a perfect Glass Cannon fantasy.

name: Spelunk
concept: A stocky cave-mole with iron-hard claws and a flat spade-nose; it digs new tunnel networks constantly, occasionally surfacing with treasure chunks.
visual: Stout, cylindrical body like a living tunnel-borer; velvety dark stone-grey fur; enormous flat pink-grey forepaws with iron-tip claws; blunt brow, tiny eyes suited to darkness; stubby tail.
hook: The cave-mole that's just doing its job — relatable, sturdy, and surprisingly good in battle.

name: Riddlestone
concept: A sphinx-like cave construct that has formed naturally from layered sedimentary stone; its face is barely distinguishable from the rock, and it moves only rarely.
visual: Recumbent cat-lion shape carved entirely from layered sandstone bands in amber, cream, and grey; face is stylised and smooth like worn sculpture; heavy paws; eyes are two oval pieces of polished amber.
signature_idea: Stone Patience — greatly raises Special Defense at the cost of Speed; lore: it has waited in the mine for centuries.
hook: The cave-sphinx that barely moves — an atmosphere piece that's also a wall in battle.

name: Sandrift
concept: A lithe, sand-coloured weasel-like kin that rides small avalanches of loose cave-gravel on its belly; difficult to catch because it can trigger a slide and vanish.
visual: Long slender mustelid form in pale sandy-grey; smooth stone-polished hide; flat head designed to push through gravel flows; tail like a short stone paddle for steering; eyes are glassy agate-brown.
hook: The gravel-surfer of the mines — speedster Stone types are rare and this one has style.

name: Cobblox
concept: A squat box-shaped creature made up of interlocking cobblestone-like segments; each segment can lock tight against neighbouring ones for a complete turtle posture.
visual: Blocky rectangular body assembled from rounded cobble-shaped segments in varied grey tones; four short legs; face is on the front face-panel — two round eyes and a wide simple mouth in a perpetually calm expression.
hook: The blocky cobblestone turtle — a pixel-art dream, looks like it was made of Minecraft blocks before that was a thing.

name: Megalith
concept: A monolith-like standing stone that has awakened; it shuffles forward on two columnar legs and its interlocked stone face is etched with faint rune-like natural mineral patterns.
visual: Tall, narrow standing-stone shape; flat broad top tapering to thick base; two column-stump arms hang at sides; face is a shallow relief of natural stone patterns forming eyes and a stern mouth; grey-blue granite colour with white quartz vein runes.
signature_idea: Monolith Stance — becomes immovable for 2 turns, nullifying all damage taken; then attacks with enormous force.
hook: The ancient standing stone that got up and walked — scale and gravitas in one form.

name: Amberite
concept: A small snail-like kin whose shell is a smooth amber gemstone; the preserved insect visible inside is actually alive and projects special mineral-light energy.
visual: Snail-form with a teardrop amber-gem shell; warm honey-amber colour with tiny silhouette of an ancient insect frozen within; soft pale grey body; two eye-stalks topped with amber-bead pupils.
hook: The amber-snail with a secret trapped inside — the mystery of what's within is irresistible.

name: Resinlord
concept: A large stag-beetle-like kin whose entire body has been preserved and enhanced by fossilised amber resin; it projects beams of compressed amber-light that petrify on contact.
visual: Stag-beetle body in gleaming amber-gold resin; oversized mandibles that glow orange at the tips; wing-cases sealed shut by amber; legs have golden resin drips like armour-rivets; body transparent enough to see the ancient structure within.
signature_idea: Amber Beam — fires a dense stream of fossilised-light energy that has a chance to petrify (Paralysis variant).
hook: The amber stag-beetle — fossilised and powerful, a collector's dream.

name: Fossik
concept: A small fossil-shrimp kin that has come back to life; its carapace is the hard chalk-white of ancient bone-stone and it navigates by vibrating its antennae against rock.
visual: Trilobite-like segmented body in pale bone-white chalk; two long swept-back antennae; multiple small legs; small eyes set in a wide flat head; delicate and prehistoric in feel.
hook: The little fossil come to life — ancient and delicate, like holding deep time.

name: Crevasser
concept: A revived fossil-crustacean that has grown larger and harder; its shell now has genuine crevasse-deep ridges and it moves along cave floors with quiet authority.
visual: Larger segmented crustacean; thick ridged carapace in layered grey-cream; heavy claws useful for gripping rock; wide eyes set at the edge of its head-plate; moves with a side-to-side deliberate walk.
hook: The fossil mid-form that looks genuinely ancient — evolution as palaeontology.

name: Lithonyx
concept: A massive revived fossil-predator whose carapace has grown thick enough to shrug off cave-ins; it swings its tail like a wrecking ball and its eyes glow with a faint ancient light.
visual: Large quadruped; thick ridged stone-white carapace with deep limestone-cream and grey layering; broad low head with two faintly glowing amber eyes; heavy armoured tail; primordial and formidable.
signature_idea: Ancient Force — a powerful physical attack drawing on the kin's aeons of preserved energy; never misses.
hook: The fossil that never should have woken up — ancient predator energy in a modern cave.

name: Crystink
concept: A small crystal-beetle whose wing-cases are faceted like cut gems; it scurries through the Crystoll Vault tunnels collecting fragments of pure diamond crystal to patch its growing shell.
visual: Beetle-form about the size of a thumb; transparent faceted wing-cases filled with cyan-white crystal shards that catch light; six iridescent legs; eyes are tiny perfect gem-spheres in deep blue.
hook: The crystal beetle that collects gems for its own shell — adorable self-improvement.

name: Lumecite
concept: A radiant crystal-stag whose antlers are grown entirely from pure luminous diamond crystal; it illuminates entire mine chambers as it walks, and its light is said to repel the Hollowing.
visual: Elegant deer-like kin with a white-grey crystal body; antlers are an elaborate branching structure of cyan-diamond crystal that glow continuously; eyes are large and clear as water; hooves are polished white stone; beautiful and otherworldly.
hook: The crystal-antlered stag lighting the dark mine — majestic and mysterious, every player wants to find it.

name: Prismara
concept: The apex Stone/Light crystal kin of the Crystoll Vault — a towering crystal-stag whose entire body is now fused into a living prism; it refracts all light into a full spectrum and its presence causes crystal growths to bloom across the cave walls. The Stone Constellation Warden.
visual: Grand stag-form; body is smooth translucent white crystal shot through with a continuous rainbow refraction; diamond-branching antlers reach nearly to cave ceilings; four crystal-column legs; eyes emit soft white radiance; when still it is indistinguishable from a perfect crystal formation.
signature_idea: Prismatic Cascade — refracts stored light into a multi-hit special barrage that hits all types neutrally but with devastating power; lights up the battlefield for several turns.
hook: The Crystoll Vault's secret — the most spectacular kin in the eastern region and a genuine jaw-drop moment.

name: Shalekin
concept: A swift flat-bodied lizard that skims along shale ledges at speed; its sides are thin enough to slip into cracks barely visible to the eye.
visual: Ultra-flat lizard body in layered grey-blue shale tones; profile is nearly two-dimensional; runs on four long splayed legs; head is a thin wedge shape with eyes on the sides; tail flat like a fin.
hook: The flat shale-lizard that disappears sideways into cracks — an unsettling, delightful ability.

name: Shalestrike
concept: A fast, aggressive monitor-lizard form whose shale-plated body can now generate enough friction force to crack stone walls on impact; it uses ledges as launching pads.
visual: Long monitor-lizard silhouette in sharp grey-blue; shale-plate armour along back and limbs; powerful rear legs for explosive sprints; flat angular head; tail whips faster than the eye can follow.
signature_idea: Ledge Launch — gains speed boost when attacking from elevated terrain.
hook: The aggressive shale monitor — fast Physical Sweeper Stone types are exciting and rare.

name: Geodebug
concept: A large pill-bug that has grown a full geode as its shell; when curled it is indistinguishable from a plain stone, and it surprises enemies by opening suddenly to expose the crystal interior.
visual: Rolled-up it is a grey stone sphere; opened it reveals brilliant amethyst-purple crystal lining; seven-segment body visible in open state; long antennae; legs fold perfectly inside; comical huge eyes when exposed.
signature_idea: Geode Surprise — ambush opening from rolled state deals damage and confuses the target.
hook: The geode pill-bug — the best surprise in a cave, every time.

name: Stalacyte
concept: A slow cave-snail whose shell is shaped like a stalactite; it attaches to the ceiling and releases when threatened, dropping onto foes below.
visual: Snail body with a long tapered stalactite-cone shell; hangs from the cave ceiling by a mucus anchor; pale limestone-cream colour with faint dripstone ridging; wide innocent eyes on stalks.
hook: The ceiling-snail — cave players will be looking up from now on.

name: Dripgore
concept: A large cave-cephalopod that has built a full stalactite-column as a natural mobile shell; it moves slowly but is nearly impervious to frontal attacks.
visual: Large body hidden beneath a heavy column of built-up limestone dripstone; tapered at top; multiple slow-moving tentacle-limbs extend from the base; eyes are dim amber slits in the stone mass; drips water constantly.
signature_idea: Column Drop — drops its full stalactite mass on a target for massive physical damage; takes a turn to re-anchor.
hook: The stalactite that walks — cave horror that becomes a beloved tanky partner.

name: Gravepick
concept: A clever crow-like cave bird that has fitted a flint shard over its beak like a pickaxe tip; it mines for gems with this tool and stores them in a stone-lined throat pouch.
visual: Black-grey corvid form with a prominent flint-shard beak-sheath; hunched forward like it is always peering at something valuable in the rock; bright curious amber eyes; stone-patterned wing feathers; stubby feet.
hook: The tool-using cave crow — resourceful and charming, a player's clever little companion.

name: Tuffcub
concept: A bear cub whose fur has been replaced by a thick coat of tuff-stone granules, making it extraordinarily dense; it bumbles happily but each bump against a cave wall leaves a dent.
visual: Round bear-cub proportions; entire body covered in pale grey tuff-stone granules that give it a rough-textured matte surface; small round ears capped with stone; wide happy face; huge paws.
hook: The stone bear cub — unstoppably cute and unstoppably heavy; both qualities are delightful.

name: Tuffcrag
concept: A full-grown stone-bear whose tuff coating has consolidated into a genuine rock hide; it carves new tunnels through sheer body mass and its roar vibrates loose stones from the walls.
visual: Massive bear; full rock-hide coat in layered tuff-grey and pale stone; broad flat face with deep-set amber eyes; fur visible only inside the ears and muzzle; enormous build; roar-cloud of stone dust.
signature_idea: Cave Roar — shakes the battlefield, lowering Defense and Special Defense of all opponents.
hook: The full-grown stone bear — powerful, intimidating, and still somehow a bear you want to hug.

name: Crystoll
concept: The singular guardian of the Crystoll Vault — an ancient crystal troll whose body is entirely transmuted into a dense network of living diamond crystal; it absorbs ambient starlight through the mine's deepest fissures and stores it as raw photonic energy. Earns the Crystoll Vault its name.
visual: Massive biped — broad-shouldered and barrel-chested like a great troll but made entirely of diamond crystal; body refracts light in all directions so it appears to glow from within; face is an abstract crystal arrangement with two deep-indigo inner-light eyes; moves slowly and each footstep resonates a pure musical tone.
signature_idea: Vault Light — charges for one turn absorbing all light in the area (dims the cave) then unleashes a devastating omnidirectional Light/Stone energy release.
hook: The legendary namesake of the Crystoll Vault — a creature so old and so bright it has become the cave itself. The east region's trophy catch.

name: Kiteling
concept: A small paper-framed glider-bird native to the Galehigh Terraces, born riding the coastal updrafts on wings of taut translucent skin stretched over hollow bone spars.
visual: Diamond kite silhouette with a tiny round head at the leading edge, cream-parchment wings edged with storm-blue, a long ribbon tail that coils in still air; reads as a kite on a string at 32px.
hook: It looks exactly like the kites the terrace farmers fly — a living toy soaring above the cliffs.

name: Galespar
concept: The fully kindled Kiteling becomes a sleek predator-kite that divebombs prey from altitude, its hollow spars crackling with accumulated static discharged on impact.
visual: Long arrowhead silhouette, wings swept back like a swept delta kite, ivory-white body with indigo lightning-stitch veins, ribbon tails split into three crackling tendrils; fast and angular at 64px.
signature_idea: Sparline Dive — builds speed charge on the turn before, then delivers a boosted Storm strike on the next.
hook: The sweet little paper kite became a lightning-veined hunter — the terrace farmers' pride turned ace.

name: Thrumvane
concept: A small, plump kin whose tail spins like a weathervane in wind; the rotation charges a static field around its body and it uses that stored charge to jam opponents' moves.
visual: Chubby oval body, stubby limbs, a broad four-blade tail that spins freely, grey-blue fur with yellow static-spark highlights at the vane tips; cute windmill shape at 32px.
hook: A living windmill with a static personality — every time it spins faster, sparks fly.

name: Thrumble
concept: A mid-stage kin whose vane-tail has grown wider and generates a continuous hum of low-frequency electricity that muddles the senses of nearby opponents.
visual: Sleeker torso, elongated limbs, tail now a six-blade fan crackling at each tip with pale yellow sparks, a thin electric halo around the body's outline; reads as actively buzzing at 48px.
hook: You can feel the hum before you see it — that constant low vibration is deeply unsettling to fight.

name: Vortavane
concept: The apex vane-beast: a tall, regal kin whose entire dorsal spine has become a bank of spinning turbine-blades, generating a tornado-like static field that blinds and staggers opponents.
visual: Upright digitigrade silhouette, dark storm-grey coat, a full spine-ridge of spinning vane-blades each trailing a spark arc, crackling eye-markings that pulse in sync with the vanes; imposing at 64px.
signature_idea: Stormfield — creates a persistent static field that has a chance to paralyse any kin that uses a contact move.
hook: The windmill grew into a roaring turbine — impossible to touch without getting shocked.

name: Cirruff
concept: A cloud-fluff pup born inside a high cirrus cloud; its fur is made of compressed cloud-stuff that crackles with soft static, and it glows faintly gold at the edges when happy.
visual: Plump round pup, fluffy white cloud-textured fur that puffs out at the paws and tail, faint gold edge-glow, two bright eyes and a tiny static-spark nose; irresistibly soft at 32px.
hook: A puppy made of cloud-fluff that sparkles — you'll want to hug it even knowing it shocks back.

name: Nimbruff
concept: The cloud-pup's fur has densified into cumulonimbus wool that flashes with internal lightning; it's cheerful but the gold-edged static halos around its body scatter light in every direction.
visual: Larger barrel-chested dog, dense grey-and-white thundercloud fur, a visible inner-glow pulsing electric-gold, long windswept ears, silver underbelly; bold presence at 48px.
hook: A golden glow behind storm-grey clouds — every battle with it feels like watching a storm roll in.

name: Cumulance
concept: The cloud-hound's final form — a great silver-and-gold stormhound whose body is a living thunderhead, radiating soft dawn-light even through the Galehigh dusk.
visual: Majestic hound silhouette, body a sculptured mass of dark-silver cloud, a blazing golden core visible through the chest, mane of vertical lightning-columns, four cloud-pad legs leaving gold hoofprints; awe-inspiring at 64px.
signature_idea: Goldstrike — a special move that targets both opposing Sp.Def and applies a Light-type radiance debuff.
hook: A cloud-puppy grew into the living heart of a thunderstorm lit from within by golden light.

name: Zappick
concept: A tiny spark-mouse that lives in the stone crevices of the Galehigh Terraces, charging itself by rubbing its wiry tail against the cliff-face until it becomes a walking static bomb.
visual: Wiry round mouse, sleek storm-grey fur spiked with static at every tip, a spring-coil tail that glows blue-white at the end, wide bright eyes; restless energy at 32px.
hook: The tiny overcharged mouse that zaps everything it touches — a walking hazard you'll adore.

name: Voltrix
concept: A sleek predatory kin grown from the spark-mouse, now capable of launching concentrated plasma bolts from the tips of its elongated coil-tipped limbs.
visual: Lean forward-leaning predator, storm-grey and electric-blue striping, four coil-tipped limbs each arcing with plasma, swept-back head-spines, long whip tail; built for pure speed and explosive power at 64px.
signature_idea: Plasma Burst — hits at high speed with a chance to ignore the opponent's Sp.Def buffs.
hook: From tiny shocking mouse to this crackling blue-streaked predator — an ambush striker that rewards the first turn.

name: Brezling
concept: A cheerful gust-finch with hollow bones so light it sometimes gets carried away by accident; it sings a rising-tone whistle that signals incoming weather to the terrace farmers.
visual: Tiny round bird, pale sky-grey body with darker wing-tips, a bright yellow-cream beak, feather-tufts that stream backward in any breeze; round quick silhouette at 32px.
hook: The little weather-bird that gets stolen by its own element — everybody roots for it.

name: Whistrak
concept: A swift gale-swallow that accelerates to shrieking speeds in strong thermals and leaves a ringing tonal trail in the air that disorients opponents.
visual: Long swept-wing swallow, pale-blue and white plumage, a forked tail edged with static-blue, a bright open-beak singing expression; pure aerial grace at 64px.
signature_idea: Resonance Shriek — reduces opponent's Speed and has a chance to confuse.
hook: A sweet little finch became a missile-fast shrieking swallow that navigates by its own sonic field.

name: Crackling
concept: A round static-beetle that clings to terrace fence-posts and discharges built-up charge in sharp pops when disturbed; the terrace children call them 'snap-bugs' and dare each other to touch them.
visual: Squat domed beetle, dark charcoal carapace, yellow-arc markings on the elytra, a tiny spark-gap gap between the wing-covers that crackles; simple dome silhouette at 32px.
hook: The snap-bug you dared your friends to touch — terrifying in miniature, irresistible to collect.

name: Stormcyte
concept: The snap-beetle fully charged — a large armoured beetle that projects a permanent crackling field, able to disrupt opponent moves with persistent electromagnetic interference.
visual: Wide beetle silhouette, jet-black carapace banded with bright yellow discharge-stripe, mandibles arcing with electricity, wings folded over a glowing gap; intimidating and geometric at 64px.
signature_idea: Jam Signal — has a chance to cancel an opponent's last-used move for the next two turns.
hook: The annoying snap-bug grew into the apex anti-mover — impossible to use your best moves against.

name: Gustwing
concept: A small crag-hopping bird with wings that are disproportionately large for its body, giving it a tumbling, erratic flight style as it surfs the cliff-face updrafts.
visual: Round body dwarfed by wide angular wings, storm-blue above and white below, short bold tail, a single bright eye visible in the compact face; looks perpetually mid-gust at 32px.
hook: Wings too big for its body — it looks like it's flying by accident, and winning by chaos.

name: Shearow
concept: A sleek mid-stage raptor that has grown into its wings and now rides thermals with precise control, using the wind to amplify the force of its diving strikes.
visual: Lean hawk silhouette, dark slate-blue dorsal plumage, white underside, swept-back head-crest, talon-tips crackling with static; controlled and alert at 48px.
hook: Watching the clumsy little wing-tumbler grow into this disciplined hunter is immensely satisfying.

name: Galecrest
concept: A magnificent storm-raptor whose every wingbeat summons a blade of compressed wind, and whose talon-strikes crackle with the electricity built during its high-altitude stoops.
visual: Large hawk silhouette with swept crescent wings, midnight-blue plumage shot with electric-silver streaks, a tall swept-back head-crest, talons wrapped in arcing plasma; commanding at 64px.
signature_idea: Wind Talon — physical Storm move that deals bonus damage proportional to the user's Speed stat.
hook: The apex of the Galehigh skies — everything below it is prey, and it knows it.

name: Sparrat
concept: A twitchy static-furred rodent that nested in old Cinderhead Mine ventilation shafts and migrated to Galehigh when the mine cooled; it stores charge in its coiled spring-tail.
visual: Small round-headed rodent, coarse grey-tan fur spiked upward by static, oversized coil-spring tail, wide startled eyes, stubby limbs always slightly airborne; comic energy at 32px.
hook: A rodent so overcharged it's practically bouncing — chaos in a small package.

name: Coilraz
concept: The twitchy spark-rodent has grown into a stocky disruptor whose coiled tail now acts as a powerful spring-launcher for electric pulses, able to arc charge across multiple opponents.
visual: Robust stoat-like silhouette, coarse striped storm-grey and pale blue fur, a tight double-helix tail tip glowing at the end, aggressive leaning stance; disruptive presence at 64px.
signature_idea: Arc Lash — hits all opponents for modest damage and has a chance to paralyse each.
hook: The chaos-rodent grew up and got organised — still chaotic, but now precisely so.

name: Puffgust
concept: A cloud-jellyfish that drifts at the height of the terrace ridgelines, trailing long translucent tentacles that act as wind-sensors; it puffs up to catch gusts and deflate to dive.
visual: Round dome body, almost translucent pale blue-grey, four trailing tentacles edged in faint yellow static dots, a simple smiling face near the top; gentle floating shape at 32px.
hook: A sky jellyfish that breathes on the same thermals as the kites — impossible not to find charming.

name: Squallveil
concept: The cloud-jellyfish kindled into a stormveil — a large, elegant airborne medusa whose trailing skirt crackles with continuous lightning that sweeps the sky in rings.
visual: Wide translucent bell-shape, storm-blue and deep purple shading, inner flash-pulse of yellow-white lightning, long fringed trailing tentacles each branching into electric filaments; dramatic and alien at 64px.
signature_idea: Lightning Skirt — damages any kin that switches into the battlefield while this kin is active.
hook: A drifting sky jellyfish became a curtain of lightning you have to walk through.

name: Quillspark
concept: A heavy-bodied cliff-porcupine whose iron-ore spines conduct and store static electricity from the surrounding air, turning each quill into a small lightning rod.
visual: Round compact body, dark iron-grey with reddish ore flecks, a back-ridge of short stubby spines each tipped in a crackle of static, tiny suspicious eyes; sturdy at 32px.
hook: A porcupine made of lightning rods — touching it from any direction is a bad idea.

name: Orequill
concept: A massive ore-porcupine whose spines have grown into heavy magnetised iron columns that arc charge between themselves in constant crackling bridges; impact attacks send a shockwave through its entire spine array.
visual: Hulking barrel silhouette, dull black iron-ore plating, a full dorsal array of tall magnetised spines each connected by arcing blue-white tendrils, small glowing eyes under a heavy brow; an immovable charged fortress at 64px.
signature_idea: Magnetite Slam — heavy physical Storm/Stone hybrid strike; if it contacts an opponent, discharges all stored static into them.
hook: The compact cliff-porcupine became a walking lightning pylon — half geological feature, half unstoppable bruiser.

name: Twixle
concept: A tiny electric-sprite insect that flickers like a loose spark; it spends its nights tracing constellations on its own as it darts between cliff-face crevices.
visual: Tiny winged sprite, body the size of a firefly, intense white-yellow core with faint storm-blue wings, a twisting sparkling flight trail, barely larger than a dot at 32px.
hook: The tiniest thing in Galehigh — a single spark given wings and a personality.

name: Lumespark
concept: The electric-sprite has kindled into a larger, brighter form whose wings emit radiant static that illuminates the terrace dusk in pulses of warm white-gold.
visual: Dragonfly-like silhouette, four wide translucent wings sparking gold at their veins, bright body of white-yellow radiance, a delicate pointed face; speed and light in one shape at 64px.
signature_idea: Gleam Dash — raises Speed and applies a brief Light-type radiant field that slightly weakens Dark-type moves.
hook: From one tiny spark to this radiant dragonfly-angel — the brightest thing in the north sky.

name: Hailwhirr
concept: A small blizzard-wasp native to the high passes above Galehigh, spinning frost crystals from its wing-tips as it spirals in updrafts; its sting is numbing cold rather than venom.
visual: Compact wasp silhouette, ice-blue and silver banding, wings that frost the air visibly as they beat, a sharp pointed abdomen tipped with a pale blue crystal stinger; crisp geometry at 32px.
hook: A winter wasp that spins ice from its wings — pretty until it stings.

name: Glacewing
concept: A mid-stage blizzard-wasp that has grown compound crystal eyes and whose wingbeats create a spiralling vortex of hail shards around its flight path.
visual: Larger angular wasp, wide iridescent frost-blue compound eyes, four wings edged with jagged ice-crystal trim, abdomen trailing a coil of hail particles; dynamic danger at 48px.
hook: The ice-vortex around it makes it look like it's already mid-attack even while resting.

name: Frigalance
concept: The apex blizzard-wasp: a slender, blade-like creature that moves through lightning-charged blizzards with total ease, delivering shots of frozen plasma that combine electric and ice damage.
visual: Long aerodynamic wasp silhouette, pale near-white with deep azure markings, a pair of blade-like crystal wings, four foreleg-lances each tipped with frozen lightning; cold elegance at 64px.
signature_idea: Sleet Lance — a special Storm/Frost hybrid move with a chance to both paralyse and freeze.
hook: Beautiful, lethal, and utterly cold — the sky's version of a thrown spear.

name: Drifthull
concept: A weather-worn, broad-bellied cloud-beast that hunches into the wind on Windward Stair; it absorbs lightning strikes into its rubbery body and re-emits them slowly as static warmth.
visual: Low broad silhouette, slate-grey rubbery hide, rounded belly, thick stubby limbs, two small glowing white eyes, faint static-crackle fringe around the edges; grounded and bulky at 32px.
hook: The unassuming grey blob that just will not go down — quietly invincible.

name: Stormhulk
concept: A massive storm-absorber that has kindled into a barrel-shaped titan; it intercepts lightning deliberately and holds the charge, releasing it in a single controlled burst once fully saturated.
visual: Enormous barrel-round silhouette, dark anvil-cloud grey, deep horizontal lightning-scar lines running around its body like contour lines, two huge steady eyes; unshakably huge at 64px.
signature_idea: Surge Release — charges for one turn, then delivers a colossal special Storm blast; power scales with damage received since last use.
hook: Let it get hit all day — then watch it pay everything back at once.

name: Gyrolin
concept: A small wind-serpent with a body like a compressed spring; it coils tight in the calm pockets between cliff faces and then launches itself skyward at terrifying speed to strike.
visual: Slender coiled serpent, pale silvery-blue scales, a pointed wedge head, two fin-like crests folded flat when coiled and spread wide in flight; minimal and tensed at 32px.
hook: The coiled spring that becomes a flying spear — all that potential energy suddenly released.

name: Spirovolt
concept: The wind-serpent fully kindled into a long, gyrating storm-snake that spirals through the air at speed, generating a plasma corona along its whole length before releasing it in a forward cone.
visual: Long spiralling serpent silhouette, deep storm-blue scales banded with electric-yellow, wing-crests spread wide and arcing with static, blazing eyes; an electric comet at 64px.
signature_idea: Coil Drive — raises Sp.Atk one stage; next Storm move deals boosted damage from the stored rotational energy.
hook: A spring became a living tornado — it spirals into the screen in a blazing helix.

name: Squallox
concept: A gust-fox kit born on the exposed upper terraces, its tail a perpetual blurred blur of motion that keeps it airborne a fraction of a second longer than it should be able to stay.
visual: Compact kit silhouette, deep azure-blue fur, four white paws, a tall pointed ear-fan on each side, a blurred fan-tail of multiple stacked ghost images; looks like it's still mid-run at 32px.
hook: The fox whose tail moves so fast it looks like it has three tails at once — speed incarnate.

name: Galefox
concept: A sleek mid-stage gust-fox who now runs so fast it creates a visible bow-wave of compressed air ahead of it; close-combat opponents are pushed back by the pressure wave before it even strikes.
visual: Lithe medium fox silhouette, deep storm-blue body fading to pale silver at the throat and belly, a single bold tail crackling at the tip, wind-distortion ripples around the paws; pure velocity at 48px.
hook: The bow-wave around it makes the ground look like it's peeling back ahead of every sprint.

name: Tempestail
concept: The apex gust-fox — a lithe, white-silver predator whose tail is now a visible thunderstorm compressed into a spinning cylinder; at full sprint its approach sounds like a breaking gale.
visual: Elegant large fox silhouette, white-silver fur with storm-blue markings, a spiralling tornado-tail that crackles with visible charge, twin ear-fins swept back; the apex of aerodynamic at 64px.
signature_idea: Gale Rush — a high-priority physical move that doubles in power if used first in a turn.
hook: The little kit that couldn't quite leave the ground became this magnificent silver storm-predator.

name: Whorlix
concept: A storm-husk kin that drifted in from the Coldfog Marches: a hollow shell of compressed dark air and residual lightning, still discharging sporadically from inside an empty void-core.
visual: Tall hollow silhouette like a funnel-cloud with a gap where the centre should be, dark ink-purple swirling walls faintly lit by trapped lightning, jagged trailing tendrils; uneasy void-shape at 48px.
signature_idea: Void Static — drains opponent's PP on the moves they use most frequently; applies confusion.
hook: A storm made of nothing — the Hollowing's mark on electricity, eerie and unforgettable.

name: Tidevolt
concept: An electric-eel kin that climbs sea-cliff waterfalls on the northern coast, generating charge from the ionised saltwater spray; it ambushes from the surf with a crackling forward lunge.
visual: Slim sinuous eel, sea-green and silver body, blue electric striping along the lateral line, a wide fan-tail that holds it upright in water; lithe hunter at 32px.
hook: An eel that climbs waterfalls by treating electricity like a ladder — wild and elegant.

name: Surgeeel
concept: A powerful electric sea-serpent that rides tidal bores up the northern inlets, discharging into the water around it; both Storm and Tide moves power it up equally.
visual: Long serpent silhouette, deep ocean-blue with bright electric-teal banding, a crested head fin and lateral fins crackling with charge, wide bright eyes; dramatic coastal apex at 64px.
signature_idea: Tidal Arc — a special Storm/Tide hybrid move that hits all opponents and gains power in rain conditions.
hook: The sea-eel that grew into a tidal lightning god — both fishers and farmers fear the storms it heralds.

name: Sparrowcaw
concept: A scrappy little terrace-sparrow that pecks spark-producing pyrite from the cliff walls and stores the flint-chips under its wing to use as a crude battery during battle.
visual: Compact passerine bird, rust-brown and dark slate-blue plumage, a puffed chest crossed by a small leather-look pouch of flint pebbles, tiny defiant eyes; cheeky and small at 32px.
hook: A sparrow that carries flint to start fires — more resourceful than it looks.

name: Flintbeak
concept: A mid-stage strike-bird whose beak has hardened into a flint-edged chisel that sparks on every strike, and whose charge builds faster the more consecutive hits it lands.
visual: Lean raptor, dark charcoal and slate-blue feathers, a dramatically elongated flint-edged beak that cracks sparks on impact, talons wrapped in static; focused aggression at 48px.
hook: The beak-as-thunderstrike concept makes every hit feel satisfying — a natural woodpecker of electricity.

name: Strikeaven
concept: The apex flint-raven: a large, sleek storm-bird whose entire beak has become a solid static-discharge rod that releases a plasma bolt on each strike; the more it attacks, the stronger each blow.
visual: Tall raven silhouette, ink-black feathers with electric-blue iridescence, a long bladed beak crackling with a continuous spark-arc, wingtips trailing static filaments; sleek and lethal at 64px.
signature_idea: Momentum Strike — deals damage that scales with each consecutive hit in a chain; chain resets if it misses or is swapped out.
hook: Each hit charges it more — a slow build into an unstoppable momentum that rewards not retreating.

name: Aethrix
concept: The Wind-Eye's hidden kin — a singular sky-sprite born at the still centre of a permanent cyclone in the sky-grotto above Galehigh. It exists in a state of calm impossibility: a being of absolute stillness surrounded by absolute chaos.
visual: Elegant humanoid silhouette, translucent wind-pale body, two wide feathered wings folded in stillness, a single rotating storm-eye marking on the chest, long flowing hair of static filaments that orbit it; serene and vast at 64px.
signature_idea: Eye of Storm — sets a unique field: all Storm-type moves used while this kin is on the field deal double power; all other moves deal half power. Lasts three turns.
hook: The dead-calm centre of a cyclone given a face — the most paradoxical and beautiful thing in the Galehigh sky.

name: Thunderoost
concept: The Thunderroost's apex bird — a legendary raptor that nests in the Windward Stair crags and whose feathers each hold a trapped lightning bolt; when it spreads its wings at dusk, the whole terrace sky lights up.
visual: Massive eagle silhouette with an enormous wingspan, white-gold primary feathers that crackle at their tips, a deep storm-blue back, a radiant light-halo crown of feather-quills, piercing twin lightning-bolt iris eyes; thunderstruck majesty at 64px.
signature_idea: Dawnstrike — a slow, very high-power Storm/Light signature move that also removes all weather and field effects on use.
hook: The bird whose wingspan lights the whole sky at dusk — the terrace farmers know it as the Lampwarden's herald.

name: Nimbit
concept: A hyperactive little sky-squirrel that glides between terrace levels using a cape of thin stretched skin, building static charge from the friction of the air as it descends.
visual: Small squirrel with wide wing-membrane flaps, pale grey body with electric-blue membrane veins, a brushy tail that flares as it glides, huge eyes for judging thermals; built for gliding at 32px.
hook: A little squirrel that charges up on the way down and unleashes it on landing — a tiny windup toy.

name: Stridepelt
concept: The glide-squirrel kindled into a lean, fast-footed sky-runner whose full wing-membranes now carry it in extended soaring bursts, and whose static-charged pelt crackles on every landing.
visual: Lean athletic squirrel silhouette, wider wing-membranes that ripple in motion, a long crackling tail, storm-blue streaks across the pale fur; always looks like it just landed at speed at 64px.
signature_idea: Glide Shock — first move of a battle is a high-priority Static charge that always paralyses if the opponent has not yet moved.
hook: The squirrel who learned to land with maximum impact — a fast support that punishes slow starters.

name: Boltwing
concept: A small, triangular-winged lightning-bat that clings to the underside of cliff ledges by day and erupts in crackling swarms at dusk, navigating by the electric sense-field of the group.
visual: Compact bat, wide angular wings, dark storm-grey body, a tiny bright-white eye each side, wing-membrane shot through with blue-white lightning veins; crisp bat silhouette at 32px.
hook: A bat-swarm that navigates by its own lightning field — the cliffs crackle at dusk when they launch.

name: Thornvolte
concept: The lightning-bat fully charged: a large, sharp-winged storm-bat whose entire frame arcs with discharge; every sonic pulse it sends out returns as a bolt of plasma.
visual: Large angular bat silhouette, midnight-blue body, wide serrated wing-edges each crackling continuously, two bright white eyes that pulse with echolocation arcs, a sharp bony crest; sleek apex bat at 64px.
signature_idea: Echo Bolt — launches a pulse that bounces between up to two targets before dissipating, hitting each for moderate Storm damage.
hook: A bat made of lightning — each sonic pulse it fires comes back as a bolt. Fighting it is fighting sound.

name: Zephyrank
concept: A colossal storm-drake that circles the upper peaks of the Windward Stair, so massive that the displacement wake from a single wingbeat topples terrace fences two levels below. Its body conducts and redirects whole storm cells.
visual: Vast dragon silhouette, deep charcoal-black scales, a wide flat head flanked by swept electrical-horn arrays, wings broad enough to blot the dusk sky, a thick whipping tail ending in a lightning-rod tip; the apex north predator at 64px.
signature_idea: Tempest Body — passive ability: any physical hit on Zephyrank has a 40% chance to paralyse the attacker from the static discharge.
hook: The drake so large it IS the storm — the thing that makes the Windward Stair famous as a danger, and you can catch it.

name: Frostkit
concept: A small frost-foxlet with ice-crystal tufted ears and a plumed tail that traces glittering trails in the snow. It dashes across glacier flats, leaving star-shaped pawprints that glimmer for several minutes before fading.
visual: Compact, round-faced foxlet with pale ice-blue fur shading to white on the chest; large translucent crystal ear-tufts; bushy tail ringed in soft diamond-blue; tiny, readable silhouette with a clear fox outline at 32px.
signature_idea: Frosttrail — leaves a lingering ice patch hazard on the field when it dashes
hook: Irresistible starter-tier fox energy; the crystal ear tufts and glittery pawprints make it immediately iconic.

name: Glacivix
concept: The kindled form of Frostkit — a sleek, long-limbed glacier-fox whose entire coat is frosted over in fine hexagonal crystal patterns. Its breath crystallises instantly into a trailing mist plume, and it can sprint across thin ice without breaking through.
visual: Lithe, elegant fox body with elongated legs; coat patterned in geometric ice-hex markings; a sweeping tail of layered ice-crystal feathers that fan out when it runs; visible speed-line silhouette, reads bold at 48px.
signature_idea: Hexdash — burst-speed move that also lowers target's speed with a chill
hook: Evolves from cute into elegant and powerful — the satisfying arc of a favourite kin growing up.

name: Snowtoll
concept: A sturdy, wide-horned ice yak calf whose bell-shaped hollow horns chime softly in cold wind. Glacier folk hang small carved bells from its horns as good-luck charms — it seems to enjoy the extra weight.
visual: Stocky barrel-bodied calf; shaggy pale-blue wool coat that puffs out at the sides; two wide, hollow horns tipped with rounded crystal bells; big solid hooves; warm round eyes; cute-bulky silhouette at 32px.
hook: The bell horns are charming and immediately distinctive — the sound design writes itself.

name: Glacibell
concept: The fully grown bell-horned glacier yak. Its horns have become massive crystalline bell-towers of ice, and a resonant toll from Glacibell can shatter thin ice walls or calm panicked kin caught in blizzards. Herders navigate by its call through whiteouts.
visual: Huge barrel-chested yak silhouette with a dense woolly coat of layered ice-blue and bone-white; enormous swept-back horns each ending in a translucent ice-crystal bell; thick hooves leaving deep prints; imposing and solid at 48px.
signature_idea: Permafrost Toll — a resonant bell-strike that also lowers both the target's attack and special attack
hook: The transition from cute tinkling calf to ancient glacier guardian is deeply satisfying — and practical traversal lore writes itself around it.

name: Auralisk
concept: A young ribbon-serpent that coils through the upper sky near the glacier. Its scales refract starlight into tiny aurora-like smears of colour. It feeds on concentrated lamp-glow and is drawn to vesperlamps, circling them curiously before darting away.
visual: Long, slender serpent body with no limbs; scales in shifting blue-to-green to rose iridescence; faint trailing light-ribbons behind it in motion; a soft glowing crescent on its brow; elegant even as a small base form.
hook: Aurora ribbon-serpent — the concept alone sells it; kids will search the glacier sky for this one.

name: Auraveil
concept: A fully kindled aurora-serpent of breathtaking scale. It drifts between glacier peaks trailing curtains of living aurora light, its whole body a slow-ripple display of shifting colour. Where it passes, the snow beneath glows faintly for hours. Pale Vault elders call it 'the sky's own brushstroke.'
visual: Greatly elongated sinuous serpent; body widens at the mid-section then tapers to a broad feathered tail of translucent aurora-light ribbons; crown of three ice-crystal spires on the brow; scales shimmer green/violet/rose in concentric rings; dramatic sweep at 48px.
signature_idea: Aurorafall — a prismatic Light/Frost combined special blast that lowers the target's special defence
hook: The living aurora — every player who sees it in the distance has to have it.

name: Hushvole
concept: A small, round snow-vole that buries itself just below the glacier surface and pops up to startle travellers. Its breath muffles all nearby sounds — experienced Pale Vault guides say you've entered Hushvole territory when your footsteps go quiet.
visual: Chubby, button-eyed little rodent; pale grey-white fur with a faint blue undertone; stubby frost-tipped claws; oversized round ears; a perfectly spherical snow-dusted silhouette at 32px that reads as one compact ball.
hook: The sound-muffling concept is evocative and spooky in a cosy way — the glacier going silent around you.

name: Hushbore
concept: A mid-sized burrowing rodent with thickened ice-plated shoulder pads from tunnelling through frozen earth. The silence aura has intensified — within a short radius, even battle cries and ability sounds are absorbed. It uses this quiet as both hunting cover and territory defence.
visual: Stout, compact rodent; broad shoulders covered in layered ice-plate armour; long digging claws with ice-crystal edges; flattened wide head; small round eyes; a side-profile silhouette with strong armour shapes readable at 40px.
hook: The ice-armour shoulder transformation makes the 'quiet predator' concept click into an intimidating mid-form.

name: Stillwarden
concept: A massive glacier-burrower whose silence aura has expanded to blanket entire cave systems. Its back has erupted into a ridge of obsidian-black ice spurs. Where Stillwarden rests, no sound exists — not wind, not water, not other kin. Hushfrost Pass travellers whisper that silence means it is near.
visual: Large, powerfully built rodent body; spinal ridge of black ice-crystal spurs along the back; thick neck, wide flat head with deep-set ice-pale eyes; slate-dark colouration on the upper body, pale beneath; silhouette dominated by the spine ridge at 48px.
signature_idea: Deadsilence — a Dark/Frost status move that prevents the target using sound-based or vocal moves for 3 turns
hook: The transition from cute snow-vole to something that makes silence feel ominous is a perfect awe-curve story.

name: Chillpip
concept: A plump little snow-chick with a soft fluff coat of powder-white down. The ice crystals in its down scatter light into tiny rainbows. It tumbles more than walks and cannot yet fly, but its cheerful chirping keeps glacier travellers' spirits up.
visual: Round, egg-shaped chick body; big round head with a tiny curved beak; oversized fluffy wings it can't quite fold correctly; powder-white with a pale sky-blue belly; crystal glints in the down; one of the roundest, chubbiest silhouettes in the roster at 32px.
hook: Maximum chick-fluff energy — the crystal-scatter rainbow detail is a small treasure that rewards close attention.

name: Crystarn
concept: A half-grown snow-bird that has shed its chick-fluff for proper iridescent feathers underlaid with tiny ice-crystal filaments. It can now fly, and its wingbeats scatter prismatic ice-dust. Flocks of Crystarn spiral above the glacier in breathtaking chevrons.
visual: Medium bird form; streamlined body with swept-back tail feathers tipped in crystal points; feathers shaded blue-white to silver; wing edges fringed with tiny icicle spurs; alert amber eye with a diamond highlight; clean aerodynamic silhouette at 40px.
hook: The transformation from helpless chick-ball to elegant crystal-feathered flier is the core kindling-joy moment.

name: Glacitern
concept: A fully matured blizzard-tern of startling size. Its wings generate localised ice-laced gales, and it dives at speed to shatter thin ice with its crystallised bill. Glacier pilots say Glacitern dives are visible from three valleys away — a diving streak of white and blue lightning.
visual: Large seabird-inspired form; sharply swept wings with serrated trailing-edge icicle spurs; elongated blade-like bill crackling with frost and static; body sleek from head to forked tail; blue-grey body, white underside, lightning-blue wing tips; fierce predator silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Icestrike Dive — a priority physical move that does bonus damage to grounded targets
hook: The evolution from round snow-chick to diving blizzard predator spans the full emotional register of creature design.

name: Brineglace
concept: A small ice-seal pup whose coat is partially translucent, showing the veins of cold sea-water running through its body. It rests on glacier shelf-ice and warbles a low, resonant call that can be heard beneath the glacier ice. Fishers near Pale Vault consider its call a weather omen.
visual: Rounded, chubby seal-pup form; semi-translucent pale-blue hide with visible dark water-vein traceries; wide, watery dark eyes; stubby fore-flippers; a compact ice-shelf blob silhouette reads perfectly at 32px.
hook: The translucent-body-with-visible-currents visual is immediately distinctive and slightly mysterious.

name: Glacseal
concept: A fully grown cold-water glacier seal. The water-vein translucency has resolved into layered ice-plate armour over a powerful body. It hunts beneath the glacier shelf by breathing through ice-bored holes. Its low resonant call can actually slow the heartrate of nearby creatures.
visual: Substantial seal body; upper torso armoured in overlapping pale ice-plate scales over translucent skin; strong fore-flippers with hooked claws; a broad whiskered head with frost-crystal whisker tips; clearly larger and more imposing at 48px.
signature_idea: Halocall — a special-type Tide/Frost move that lowers the target's special attack through resonant frequency
hook: The armoured glacier-seal with resonant-slowing call makes for a distinctive and thematically rich wall archetype.

name: Geolace
concept: A small, crystalline geode-crab whose outer shell is a natural geode split down the middle, exposing a cavity glittering with frost-crystal druzy. It scuttles along glacier crevasse walls and eats mineral-rich ice. Its shell grows a new layer of crystals each winter.
visual: Squat crab-like form; body is literally a split geode half — rough dark mineral exterior with a spectacular glittering interior visible from above; six short spiky legs; two crystal-tipped pincer claws; unique silhouette readable at 32px as a lumpy oval with jutting points.
hook: A geode as a crab-shell is visually unlike anything else — the glittering interior is a treasure chest on legs.

name: Geodrake
concept: A mid-sized geode-armoured crustacean that has grown additional crystal growths along its carapace. The crystals serve as both armour and weapon — Geodrake can launch crystal shards by flexing its shell. Deep glacier miners warn that Geodrake territories are marked by shattered walls.
visual: Wider, heavier crustacean form; carapace now densely covered in faceted crystal protrusions in purple-to-ice-blue; thicker claws tipped with drill-point crystal spires; mid-form still crablike but clearly larger and more weaponised at 40px.
hook: The growing crystal-armour escalation makes each stage feel like an upgrade.

name: Vaultclaw
concept: A colossal glacier-hermit whose geode shell has become a literal ice-cave it carries. The crystal interior is now large enough to shelter small kin in blizzards — some say Frostkit families nest inside willing Vaultclaw shells. Its claws can carve new passages through glacier ice.
visual: Large, powerful crustacean body; the carapace is now a massive dome of geode and ice-crystal formations, towering above the body; huge armoured claws; a walking glacier-cave silhouette — dramatic and distinctive at 48px, dominated by the crystal dome above.
signature_idea: Geovault — a Stone/Frost physical move that also raises the user's defence as crystal armour hardens further
hook: A walking crystal cave that shelters other kin — the ecological and visual storytelling is irresistible.

name: Rimpling
concept: A tiny icicle-bat that roosts in glacier cave ceilings in dense clusters. Its wings are thin membranes laced with ice-crystal veins. When startled, it emits a high-pitched crystalline shriek that freezes moisture in the air into a burst of ice-shards.
visual: Small bat form; thin wing membranes with visible angular crystal-vein patterning; large round ears with pointed crystal tips; tiny stub body almost invisible between the wings; a wide-winged hanging silhouette at 32px.
hook: Crystal-veined bat wings are visually striking and the shriek-freeze concept ties flavour perfectly to a status role.

name: Shardwing
concept: A large blizzard-bat whose ice-crystal wing veins have grown into pronounced jagged spurs along the leading edge. It flies through storm clouds, harvesting static electricity into the crystal spurs, then discharges blasts of frozen lightning. Glacier caves near Hushfrost Pass crackle with its passing.
visual: Large bat with a wide, angular wingspan; leading edges of wings lined with serrated crystal-lightning spurs; a broad, flat head with multi-pointed crystal ear-fans; body dark blue-grey; wing veins glow faintly gold-blue with stored charge; imposing at 48px.
signature_idea: Crystarc — a Storm/Frost special move that can paralyse on contact
hook: The bat-that-harvests-lightning concept bridges Storm and Frost beautifully; it lives in the narrow space between the two biomes.

name: Snowcune
concept: A playful little snow-hare with oversized feet perfect for bounding across deep powder. Its fur coat is two layers: the outer is a coarse frost-white that repels snow, and the inner radiates a faint warmth. It moves in bounding arcs, always landing softly, leaving only the faintest impressions.
visual: Classic hare silhouette; very large hind feet, long upright ears with pale icy tips; powder-white fur with a subtle blue-grey shadow tone; round body, small face with a tiny dark nose; speed-suggesting long-legged pose at 32px.
hook: The oversized snow-hare feet are immediately charming; the dual-coat detail rewards a player who reads the dex entry.

name: Blizzrhare
concept: A mid-form hare that has shed its soft pup-coat for sleek winter fur hardened into wind-channelling ridges. It runs so fast it generates a localised snow-vortex around itself. Pale Vault villagers call these small spinning snow-devils 'hare-ghosts.'
visual: Taller, leaner hare form; fur now has aerodynamic ridge-lines down the flanks; elongated ears swept back; narrow, aerodynamic face; the overall silhouette reads like a sprinter frozen at the instant of launch at 40px.
hook: The hare-ghost snow-vortex detail is the kind of world-building kids pass on to friends.

name: Vortexlope
concept: A blizzard-speed hare of remarkable size whose constant motion generates a persistent personal blizzard. It never truly stops moving — even resting, it trembles with contained velocity. When it runs at full speed the snow-vortex behind it is visible for kilometres. The fastest kin native to the north.
visual: Tall, long-limbed, powerful hare; fur has crystallised into blade-like ridge-plates along the entire back and limbs; swept-back ears now rigid and tapered like antennae; a trailing blizzard-halo always swirls behind it; dynamic forward-leaning pose at 48px.
signature_idea: Blizzardbreak — the highest-speed-tier Frost special attack, power scales with the user's speed advantage over the target
hook: The glass-cannon blizzard-hare is an archetype-fulfilling powerhouse with strong visual storytelling in its silhouette alone.

name: Pellice
concept: A small frost-fox cub with an exceptionally fluffy tail that it wraps around itself as insulation. Unlike Frostkit, it is calmer and more deliberate — it walks slowly, thinks carefully, and rarely panics. Glacier farmers keep Pellice families near food stores to prevent ice-rot.
visual: Small, round-bodied cub with a proportionally enormous bushy tail; coat in deep cream-to-pale-amber shading; ice-crystal bead markings along the tail; a distinctive side-profile silhouette dominated by the tail circle at 32px.
hook: The massive tail as defining feature and the calm personality differentiate it completely from Frostkit's dash-energy.

name: Hoarfen
concept: A graceful, moonlit frost-fox whose fur has taken on a spectral silver luminosity under the long dusk sky. It is nocturnal by preference, hunting by moonlight reflected off glaciers. Pale Vault astronomers note that Hoarfen activity patterns track the lunar cycle with uncanny precision.
visual: Slender, elegant fox silhouette; fur is deep silver-white with a faint inner luminescence, as if lit from within by cold moonlight; the large tail now has trailing phantom wisps at the edges; eyes are pale silver; a ghostly, beautiful profile at 48px.
signature_idea: Moonhoar — a Lunar/Frost special move that lowers the target's special defence under the effect of a moon-chill
hook: The transition from warm cub to spectral moonlit fox is one of the most evocative kindling transformations in the roster.

name: Tundrik
concept: A compact, wide-shouldered frost-bear cub with stubby crystal-tipped claws. Its fur is thick enough to insulate against the deepest glacier cold — it actively seeks the coldest spots on the glacier to nap. Pale Vault children sometimes use sleeping Tundrik cubs as impromptu stools.
visual: Very wide, low-slung bear cub silhouette; thick layered fur coat in mottled ice-blue and cream; tiny round ears; flat wide face with a permanent serious expression offset by a chubby body; crystal-claw tips; the wide-shoulders-tiny-ears combo is immediately recognisable at 32px.
hook: The contrast between the serious expression and the ridiculous chubbiness is classic creature-design comedy.

name: Permafrost
concept: A massive glacier-bear whose fur has been compressed by decades of extreme cold into a solid ice-plate coat. The name is what glacier folk just call them — 'the permafrost' — not as a category but because each one seems to have been there forever. It walks through blizzards without appearing to notice.
visual: Enormous bear form; upper body encased in fused ice-plate armour of layered blues and whites; the fur visible at the belly and paws is still thick and cream-coloured; small, deeply set eyes under a heavy ice-plated brow; a powerful, immovable silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Icecrusher — a high-power physical Frost move with a chance to lower the target's defence
hook: The kindled-into-armour concept is a clean visual story: the cub who slept in cold becomes armour itself.

name: Lenticle
concept: A translucent ice-jelly the size of a fist that drifts on glacier updrafts. Its bell-cap is a perfect lens of pure ice that focuses starlight into a concentrated warm point beneath it — a tiny walking magnifying glass. Children in Pale Vault are warned not to stare at one too long.
visual: Small dome-jellyfish body of crystal-clear ice; tentacles short and trailing, tipped with tiny crystalline weights; the domed cap catches and refracts any available light into scattered prismatic beams; almost invisible against a bright background — a ghost at 32px.
hook: A drifting lens of pure ice that focuses starlight — perfectly weird and Vesperholm-authentic.

name: Prismrift
concept: A mid-growth aurora-jelly that has developed a more complex lens-body — multiple ice-prism lobes that each bend light differently. In still air it creates a small aurora-display directly around itself, a personal light show. It can direct these prismatic bursts offensively.
visual: Larger, multi-lobed jelly form; body now has three stacked dome-prisms of slightly different sizes; long trailing ribbon-tentacles in soft aurora colours; the combined multi-prism silhouette is deeply alien and beautiful at 40px.
hook: Multi-prism stacked-dome body is visually unlike anything else — a kinematic art-brief gift.

name: Crystaveil
concept: A legendary-tier aurora-jelly of immense prism complexity. Its body spans several metres of stacked ice-crystal lobes, and the aurora display it generates is indistinguishable from the real sky phenomenon to a distant observer. Aurora Hollow is named for the first recorded Crystaveil sighting — locals thought the aurora had come down to the ground.
visual: Vast, billowing jelly with a towering stack of ice-crystal prisms; trailing tentacles each metres long in aurora-colour gradients; the whole form emits a soft constant aurora-shimmer; at 48px it dominates the frame, a cathedral of refracted light.
signature_idea: Prismafall — a Light/Frost special move that simultaneously lowers target's special defence and confuses; the aurora display makes it impossible to look directly at the user
hook: Aurora Hollow's namesake. Finding one is a player story in itself — a boss-tier presence hiding in a northern spur.

name: Niblatch
concept: A squat, wide-bellied toad-like creature that sits motionless in snow drifts, camouflaged as a lump of ice. It exhales a fine mist that reduces the temperature of surrounding air. Glacier guides learn to distinguish Niblatch from actual ice by the faint rattle of its breathing.
visual: Very squat, flat amphibian form; pale blue-grey warty hide that mimics snow-ice surface texture; wide flat head, large downturned mouth, small gold eyes almost level with the top of the head; crouched into a lump that barely reads as alive at 32px — the camouflage is the joke.
hook: The living-lump-of-ice gag is immediately funny; the mist-cooling ability is quietly terrifying once you understand the implications.

name: Glacigroth
concept: A large, ancient toad-creature that has been sitting in the same glacier stream for so long it has partially merged with the ice around it. Glacier ice grows over and through its body; when it moves, it takes some of the ice with it. It breathes a persistent frost-fog that coats surfaces in slick ice.
visual: Massive, sprawling toad body; large sections of the back and flanks are encrusted in glacier ice growths, giving it a half-fossil appearance; pale river-blue hide visible between ice patches; the overall silhouette at 48px reads as something between a living creature and a glacial boulder.
signature_idea: Frostbreath — a Tide/Frost status move that coats the field in ice-slick, lowering speed of all grounded kin for 3 turns
hook: The 'partially merged with the glacier' concept is profoundly strange and ancient-feeling — it feels like a discovery, not an encounter.

name: Crestridge
concept: A stocky crystal-deer fawn whose antler nubs are already developing into ice-mineral formations. It grazes on mineral-rich glacier ice, digesting the stone content to reinforce its own body. Even as a fawn, tapping its hide produces a dull minerallic knock.
visual: Neat, compact deer-fawn proportions; hide in deep slate-blue with stone-grey dappling; visible minerallic antler nubs gleaming at the brow; legs end in solid stone-hoof stumps rather than cloven hooves; the mineral-hardness reads even at 32px.
hook: A fawn whose bones are literally becoming stone — the visual promise of what it kindles into is visible from the first glance.

name: Glacistag
concept: A fully grown crystal-mineral stag of extraordinary stillness. Its antlers are elaborate mineral-crystal formations rivalling the glacier formations around it — cartographers sometimes mistake a standing Glacistag for a new ice formation. Pale Vault hunters say you cannot chase one; you can only wait for it to stand in your path.
visual: Tall, stately stag with a powerful chest and hindquarters; hide fully mineralised in layered grey-blue stone-ice composite; massive multi-point antlers of interleaved crystal and mineral, each point a different length and formation; a monument-like silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Ironglacier — a Stone/Frost physical move that also raises the user's defence
hook: A stag so still it gets mistaken for a glacier formation is a perfect piece of Vesperholm ecological world-building.

name: Coldwisp
concept: A drifting hush-wraith of condensed cold light — not truly a physical creature, but a sustained luminous cold-air vortex that has developed awareness. It guides travellers lost in glacier fog by hovering at the limit of visibility, just bright enough to follow.
visual: Small, loose orb form of swirling cold-light motes; a vaguely face-shaped brighter concentration at the centre; trailing wisp-threads of dim aurora-pale light; floats slightly above any surface; soft and slightly sad-looking even at 32px.
hook: The wraith-that-guides-you-home concept is deeply cosy and lore-rich; it ties directly to the 'lanterns in the dark' emotional register.

name: Glacewraith
concept: A fully manifested cold-light wraith of significant presence. What was a gentle guide has become something vast and cold. It no longer leads travellers — it stands between them and the dark, and anything hostile to those under its protection finds the temperature around it dropping sharply. Pale Vault storm-watchers consider a Glacewraith sighting a blessing.
visual: Larger, more defined form; a sweeping cloak-like mass of cold-light mist with a luminous core; a distinct ghostly face with two pale-bright eyes; the cloak-mass trails behind it like a comet; elegant and slightly imposing at 48px.
signature_idea: Coldguard — a Frost/Light special move that simultaneously damages and raises the user's special defence
hook: The protective wraith guardian with a comet-cloak silhouette feels like the north's spiritual guardian — deeply Vesperholm.

name: Blizzowl
concept: A stocky frost-owl with a rounded facial disc of ice-crystal feathers that functions as a natural parabolic dish — amplifying sounds across vast glacier distances. It sits motionless for hours, listening to sounds reflected off glacier walls kilometres away.
visual: Classic round-headed owl form; facial disc of concentric ice-crystal feather rings that subtly reflect light; thick body feathers in layered white-blue; large, deeply-set amber eyes; short talon-feet gripping ice ledges; a calm, watchful silhouette at 32px.
hook: The parabolic ice-dish face as a listening device is a genuine piece of biological wonder-design.

name: Glaciowl
concept: A massive frost-owl whose ice-crystal facial disc has expanded into an elaborate full-face mirror of layered prisms that reflect moonlight across the glacier. It hunts entirely by the reflected sound of the moon's gravitational pull on glacial ice — a method so arcane that researchers debate whether it actually works, yet the Glaciowl always finds its prey.
visual: Large, imposing owl; the facial disc is now an enormous elaborate mirror-disc of layered moon-reflecting crystal prisms, almost as wide as the body; long, broad wings in deep blue-grey with white-barred undersides; a regal, commanding pose at 48px, the disc dominating.
signature_idea: Moonecho — a Lunar/Frost special move that sends a reflected sonic pulse dealing delayed damage on the target's next action
hook: The hunt-by-moon-tide-acoustics concept is the kind of outrageous dex-entry claim kids will argue about for years.

name: Pulseice
concept: A squat, crystalline urchin-like creature that generates static electricity by rotating its internal ice-crystal spine arrays. It rolls across glacier flats, leaving sparking trails in the ice behind it, and crackles dangerously when startled.
visual: Spherical form completely covered in short, radiating crystal-static spines; the spines crackle with faint blue-gold arcs; a single large eye visible between spine clusters; rolls rather than walks; reads as a bristling electric snowball at 32px.
hook: A rolling electric ice-urchin is exactly the kind of 'wait, what is that' moment that makes exploration thrilling.

name: Tempestcrust
concept: A fully grown blizzard-urchin whose crystal spines have grown to considerable length and now arc visibly between them in constant discharge. It floats above the glacier surface on an electromagnetic cushion generated by its own storm-ice field, and its approach is heralded by all metal objects in the vicinity vibrating.
visual: Larger spherical form; the spines are now long, elaborate crystal rods crackling with continuous multi-arc lightning between them; the electromagnetic float lifts it a few centimetres off any surface; the single eye now has a lightning-slit pupil; a dramatic bristling sphere at 48px.
signature_idea: Tempestspine — a Storm/Frost special attack that also damages any kin switching in for 2 turns from the field-static
hook: The concept of hovering on its own electromagnetic field is quietly magnificent — the approaching-vibration-of-metal detail is genuinely scary.

name: Iceling
concept: A small, round ice-sprite no bigger than a fist that forms spontaneously wherever glacier ice meets air in a specific temperature band. It bounces off ice surfaces playfully, and its body is technically just very sophisticated ice — though Pale Vault philosophers debate this warmly over tea.
visual: Tiny, perfectly round body of translucent blue-white ice; a simple expressive face of two dark eyes and a small curved mouth pressed into the ice surface; stubby arms and legs of solid ice protrusions; bounces on the bottom like a rubber ball; the quintessential sprite form at 32px.
hook: The philosophical question of whether it's a kin or just very ambitious ice is the perfect dex-entry hook.

name: Glaceling
concept: A more developed ice-sprite that has gathered enough ambient ice to give itself a more defined, humanoid shape. It still bounces on rounded feet, but now manifests ice structures around itself — walls, bridges, steps — apparently decorating its territory. The structures always collapse after a day.
visual: Slightly taller, more defined sprite form; a distinct head on a short neck, arms with three-fingered ice hands; face is more expressive and detailed; occasionally surrounded by small floating ice-crystal fragments it is sculpting; mid-ground presence at 40px.
hook: The ice-sculpting-territory-decoration behaviour makes it feel like a small, weird artist — immediately lovable.

name: Frostholm
concept: The apex form of the ice-sprite lineage — a vast, ancient glacier-golem that has accumulated centuries of ice, starlight, and aurora-glow into a self-aware glacier monument. Frostholm is the living embodiment of the Pale Vault itself; legends say the glacier exists because Frostholm chose to sleep there, and it dreams the aurora into being. It is the Frost Constellation Warden — the Aurora Hollow's true guardian.
visual: Towering, broad-shouldered golem form sculpted from ancient blue-white glacial ice; its surface etched with centuries of swirling aurora-pattern carvings; the face is serene, simple, and impossibly old; aurora-light leaks from the carved lines across its body; at 48px it fills the frame completely, a walking glacier-face.
signature_idea: Aurora Sanctum — a Light/Frost special move that raises both the user's special defence and special attack and launches an aurora-wave dealing moderate damage to all opponents
hook: The Frost Constellation Warden — the glacier guardian that dreams the aurora. Finding it in Aurora Hollow is the north's equivalent of the story's whole promise.

name: Sunsprout
concept: A compact sun-flower bulb kin that drifted into the Sunken Solarium long ago and absorbed stored daylight through its roots, giving its petals a warm inner glow even in perpetual dusk.
visual: Squat round green bulb body, four petals splayed around an amber-glowing centre disc, tiny leafy feet; warm gold halo at the petal tips; reads as a bright flower silhouette at 32px.
hook: A cheerful sun-petal kin glowing from the inside — the first Solar kin a player will meet, and it feels like holding a tiny lantern.

name: Solvyne
concept: A tall vine-wreathed sun-fae whose open flower-crown channels stored daylight into its spiral tendrils, healing wounds with warm radiance.
visual: Slender humanoid silhouette wrapped in glowing vines; broad open sunflower crown framing the face; amber-gold light streams from the petal edges; reads as a confident mid-stage at 48px.
hook: It tends to wounded kin in the Solarium ruins like a guardian — an ally that glows warmer the more it trusts you.

name: Auravane
concept: A great solar-vine sovereign whose canopy of golden petals releases stored daylight in wide solar pulses, sustaining the last living flora of the Sunken Solarium.
visual: Large, stately kin with a thick trunk-like lower body anchored by root-feet; eight grand petals fan outward like a sun-disc crown, each veined with liquid gold light; dominant, warm silhouette at 64px.
signature_idea: Solar Bloom — releases a pulse of stored light that heals self and chips all foes with Solar damage
hook: The undisputed caretaker of the Solarium — a radiant tree-creature that makes every battle feel like fighting a living sunrise.

name: Glentide
concept: A warm-water koi whose scales hold refracted stored daylight from swimming through the sunlit flooded halls of the Sunken Solarium, making its body shimmer like sunlight on water.
visual: Elegant koi fish silhouette; scales flash amber and gold against a teal body; trailing fins lit at the edges like diffused sunbeams; clean, readable at 40px.
hook: A living shard of sunlight on water — watching it move in the dark ruins feels like remembering summer.

name: Glenveil
concept: A grand solar koi that has grown vast in the Solarium's flooded arches, its body now acting as a lens that focuses stored daylight into blinding beams when it surfaces.
visual: Long, majestic koi with a body spanning two screen widths; trailing double-tail fans wide; dorsal fin rises like a sun crest; entire flanks glow gold-white at the edges; commands the space at 64px.
signature_idea: Prism Surge — water-lens move that deals Solar + Tide damage in one burst
hook: The Solarium's living treasure — a fish the size of a door made entirely of sunlit water, awe-inducing on first sight.

name: Helibud
concept: A rolling solar-seed that bounced free of the Solarium's golden arches; it spins constantly to charge itself with stored daylight, emitting a faint hum and a warm amber glow.
visual: Smooth orb-shaped kin, deep amber with eight radial sun-ray notches carved around its equator; two small leaf-wing nubs; single glowing eye; reads cleanly as a spinning ball at 32px.
hook: Endlessly spinning and humming with stored warmth — a living solar toy kids will want to roll everywhere.

name: Helicore
concept: A solar orb kin that has cracked open slightly to reveal a molten amber core; the spinning has accelerated so much that it now hovers just above the ground, leaving a faint scorch ring where it rests.
visual: Slightly larger orb with a glowing fracture line around the equator revealing golden inner light; a halo of heat distortion shimmers above it; sun-ray notches are now clearly defined ridges; bold at 48px.
hook: A spinning engine of stored sunlight on the verge of breaking open — it feels genuinely powerful and a little dangerous.

name: Helithorn
concept: The fully awakened solar apex — the outer shell has burst open into a ring of eight radiant thorn-spokes orbiting a blazing amber core, discharging stored daylight in flares that scorch the air around it.
visual: Central blazing amber sphere orbited by eight angled spike-shards like a sun diagram; the whole assembly rotates slowly; corona of golden light bleeds outward; unmistakable, awe-defining at 64px.
signature_idea: Sunburst Crown — charges one turn then releases all stored light in a radial explosion hitting every foe
hook: The most purely Solar thing in the dex — a miniature sun wearing its own corona, rotating in midair. Jaw-dropping on first encounter.

name: Gilpaw
concept: A small leonine cub whose coat has mineralised into gilded stone plates, soaking up ambient Solar energy from the Solarium's ruins. It naps in sun-warmed arches and radiates stored heat.
visual: Compact lion-cub silhouette; body covered in smooth gold-toned stone plates like overlapping scales; four stubby paws with amber glowing pawpads; round face with bright amber eyes; cute and sturdy at 32px.
hook: A golden armoured cub — solid, warm, and endearing, like a sun-kissed statue that decided to yawn.

name: Goldmane
concept: A gilded stone lion whose mane has erupted into a crown of solar-flare spines; it stores massive amounts of daylight in its dense mineral body and releases it in searing physical charges.
visual: Large, imposing lion silhouette with a barrel chest; mane replaced by radiant gold-stone spines fanning outward like sun rays; body plates carved with spiral solar motifs; heavy paws leave glowing prints; dramatic at 64px.
signature_idea: Solarite Charge — physical Solar move that scales with the user's Defense stat
hook: A gilded stone lion whose mane is made of sunlight — the apex predator of the Solarium, and unmistakably a trophy.

name: Solray
concept: A flat, disc-shaped solar ray-fish that drifts through the Solarium's flooded halls like a living sunbeam, its body fully translucent except for a golden radial pattern of stored-light cells.
visual: Flat circular body, translucent amber with a golden starburst vein-pattern at the centre; six thin trailing rays fanning back like a sun's corona; floats serenely; elegant at 40px.
hook: A solar ray floating in dark water like a living stained-glass window — beautiful and alien.

name: Solreach
concept: A vast solar disc-ray that has doubled in size and brightness, now trailing twelve long luminous rays that each end in a focused point of concentrated daylight capable of cutting stone.
