visual: Wide disc silhouette, now with a visible central eye that pulses golden; twelve long ray-trails fan out in all directions, each tipped with a bright point; at 64px it fills the frame like a living sun glyph.
signature_idea: Ray Convergence — twelve rays briefly merge into a single concentrated beam for massive Solar damage
hook: A creature shaped exactly like the sun — ancient, enormous, and utterly unmatched in the flooded dark.

name: Mirrorfly
concept: A small beetle-like kin whose entire dorsal shell is a polished mirror-plate; it reflects and redirects stored Solar light to dazzle opponents and scout routes through dark ruins.
visual: Compact beetle silhouette; smooth dome-like upper body is a gleaming mirror with a gold rim; six segmented legs; two antennae tipped with tiny amber gems; reads as a silver disc on legs at 32px.
hook: A living periscope made of sunlight — a clever little trickster who uses its mirror body to blind and redirect.

name: Glintshell
concept: A large mirror-carapace beetle whose shell has grown into multiple angled panels, each precisely positioned to concentrate reflected Solar light into blinding focal points and confuse enemies completely.
visual: Broad beetle silhouette with a multi-faceted segmented shell of mirror-bright amber-gold panels; compound eyes glow; wings fold beneath, visible as a thin gold border; imposing and geometrically striking at 64px.
signature_idea: Mirror Field — sets a reflective hazard that bounces status effects back at the attacker for 3 turns
hook: A walking solar mirror array — equal parts beautiful and infuriating in battle, the ultimate status-game disruptor.

name: Dawnfawn
concept: A young sun-stag fawn whose antler stubs are flowering sun-vine shoots; it drinks stored daylight through the vines and runs so fast it leaves a brief trail of golden motes on the overgrown Sunvault Climb terraces.
visual: Slender fawn silhouette; cream-gold coat with amber dappling; two short antler stubs sprouting bright yellow sun-flowers; four long sprinting legs; tail is a tuft of glowing seedfluff; lively and leggy at 40px.
hook: A golden fawn trailing flower-petals as it runs — fleet-footed, joyful, and impossible not to chase.

name: Sunstag
concept: A great dawn-stag with a full crown of antlers wreathed in blooming sun-vine flowers; each tine blazes with stored Solar energy, and its passage across the terraces floods the path with warm golden light.
visual: Tall, proud stag silhouette; twelve-point antler crown flowering at every tip with radiant amber blooms; broad chest, powerful haunches; coat shifts from deep amber at the hooves to pale gold at the neck; commanding at 64px.
signature_idea: Crown Gallop — Physical Solar/Verdant combo charge that deals both type damage and scatters healing petals
hook: A magnificent blazing stag with antlers in full flower — the single most impressive creature on the Sunvault Climb, an instant collector's trophy.

name: Flarepuff
concept: A small round flare-drake hatchling that stores Solar heat in the sacs along its spine; when frightened it releases tiny bursts of stored sunfire — more flash than fury, but still stings.
visual: Round, squat lizard-like body; six glowing amber dorsal sacs in a row; short tail with a bright ember tip; wide golden eyes with slit pupils; stumpy limbs; reads as a cute spiky ball at 32px.
hook: A baby flare-drake that sneezes sunfire — too small to be scary but impossible to stop collecting.

name: Solarex
concept: A lean, wing-folded flare-drake that has mastered the art of compressing stored Solar energy into intense focused bursts; its spine sacs are now pressure vessels that blast jets of concentrated sunfire on command.
visual: Lean reptile silhouette; six sacs along the spine have grown to glowing orbs; folded wings tipped with ember-gold; elongated neck; clawed feet planted wide; the whole body reads as coiled energy ready to release at 64px.
signature_idea: Flare Jet — fires a sustained beam of Solar+Ember energy from the spine sacs, ignoring partial type resistances
hook: A dragon that fires sunbeams instead of fire — distinctly Solar, genuinely threatening, a late-game prize.

name: Auroling
concept: A small daylight-sprite resembling a compressed sunbeam given form; it drifts through the Sunken Solarium's archways leaving brief afterimages of itself as it flits between pools of stored-light glow.
visual: Small, wisp-like figure with a round bright core and four trailing light-ribbon limbs; alternating gold and pale-white hues; eyes are two warm amber dots; simple but luminous silhouette at 32px.
hook: A tiny piece of daylight that got lost and made a body — ethereal, wandering, and quietly magical.

name: Auroveil
concept: A mature daylight-sprite that has grown into a shimmering veil of pure Solar radiance; it drapes itself over allies in battle to absorb incoming energy, converting darkness into stored light.
visual: Tall gossamer figure; body is a flowing layered veil of translucent gold-white light; face is a serene sun-oval with closed crescent eyes; edge of the veil shimmers with dispersing photon-sparks; elegant and protective at 64px.
signature_idea: Light Veil — reduces all special damage dealt to the active kin for 5 turns
hook: Wrapping yourself in sunlight made solid — a sentinel of pure radiance that makes battle feel sacred.

name: Cindlark
concept: A swift sun-bird that harnesses the atmospheric clash between stored Solar warmth and rising storm-air along the Sunvault Climb terraces, crackling with static even as it basks in warm golden light.
visual: Streamlined bird silhouette; amber-golden feathers shading to electric blue at the wingtips and tail; two prominent crest feathers arcing backward; crackle-line markings on the wings; fast silhouette at 40px.
hook: A solar bird flickering between gold and blue — the thrill of a stormy sky meeting a warm afternoon in one creature.

name: Voltflare
concept: A large raptor-form sun-bird that has fully merged its Solar and Storm energies; its wings release continuous sheets of solar-charged lightning and it screeches with a sound like sunlight breaking through storm clouds.
visual: Broad-winged raptor silhouette; primary feathers glow amber at the base, crackle into blue-white arcs at the tips; golden eye above a sharp beak; tail fans wide showing alternating solar-gold and lightning-blue bands; imposing at 64px.
signature_idea: Thunderblaze — Solar+Storm dual special move that deals both type damage on a single hit
hook: A raptor born where the sun meets the storm — dramatic, charged, and absolutely unstoppable looking.

name: Warmcoil
concept: A serpentine kin that glides through the warm flooded halls of the Solarium, its scales acting as solar cells that heat the surrounding water and confuse navigating creatures with warm-current eddies.
visual: Long, sinuous water-snake silhouette; pale teal scales with amber-gold hexagonal pattern on the dorsal side; head fanned by two flat gill-fins; tail tapers to a glowing amber point; graceful at 40px.
hook: A solar serpent in warm water — languid, beautiful, and quietly dangerous like a current you didn't notice until it pulled you.

name: Solarcoil
concept: A vast solar-water serpent that has become the dominant presence in the Solarium's deepest flooded vault; it controls temperature currents to drain opponents of energy while radiating stored warmth like an underwater sun.
visual: Massive serpent silhouette that curves across the full battle frame; deep teal body with a full dorsal ridge of bright amber solar plates; wide flat head framed by large gill-fans; eyes glow warm gold; effortlessly huge at 64px.
signature_idea: Thermocline — raises the battlefield temperature, dealing Solar chip damage each turn and reducing foe Speed
hook: An enormous sun-warmed sea serpent that owns the Solarium's flooded depths — a collector's end-game treasure and a battle puzzle.

name: Solpillar
concept: A cylindrical sun-disc jelly that floats upright in the Solarium's illuminated water columns, absorbing stored daylight through its translucent body and releasing concentric radial pulses that ward off predators.
visual: Tall cylindrical translucent jellyfish silhouette; central column glows deep amber; nine horizontal disc-rings of decreasing opacity float around the body; bell-crown at the top with short fringe tentacles; unusual, serene at 48px.
signature_idea: Solar Pulse — radial damage that also reduces foe Attack for one turn
hook: A tower of sunlit water stacked in rings — utterly unlike anything else in the dex and weirdly calming to look at.

name: Crownore
concept: A slow-moving gilded ore-golem that crystallised around a core of concentrated stored daylight; its stone body glows with warm internal light and it is nearly impervious to physical assault.
visual: Squat, broad boulder-like golem silhouette; body is dark stone shot through with veins of molten amber; flat face with two deep gold-glowing eye pockets; four thick limb-stubs; immovable and radiant at 48px.
hook: A living geode stuffed with daylight — impossibly heavy, impossibly tough, and glowing warm gold from within.

name: Lumflect
concept: A flat-bodied mirror-fae that skates along the surface of the Solarium's flooded floors, using its reflective form to bounce and redirect stored daylight to illuminate hidden passages for those it trusts.
visual: Flat diamond-shaped body with a mirrored silver-gold surface; four short skating-limbs; head is a small oval with brilliant white-gold eyes; two thin antennae ending in gem-tips; fast, low silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Redirect — reflects the next incoming status move back at the attacker
hook: A living mirror that guides you through the dark ruins by bouncing light around corners — a scouting companion that also hits hard.

name: Helixia
concept: The Helia Vault's guardian: a great solar apex kin shaped like a living orrery, its body a central amber core ringed by three concentric hoops of golden light that rotate at different speeds, releasing precision solar lances.
visual: Spherical amber core roughly lion-headed, with three glowing golden rings orbiting at different angles (like an armillary sphere); each ring is studded with small radiant nodes; the whole structure rotates; breathtaking at 64px.
signature_idea: Orrery Lance — fires a targeted beam from each ring simultaneously, three hits of Solar damage in one turn
hook: A living golden armillary sphere — the awe-pinnacle of the Solar type and the centrepiece of Helia Vault. Nothing else in the dex looks anything like it.

name: Flicket
concept: A darting golden lizard that uses its mirrored scales to flash stored Solar energy at rivals in brief dazzling bursts; it is the fastest thing in the Solarium and loves to steal warm resting spots.
visual: Slim gecko-like lizard; scales are tiny gold mirror facets; wide flat head; four sprinting legs; long flat tail; a golden flush gleams differently depending on the angle of viewing at 32px.
hook: A golden flicker of a gecko — blink and it's gone, and it's stolen your sun-spot while you looked away.

name: Blazecrest
concept: A large, swift solar monitor that has grown a bony head-crest of solar-capacitor ridges; when it sprints the crest glows white-hot with released daylight and it can blind foes with a snap of stored flare.
visual: Long, low-slung monitor silhouette; bony solar-ridge crest from snout to neck tip; gold-pale body with a network of amber veins; thick powerful tail; wide splay-legged stance; fast and impressive at 48px.
hook: A solar monitor lizard whose head crest glows white-hot when it charges — beautiful, predatory, and clearly faster than you.

name: Solspore
concept: A solar seed-sprite that rides warm air currents in the Sunvault Climb, releasing drifting spores that carry tiny charges of stored daylight; the spores stick to opponents and slowly drain their energy.
visual: Small round seed-body with four fluffy parachute tufts at the top, each tuft tipped in amber gold; tiny trailing root-legs below; seed coat is pale green-gold; floaty and delicate at 32px.
hook: A floating solar dandelion clock — deceptively dainty and impossible not to love, but those spores are a nuisance in battle.

name: Heliarch
concept: A tall sun-tree fae that has rooted itself in the cracked flagstones of the Sunvault Climb and grown a canopy of solar-luminescent leaves; it commands the warm air of the entire terrace and bombards foes with light-charged seeds.
visual: Tall figure with gnarled bark-skin legs rooted into stone; upper body branches into a broad canopy of gold-green leaves that each glow amber at the edges; face is a knotted sun-sigil carved in bark; imposing and alive at 64px.
signature_idea: Seed Cannon — fires an arc of solar-charged seeds that apply a poison-like solar drain over three turns
hook: A living sun-tree anchored to ancient stone — rooted in place, utterly immovable, and radiating commanding authority.

name: Gildwing
concept: A giant golden moth-like sky kin whose wings are panels of pure compressed daylight; it circles the highest peak of the Sunvault Climb, filling the valley below with warm soft light and obliterating anything that threatens the solar sanctum with blasts of concentrated radiance.
visual: Enormous moth silhouette; wings are solid gold panels with no texture variation — pure flat light; round body in deep amber; six trailing leg-tendrils; two long antennae arcing back; otherworldly and pristine at 64px.
signature_idea: Dawnwing Burst — the two gold wing-panels slam together, releasing a shockwave of Solar+Light energy
hook: A moth the size of a doorframe with wings made of solid sunlight — the most awe-inducing presence over the Sunvault Climb, and completely unique.

name: Solcrab
concept: A squat stone crab whose heavily mineralised shell absorbed centuries of stored Solar heat from the Solarium's golden arches; it uses its superheated claws to crack stone and cauterise foes on contact.
visual: Wide crab silhouette; heavily ridged carapace in stone-grey shot with molten amber veins; two oversized claws glowing orange at the grip edges; small beady amber eyes on short stalks; solid and low to the ground at 48px.
hook: A solar-heated stone crab — prehistoric, stubborn, and it will absolutely not let go once it's grabbed something.

name: Brighthorn
concept: A young sun-ram with a single luminous golden horn that channels stored Solar energy into focused bursts; it headbutts sunlit ruins to absorb their stored warmth and grows stronger the more it charges.
visual: Compact ram silhouette; cream-amber fleece; single central horn spiralling to a bright amber point that glows like a beacon; hooves leave brief sun-imprint marks; solid and determined at 40px.
hook: A golden one-horned ram that charges ruins to drink their light — sturdy, stubborn, and brilliantly single-minded.

name: Solhorn
concept: A great solar-ram that has grown a second sweeping horn alongside its original; both horns now act as solar capacitors, storing and releasing immense charges in devastating horn-strikes that leave scorch circles in stone.
visual: Large, broad-shouldered ram silhouette; two great sweeping horns rising in a wide V, both tipped and veined with brilliant gold glow; heavy fleece body in rich amber-cream; deep planted stance; formidable at 64px.
signature_idea: Dual Capacitor Charge — the two horns fire simultaneously for two hits of Solar Physical damage in one action
hook: A solar battering ram with two horns full of compressed sunlight — the definition of unstoppable force.

name: Tidecomet
concept: An apex kin that looks like a comet trailing warm water: a compressed sphere of superheated Solar-charged ocean that blazes through the Solarium's deepest flood-vaults, converting everything it touches into steaming radiance.
visual: Dense, blinding sphere of amber-gold surrounded by a streaming trail of luminous warm-blue water droplets; the core is barely distinguishable from a small sun; two crescent-shaped water-wings arc back from the sides; truly spectacular at 64px.
signature_idea: Comet Dive — charges one turn then detonates as a Solar+Tide explosion dealing massive damage to all foes and self-damaging slightly
hook: A living comet made of sunlit water — a blinding, beautiful, suicidal finisher that every collector will want and fear.

name: Kindlesol
concept: A rare mid-grade Solar spirit that wanders the Sunvault Climb in the form of a compact radiant sphere ringed by eight floating sun-script runes; it illuminates lost waypoints in the ruins and leaves warm sigils on stone that glow for days.
visual: Smooth amber sphere with a calm sun-face etched on the front; eight small glowing rune-shards orbit slowly around the equator; a soft corona of warm light halos the body; serene and self-contained at 48px.
signature_idea: Sun Sigil — marks a foe with a solar-script rune that doubles the next Solar hit's damage
hook: A wise little sun-oracle wrapped in golden runes — it marks its enemies for the light and makes the Solarium feel like a place of ancient, living magic.

name: Snoozlet
concept: A drowsy round moon-sheep that drifts half-awake through the Nightreach highlands, trailing softly glowing wool-tufts that carry faint dream-motes wherever they float.
visual: Plump round sheep body in pale cream-blue, half-closed crescent eyes, small crescent-moon horns, fluffy wool with faint silver-blue glow-wisps drifting off it; maximally round silhouette at 32px.
hook: The sleepiest, softest sheep in the world — just looking at it makes you yawn.

name: Drowshorn
concept: A mid-sized dream-ram whose crescent horns have grown into proper moon-arcs that hum with soporific resonance; anything caught near it during its slow, dreamy patrol gradually loses focus.
visual: Stocky ram silhouette, deep slate-blue wool, full crescent moon-arc horns lit with cool silver, half-lidded star-pupils, trail of floating dream-motes; calm and commanding at 48px.
hook: Peaceful but quietly menacing — it doesn't fight you, it just makes you forget you wanted to.

name: Lunarbel
concept: A great moon-ram whose wool has become a cascade of solidified moonlight, each strand a fine thread of pure silver-white luminescence. It stands watch over sleeping kin, radiating a calming aura that suppresses nightmares.
visual: Large broad-shouldered ram, glowing silver-white flowing wool, full moon-disk framed between sweeping horn-arcs, radiant star-pupils, soft halo aura; majestic and otherworldly at 64px.
signature_idea: Dream Warden — raises own Sp. Def and inflicts sleep on a switched-in opponent
hook: A sky-sheep made of moonlight, standing guard in the dark — the most reassuring sight in the night highlands.

name: Glimmite
concept: A tiny hovering orb-sprite that buzzes around Nightreach like a will-o'-wisp, its faint moon-glow blinking in patterns that seem to convey messages no one fully understands.
visual: Small perfect sphere, cool blue-white glow with a dim core, two faint crescent eyebrow-marks, no limbs, blinks on and off; minimal ghost-ball at 32px.
hook: A tiny mystery that pulses at you — you can't tell if it's friendly or mischievous, and that's exactly the point.

name: Vesphex
concept: A swarm-mind of a dozen blinking orb-sprites that fused under an eclipse, their combined light casting confusing overlapping shadows. Opponents struck by its eclipse-beams suffer a muddled vision of contradictory dreams.
visual: A loose cluster of pale orbs orbiting a dark central mass, half lit silver-blue half swallowed in ink-shadow, overlapping crescent-shadow halos; eerie and beautiful at 64px.
signature_idea: Eclipse Pulse — lowers accuracy and applies confusion; Eclipse (Lunar/Dark) flavour
hook: Cute blinking light became a cluster of eclipse-shadows — disorienting, eerie, perfect.

name: Petalune
concept: A quick frost-moth with wings patterned in delicate ice-crystal mandalas that catch moonlight and scatter it as prismatic cold sparks. It flits between the telescope domes leaving frosty petal-impressions on the glass.
visual: Slender moth silhouette, pale blue-white body, broad wings with intricate frost-mandala patterning in silver and ice-blue, long tapered antennae; delicate and swift at 48px.
hook: A moth made of moonlit frost — beautiful, fleeting, and endlessly collectible.

name: Crystalune
concept: A large moon-moth whose wings have crystallised into translucent ice-panels etched with star-map engravings. It navigates by the stars with uncanny precision and can flash-freeze the air around it.
visual: Wide-span moth, deep midnight-blue body, enormous translucent ice-panel wings with fine star-chart etchings glowing silver, trail of ice-crystal motes; grand and luminous at 64px.
signature_idea: Starmap Veil — sets a two-turn Frost field that slows all grounded opponents
hook: Its wings are literally a star atlas carved in ice — the most visually stunning moth in Vesperholm.

name: Tapireve
concept: A gentle tapir-like dreameater that wanders the border between waking and sleep; its long snout can sift bad dreams out of slumbering kin, leaving behind a faint trail of silver vapour.
visual: Compact tapir body, dusty silver-lavender coat, long gentle snout with a crescent-tip, large closed-seeming eyes with tiny star glints, small trunk that trails dream-vapour; soft and round at 48px.
hook: The dream-eater that takes away nightmares — cosy, tender, and a little mysterious.

name: Somnaphant
concept: A majestic moon-tapir that has grown a dreamscape crown: a halo of floating geometric dream-shards orbit its brow, each one a captured omen or vision. It consumes nightmares whole and exudes serenity.
visual: Large sturdy tapir silhouette, deep indigo coat with silver constellation-markings, a floating crown of glowing geometric shards (triangles, crescents) orbiting the head, calm heavy-lidded eyes; powerful and serene at 64px.
signature_idea: Omen Hoard — drains opponent's Sp. Atk while restoring own HP
hook: An ancient dreameater who has eaten so many omens it's become one itself — the most knowing creature in the world.

name: Flickat
concept: A sleek night-cat that seems to exist half in shadow and half in moonlight; it vanishes when you look directly at it and reappears at your side, blinking with calm crescent-slit eyes.
visual: Slim cat silhouette, deep charcoal-grey coat with faint moon-silver highlights, crescent-slit eyes, half-translucent tail tip that phases in and out; quick and ephemeral at 32px.
hook: The cat that exists between one moment and the next — impossible to catch, impossible to resist.

name: Lunarist
concept: A lithe moon-cat that can step fully into the space between moonbeams; it travels by leaping between patches of moonlight and arrives at its destination as if teleported, trailing silver afterimages.
visual: Lean elegant cat, deep navy body with silver light-streaks along every limb, large luminous crescent-eyes, three translucent afterimage silhouettes lingering behind each pose; fast and ghostly at 64px.
signature_idea: Moonbeam Step — priority-status move that sharply raises own Speed this turn
hook: The cat that moves through moonlight itself — Speed that makes your eyes ache trying to follow it.

name: Astrowl
concept: A constellation-feathered owl whose plumage maps the night sky — each feather bears a glowing star-point connected to its neighbours by faint silver lines. It reads omens in the starfield and calls out patterns that shimmer in the air.
visual: Round owl body, deep midnight-blue feathers each marked with a star-point linked by silver constellation-lines, large luminous disc-eyes in gold, broad silent wings; iconic star-chart silhouette at 48px.
hook: A living star-chart with feathers — Nightreach's iconic scholar-bird, the one locals watch to read the sky.

name: Stellaryx
concept: Astrowl's final kindling: a great horned starlight-owl whose wingspan maps an entire constellation across both wings simultaneously. The pattern shifts as it flies, tracking the sky in real time — a living celestial chart that can project blinding stellar beams.
visual: Large imposing owl, wide dramatic wingspan, feathers showing a shifting star-chart that glows brighter in battle, prominent ear-tufts like twin bright stars, intense golden disc-eyes; commanding and luminous at 64px.
signature_idea: Stellar Lance — focused Lunar/Light beam attack that ignores Sp. Def boosts on target
hook: Astrowl's full form — a wingspan that charts the whole sky, and a gaze that has seen every constellation twice.

name: Dreamoth
concept: A huge dust-coated dream-moth that drifts through the Nightreach twilight on near-silent wings, releasing soporific silver spores with every wingbeat. Anything caught in its spore-cloud finds its thoughts drifting pleasantly off course.
visual: Broad-winged moth, soft ash-mauve body, wings with sweeping eye-spot patterns in silver and deep indigo, trailing clouds of luminous silver spore-dust; dreamlike and vast at 48px.
hook: Enormous, silent, and trailing sleep-dust — both beautiful and slightly terrifying in the best way.

name: Morpheva
concept: Dreamoth's final form: a vast dream-emperor moth whose wings carry shifting dream-visions across their surface — opponents who gaze on it see their own deepest wishes and lose the will to fight. It embodies the sleep-deep boundary between hope and forgetting.
visual: Enormous moth, deep midnight body, wings displaying slow-shifting silhouette-visions in pale silver (landscapes, figures), swirling crescent antennae, trails of luminous dream-dust cascading from every wingbeat; overwhelming and beautiful at 64px.
signature_idea: Reverie Storm — area status move that sleeps all grounded opponents after two turns of setup
hook: The dream it showed you was so real you stopped fighting — Vesperholm's most emotionally devastating kin.

name: Spirlet
concept: A tiny night-spirit sprite that looks like a faint crescent cut from silver tissue paper; it drifts on the cold night air above Nightreach Observatory, emitting a soft high hum that unsettles nearby kin.
visual: Simple crescent-moon silhouette form, translucent silver-white body, two tiny round eyes, a faint shimmer trail; minimal and eerie at 32px.
hook: A tiny sliver of moon given life — impossibly delicate and just a little unsettling.

name: Nightwraith
concept: A mid-stage moon-spirit that has grown a veil of dark mist around its crescent core; it whispers in a frequency that plants doubt and unease in the minds of those who hear it.
visual: Hovering crescent-core wrapped in a flowing ink-and-silver mist veil, two luminous crescent eyes, long wispy trailing arms of mist; spectral and unnerving at 48px.
hook: The cute crescent sprite grew into a whispering dusk-wraith — one of those rare mid-stages worth using in its own right.

name: Omenire
concept: A towering eclipse-spirit whose crescent core is now fully ringed by a disc of null-dark; it embodies the omen of a total eclipse — foreboding, still, and able to drain conviction from anyone who meets its gaze.
visual: Tall spectral silhouette, a full solar-eclipse disc at the chest (silver rim, ink-dark centre), long ink-mist arms reaching wide, crescent crown of pale fire atop the head; dramatic and eerie at 64px.
signature_idea: Eclipse Omen — lowers all opponent stats by one stage simultaneously; usable once
hook: The crescent grew into an eclipse — the omen of everything going still before something terrible or wonderful happens.

name: Tidewane
concept: A slow-moving moon-jellyfish that drifts through fog-banks like a displaced deep-sea creature, its trailing tentacles tuned to moonlight. The tidal pulls of the night sky flow through it, and it sways with invisible currents.
visual: Dome-bell jellyfish body, translucent pale silver-blue with a crescent pattern at the bell-top, long trailing luminous tentacles, lazy drift posture; ethereal and soft at 48px.
hook: A jellyfish that drifts through air instead of water, lit from within by moonlight — eerily beautiful.

name: Lunargale
concept: A vast moon-jellyfish whose bell has expanded to hold a small personal fog-sea within its dome. The gravity of the moon flows through it and it can cause localised tidal disruptions — flooding an opponent's footing or pulling protective barriers apart.
visual: Huge jellyfish silhouette, broad dome glowing with a swirling miniature fog-sea inside, long sweeping tentacles trailing water-mist, crescent-moon halo around the bell rim; vast and hypnotic at 64px.
signature_idea: Moon Tide — reduces opponent's Sp. Atk and sets a weather-like tide effect for three turns
hook: A jellyfish that contains its own private sea, powered by the moon — staggeringly cool as a late-game collector's prize.

name: Nocturnip
concept: A moon-blooming root sprite that sprouts only under full moonlight, its pale leaf-fronds curling upward like outstretched hands to soak in starlight. It smells faintly of night-flowers and damp earth.
visual: Small rounded root-body, pale green-silver colouring, three curling star-tipped leaf-fronds atop the head, sleepy crescent eyes, tiny root-feet; a plump friendly vegetable at 32px.
hook: A flower that only exists under the moon — the secret garden variety you can actually befriend.

name: Stellabloom
concept: A full moon-blossom spirit whose flowering crown has opened into a six-pointed star of luminous silver petals, each one a petal-map of a different constellation. It photosynthesises starlight and releases healing pollen.
visual: Upright root-sprite, silver-green body, enormous six-pointed star-blossom crown with glowing constellation-maps on each petal, root-tendrils spreading outward like anchoring arms; striking and graceful at 64px.
signature_idea: Star Pollen — heals own HP and applies sleep-seeds to opponent simultaneously
hook: A moon-flower that blossoms into a six-pointed star of healing light — stunningly beautiful and unexpectedly tactical.

name: Lunsprite
concept: A small silver-blue fox-kit with a crescent moon branded on its forehead and a tail that curves upward into a moon-arc. It reads omens by sniffing the night air and warns its companions with short yipping calls.
visual: Compact fox-kit silhouette, silver-blue fur, crescent-moon forehead mark glowing softly, upward-curving moon-arc tail, bright curious eyes; small and expressive at 32px.
hook: The omen-reading fox kit that warns you with a yip before trouble comes — a tiny faithful scout.

name: Vespera
concept: A sleek silver fox spirit whose entire pelt is a shifting map of the night sky — constellations drift across its coat as it runs, and when it howls at the moon its voice echoes with the sound of distant bells.
visual: Elegant long-legged fox, deep silver coat with shifting constellation-patterns flowing across the fur, crescent-horns sweeping back from the brow, twin moon-arc tails; lithe and luminous at 64px.
signature_idea: Constellation Howl — raises own Speed and lowers opponent's Sp. Atk with a single call
hook: The little omen-fox grew into a creature of pure night-sky — constellations running beside you.

name: Orbwink
concept: A chubby round night-frog that puffs up and glows faintly under moonlight; it blinks its large silver eyes out of sync (one open, one shut) in a way that disconcerts anything watching it.
visual: Wide round frog body, pale silver-grey skin, one enormous open silver eye and one closed eye-crescent, wide low posture; round and comically odd at 32px.
hook: The goofy one-eyed frog that unnerves everything — chaotic and loveable in equal measure.

name: Lunacroix
concept: A large moon-toad whose mismatched eye-blink has become a genuine hypnotic weapon — one eye projects a loop of calming dream-visions while the other stares unblinking with cold lunar intensity.
visual: Wide powerful toad silhouette, deep indigo-silver skin, one enormous golden moon-disc eye projecting dream-light, one cold crescent eye; wide and formidable at 64px.
signature_idea: Dual Gaze — confuses opponent and lowers their Speed in one action
hook: One eye puts you to sleep, the other freezes you in place — the most disorienting creature in the west.

name: Nebulette
concept: A luminous cloud-serpent made of compressed starlight dust; it coils through the upper reaches of Nightreach Observatory trailing nebula-wisps. Its body is soft and diffuse but its star-point head can punch through stone.
visual: Slim serpent silhouette, translucent violet-and-silver cloud-body with star-motes visible through it, bright pointed star-head, soft trailing cloud-tail; airy and dangerous at 48px.
hook: A cloud that solidified into a serpent — you can see through it but somehow that makes it scarier.

name: Aurorask
concept: A vast nebula-serpent whose condensed body now trails a full aurora of compressed starlight; it fires lance-thin stellar beams of immense focus and fragility, capable of puncturing the night sky visually before blinking away.
visual: Long serpentine form, shifting aurora-pale body (silver-violet-blue), broad flowing light-ribbon fins trailing from every spine-ridge, brilliant pinpoint eyes, a sense of barely-controlled power; spectacular and fragile at 64px.
signature_idea: Nova Lance — very high power Lunar/Light special attack with 10% recoil
hook: A serpent of aurora light — glass cannon personified, a beautiful disaster waiting to happen.

name: Omenkit
concept: A small wiry moon-ferret that moves in and out of shadows with unnerving speed, carrying a crescent-tipped tail that it uses to mark things it considers cursed. Travellers along the Sunvault Climb sometimes spot one dashing between rocks just before something goes wrong.
visual: Lithe ferret silhouette, charcoal-and-silver two-tone fur, crescent-tipped glowing tail, bright wide alert eyes; quick and alert at 32px.
hook: The eclipse-tailed omen-ferret — fast, mischievous, and every old traveller's unlucky charm.

name: Shadowlune
concept: A sleek eclipse-predator, half moonlit silver and half swallowed shadow, that hunts by riding the threshold between dark and light. It strikes from the boundary where moonbeam meets shadow and vanishes before the hit registers.
visual: Lean powerful ferret-weasel, left half brilliant moon-silver, right half absolute ink-black with no detail, crescent-moon scar marking across the face, long shadow-trailing tail; dramatic split silhouette at 64px.
signature_idea: Threshold Strike — a physical attack that ignores Defense boosts; fails in direct sunlight
hook: A creature literally split between light and dark — the most visually striking eclipse-kin in the game.

name: Constellan
concept: A slow, indestructible constellation-turtle whose shell bears the exact map of the night sky's eight major constellations, glowing in living light. Astronomers at Nightreach consider it a sacred keeper of the sky's memory.
visual: Wide dome-shelled turtle, heavy dark blue-black body, shell surface covered in glowing gold-silver constellation lines with bright star-nodes at intersections, slow steady presence; vast and immovable at 64px.
signature_idea: Sky Memory — raises own Defense and Sp. Def simultaneously; one use per battle
hook: An unkillable tortoise whose shell is literally the night sky — the observatory's patient guardian.

name: Solunet
concept: A little moon-tide sprite shaped like a water-drop with a crescent inside; it skips across wet rooftops in Nightreach when the moon is high, riding the silver reflections of puddles.
visual: Teardrop body, translucent cool-blue with a glowing silver crescent suspended inside, tiny stub feet, round hopeful eyes; simple and lovely at 32px.
hook: A moon caught inside a raindrop — the most delicate little thing, made of two beautiful things at once.

name: Tidalune
concept: A moon-tide sprite that has gathered enough water to form a proper fluid body, hovering in a rotating sphere of water illuminated from within by crescent-light. It pulls at opponents with slow tidal forces.
visual: Sphere of slowly rotating pale blue water with a luminous crescent core, small fine-featured face at the water surface, trailing water-arc tails; elegant floating orb at 48px.
hook: A moon living inside a sphere of water — hypnotic to watch and quietly threatening.

name: Lunaquell
concept: The tide-moon spirit in its full form: a vast oceanic omen-being whose water-sphere has grown to contain a miniature tidal sea, with a full moon disc blazing at its heart. It calls tides even in landlocked places.
visual: Large hovering sphere of churning dark ocean water, full moon-disc blazing silver at the exact centre, visible wave-turbulence inside the sphere, trailing ocean-mist arcs; vast and awe-inspiring at 64px.
signature_idea: Neap Call — calls a tidal wave that hits all opponents and sharply lowers their Speed
hook: It carries the whole ocean in a sphere and a moon inside that — one of Vesperholm's most staggering final forms.

name: Dawnwatcher
concept: The sub-legendary apex of the Lunar constellation — a great celestial heron of crystallised moonlight and captured starfire, said to stand vigil at the exact moment between night and dawn. Nightreach astronomers built the observatory to watch for it. Lunar/Light Constellation Warden.
visual: Tall elegant heron silhouette, body formed of layered plates of translucent crystalline moonlight, long neck and crest trailing silver-white starfire, vast wings spanning full starfield patterns, a single blazing star-eye; monumentally graceful at 64px.
signature_idea: Starfire Vigil — marks one opponent for true damage every turn for 3 turns while raising own defenses
hook: The heron that watches the sky so dawn can come — the Warden of the Lunar constellation, and the reason Nightreach Observatory exists at all.

name: Velundra
concept: An ancient moon-serpent that has been coiled around the peak of Nightreach since before the observatory was built; it is older than the sky charts the astronomers study. Its scales are pure compressed moonphase — dark on new-moon nights, blazing on full. A sub-legendary guardian of the west.
visual: Massive coiling serpent, large flat moon-disc head bearing all eight lunar phases in a ring, scales that shift from ink-dark to brilliant silver, long slow-coiling body; monumental and ancient at 64px.
signature_idea: Moonphase Turn — switches between a defensive new-moon form and an offensive full-moon form each turn
hook: A serpent that IS the moon's phases — the oldest thing in the west, and you can catch it.

name: Murmix
concept: A stout moon-badger with a wide flat forehead that functions as a natural star-chart compass; it charges obstacles headfirst, using moonlight reflected off its brow-plate to navigate in complete darkness.
visual: Stocky broad-shouldered badger, deep charcoal body, flat reflective silver brow-plate with faint constellation markings, short powerful legs, determined forward-leaning posture; compact and sturdy at 48px.
hook: A moon-badger that headbutts its way through the dark using a built-in star-chart — pure determination made adorable.

name: Starforge
concept: The moon-badger's final form: a heavy-plated star-chart bear whose entire body has mineralised around its lunar energy, each crystalline plate bearing a different constellation. It strikes with the weight of a falling star.
visual: Massive bear-like silhouette, each body plate a different stone-crystal engraved with constellation patterns and lit from within, flat moon-disc face, enormous heavy forelegs for devastating physical strikes; immense and deliberate at 64px.
signature_idea: Falling Star — charges for one turn, then delivers a physical Lunar/Stone hit that bypasses Defense
hook: A mineral bear that hits with the weight of a meteorite — the universe's most patient bruiser.

name: Glimflit
concept: A tiny firefly-sprite that bobs through Tinderwick's evening air, its tail-lantern blinking in rhythmic code only other Glimflit can read.
visual: Transparent-winged insectoid sprite, thumbnail-sized; round mint-green body, a single amber bead tail-lamp that pulses on and off; long antennae tipped with spark-dots; silhouette reads as a floating comma at 16px.
signature_idea: Beacon Blink — switches itself and one ally's positions, also removing one entry hazard from the target's side.
hook: It blinks at you with a friendly rhythm — kids will try to tap along.

name: Glimscout
concept: A grown firefly-courier that blazes a trail of lingering glow-motes wherever it streaks, marking safe paths through the dusk for those who follow.
visual: Elongated, dragonfly-like frame; four layered wings edged with cyan; abdomen striped amber and cream, tip blazing a permanent steady beacon; big compound eyes catching every glint; reads as a streak of light at 32px.
signature_idea: Trailblaze — sets a field effect for 5 turns that boosts ally Speed by one stage on entry and negates accuracy drops.
hook: It looks fast even when standing still — older players will immediately clock it as a pivot piece.

name: Lampling
concept: The beloved mascot of Vesper Crossroads — a sentient vesperlamp kin that has been glowing at the crossroads inn for longer than anyone can remember. It welcomes every weary traveller with a warm amber light and an unhurried tilt of its brass hood.
visual: Squat, teardrop-shaped body of burnished brass, a round glass-chimney belly filled with warm amber glow; two small mitten-like hands grip the base; tiny curled feet; a brass hood sits slightly askew like a jaunty cap; warm cream light pools at its base; instantly iconic at 32px — fat oval + hat silhouette.
signature_idea: Heartlight — sets a persistent healing field for 4 turns (allies recover 1/8 HP each turn) and clears all party status conditions on use.
hook: It IS the crossroads — the mascot every player will bond with on their first visit. A hug in kin form.

name: Glowpan
concept: A squat cave imp whose pan-flat face is a polished stone mirror, bouncing mine-lantern light in blinding flashes to startle Hollowing scouts away from the deep galleries.
visual: Stubby four-limbed imp, charcoal-grey stony skin, a perfectly round concave mirror-face of glossy white quartz that reflects everything around it distorted; tiny coal-black eyes set in the rim; wide flat feet gripping cave rock; silhouette = round-faced goblin at 32px.
signature_idea: Dazzle Flash — lowers accuracy of all foes by two stages and may inflict the Dazed status (no stat changes next turn) on the primary target.
hook: Its face IS a mirror — it shows you your own distorted reflection, which is quietly unsettling and charming in equal measure.

name: Glowarden
concept: A sentinel of the deep mine, its once-flat mirror-face grown into a great polished slab that projects a full-body light shield over allies it deems worth protecting.
visual: Bulky, broad-shouldered stone guardian; the mirror-face is now a wide rectangular slab of veined white quartz with a soft amber shine; arms are thick columns of layered rock with crystal-seam highlights; planted stance reads as immovable at 32px.
signature_idea: Mirror Ward — erects a barrier halving all special damage for 5 turns (the Reflect equivalent), and reflects any accuracy-lowering move back at the attacker.
hook: A walking fortress with a glowing face — exactly the 'tank that also looks cool' kids want on their team.

name: Tessel
concept: A living geometric star-fragment born from the Nightreach Observatory's broken astrolabe, its facets each mapped to a different constellation; it drifts through the dome at night cataloguing the stars that remain.
visual: Eight-pointed flat star-polygon, each point a slightly different length; body is deep indigo with glowing white geometric lines tessellating across the surface like a stained-glass map; no visible limbs, drifts via a subtle shimmer-field; edges glow cyan when all eight constellations are complete; striking at any pixel size.
signature_idea: Constellation Lock — on entry, identifies the opponent's primary type and boosts the team's resistance to that type by one half-step for 3 turns.
hook: It IS a constellation made small — players collecting the game's star lore will feel like this is their key item made alive.

name: Wicklit
concept: A matchstick sprite, barely the height of a thumb, that ignites itself to draw attention away from endangered kin, then safely regrows its wax body overnight.
visual: Thin matchstick body of pale cream wax, a spherical amber head topped by a single tiny flame-tuft; two twig-thin arms; big worried eyes; small enough to balance on a coin at 16px.
hook: It sacrifices its own flame to protect others — children love a scrappy little helper with a big heart.

name: Wickmere
concept: A half-grown candle-folk that has learned to shape its wax body mid-battle, flowing around attacks and re-forming with a warm laugh, frustrating physical hitters.
visual: Slender humanoid of ivory wax, three flames now crowning its head like a candelabra; half-melted wax drapes off shoulders like a cape; cheerful smiling face; rounded candle-base feet; reads clearly at 32px.
signature_idea: Soft Wax — when hit by a physical move, has a 30% chance to reduce the attacker's Attack by one stage (wax clings and slows).
hook: The three-flame crown is immediately distinctive and memorable on a team roster.

name: Wicklord
concept: A regal candelabra-kin whose body is a flowing pillar of warm wax lined with seven blazing wicks; it calms storms of fear and darkness with a steady, generous light that seems to make everyone in range feel safer.
visual: Tall, dignified humanoid; torso is a layered tiered candelabra of poured wax, seven distinct flames each a different warm hue from amber to rose; long draping arms of flowing wax; a composed, kind face half-shadowed by a wax-brim hat; strikes a warm silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Seven Wicks — activates Reflect AND Light Screen simultaneously at reduced duration (3 turns each), at the cost of the user's next action.
hook: The seven-flame crown doubles as a personality — each flame flickers differently; players will call it iconic.

name: Prismling
concept: A bubble-round prism-sprite no bigger than a marble, tumbling through shafts of lamplight and splitting them into tiny rainbows wherever it rolls.
visual: Perfect sphere of clear glass with a warm pastel rainbow refracting through its core at all times; no visible face — just the colours shifting inside; rolls on a tiny shadow-outline base; unmissable silhouette even at 16px.
hook: A living marble that makes rainbows — the simplest possible 'I want that' hook for young players.

name: Prismara
concept: A fully faceted prism-creature that can bend incoming energy attacks around itself, redirecting them harmlessly as prismatic light-fans; a natural counterwaller that frustrates special attackers.
visual: Large hexagonal prism body standing upright, each face a different pastel colour; two elegant wing-fins of spun glass; a small elegant 'face' engraved at the top face by natural refraction-lines; projects a constant soft rainbow halo; regal at 48px.
signature_idea: Refract — reduces all incoming special moves by 30% for 5 turns; while active, contact special moves that miss instead hit the user's own side (reflected).
hook: Pure optical elegance — players who like strategy will recognise this as a special-wall cornerstone immediately.

name: Dewsprite
concept: A water-drop spirit that clings to lantern-glass at Pearlmoor Quay, absorbing the lamplight and reflecting it back as soft healing radiance; sailors leave it fresh water as thanks.
visual: Teardrop body of translucent cyan-blue, a warm amber glow pooled at the rounded base; two tiny fin-like hands; a single bright white droplet-marking on its forehead; reads as a glowing raindrop at 16px.
hook: Sailors in the game's lore leave it water — it feels both mystical and domesticated, which is endearing.

name: Dewveil
concept: A large, luminous tide-spirit that wraps allies in a cocoon of glowing mist, both soothing wounds and washing away status ailments; the Quay's dockhands call it the 'harbour healer'.
visual: Flowing, vaguely jellyfish-shaped; a rounded bell of radiant pale-blue water-light, four long trailing tendrils edged with amber, a serene face just barely visible within the bell; gentle, vast-feeling silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Cleansing Veil — removes all status conditions from all allies and leaves a 3-turn Misty Terrain that prevents new status being inflicted on grounded allies.
hook: The 'cleanse your whole team' kin that every long-haul player wants one of.

name: Mossglow
concept: A fuzzy moss-ball that slowly rolls through the forest floor of Lowleaf Hollow, leaving a trail of faint bioluminescent spores; too round and soft to be scary but deeply easy to underestimate.
visual: Near-perfect sphere of dense green moss with scattered amber spore-dots; no obvious limbs but two tiny leaf-stubs; a single sleepy eye peeking out from the moss; rolls via a wobble-wiggle motion; reads as a mossy marble at 16px.
hook: It looks completely harmless — players discover that its spore cloud inflicts Sleep, which is a lovely reveal.

name: Mossmantle
concept: A half-formed moss-treeling that has grown a cloak of living bioluminescent fronds; when it opens its arms the spore cloud it releases can confuse or sedate an entire clearing.
visual: Short bipedal figure draped in a thick cape of glowing green moss-fronds; a wooden face-plate with amber eyes showing through the moss hood; stubby arms ending in leaf-fans; a round body hidden under the living mantle; warm and eerie at 32px.
hook: A walking haunted coat of moss — kids will love the idea of a kin that is basically a living cloak.

name: Lumenmoss
concept: An ancient moss-lord of the Hollow whose entire body is a cathedral of bioluminescent growth; it breathes out a spore-fog that coats opponents' scales and slows their movement, while healing allies who stand within its light.
visual: Huge bipedal form entirely cloaked in thick layered glowing moss-panels; a great antler-rack of twisted branches sprouting glowing spore-bulbs; a solemn carved-wood face deep within a moss-arch; radiates green-amber light in gentle pulses; awe-inspiring at 48px.
signature_idea: Sporemist Cathedral — poisons all foes with a lingering light-spore variant (Glowblight: takes 1/8 HP each turn + -1 Speed) while curing all allied status ailments.
hook: A creature that IS a living forest shrine — kids who love Verdant AND Light kin will feel this is made for them.

name: Halobuck
concept: A young deer-like kin of the Lowleaf Hollow whose budding velvet antlers glow soft amber, acting as living candles in the forest dark for the lost and frightened.
visual: Slender fawn body with pale cream-and-sage dappling; two small velvety antler-buds each tipped with a warm amber flame-glow; big reflective eyes; delicate, hesitant stance; silhouette is immediately recognisable as a gentle deer at 32px.
hook: A glowing baby deer that uses its antlers as lanterns — a classically soft design that players will feel protective of.

name: Halovestige
concept: A majestic halo-stag of the deep forest whose great crown of antlers each bear a fully blazing amber light, creating a ring of warmth that fortifies companions and repels the Hollowing's cold.
visual: Tall, dignified stag with a warm honey-and-bone coat; antlers now sweep into a full circle above the head, each tip a burning amber flame making a crown of fire-candles; the whole animal has a soft warm glow; powerful and serene at 48px.
signature_idea: Antler Halo — places a persistent protective field that grants all allies +1 Defense and heals 1/16 HP per turn for 5 turns; cannot be removed by opponents.
hook: A deer with a crown of fire for antlers — one of the most visually memorable kin in the game.

name: Tinderelle
concept: A quick-footed storm-sprite that crackles with low-voltage light as it dashes across Galehigh Terraces, using its charge to re-ignite guttered lanterns with a happy tap of its nose.
visual: Small, nimble bipedal sprite; periwinkle-blue body with amber electric-spark freckles; a tiny blunt horn crackling with a static glow; long ears that stream back like banners in the wind; wide grin; fast-looking even at 32px.
hook: It runs around relighting lanterns — a personality that maps directly onto the game's own quest.

name: Tinderstorm
concept: A lithe storm-herald that channels lightning through a lantern-bell mounted between its horns, ringing it to unleash precision pulses that paralyse foes or charge allies with speed.
visual: Sleek four-legged creature with a deep navy and cream coat; two sweeping curved horns bridged by a glowing brass bell crackling with arc-lightning; amber eyes; a mane of upright bristles sparking at the tips; elegant and dangerous at 48px.
signature_idea: Bell Shock — inflicts Paralysis on all opponents and grants one ally Quickened status (+1 Speed, cannot be paralysed) for 3 turns.
hook: A lantern-bell between storm-horns is an image that sells itself — the sound design alone will make players love it.

name: Frostwick
concept: A small ice-candle sprite of the Pale Vault Glacier, its body a pillar of frost-clouded ice around a perpetually burning inner light that never quite melts it — a paradox it seems entirely unbothered by.
visual: Stubby rectangular candle-body of pale blue frosted ice; a warm amber flame flickers from the flat top through a crown of ice-crystal spires; two stubby arm-nubs; a round cheerful face etched into the ice; reads as a fat crayon at 16px.
hook: A candle made of ice that still burns — it's a tiny philosophical mystery kids will latch onto.

name: Frostlume
concept: A frost-sculpture kin of cathedral proportions — a living ice-lantern whose inner flame casts long aurora-coloured shadows across the glacier; enemies who look into its light find their focus broken.
visual: Tall imposing form: a tapered ice-obelisk body with gothic arch-window cutouts that let inner flame-light spill in aurora colours; two wide wing-fin panels of translucent ice; a noble carved-ice face at the apex; breathtaking silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Aurora Pane — erects a special-damage barrier for 5 turns AND inflicts Dazed on any attacker who uses a special move against this kin while the barrier is active.
hook: An ice-lantern that punishes special attackers who look into its light — mechanically satisfying AND visually spectacular.

name: Lunveil
concept: A silvery curtain-moth near the Nightreach Observatory, its wings folded like shut eyelids; at night it opens them to reveal glowing Lunar-map markings that disorient rivals.
visual: Mid-sized moth with broad flat wings folded at rest; wings are dove-grey with eyes-shut markings on the outer face, but when spread reveal detailed silver-on-indigo moonphase maps; antennae tipped with small white orbs; elegant and mysterious at 32px.
hook: Two completely different wing faces — the shy closed moth and the revelatory open moth — give it a double life kids will find fascinating.

name: Lunvane
concept: A vast lunar-herald moth whose wing-span casts a moon-shadow over the battlefield; it confuses, charms, and sleep-dusts opponents with an otherworldly calm that feels like drifting off to sleep under open skies.
visual: Enormous wingspan; wings are deep midnight-blue with silver crescent and star-chart patterns that shift slowly; a long graceful body of silver-white; two large feathery antennae like plumes; hovers silently; presence fills the battle frame at 64px.
signature_idea: Moonfall Curtain — inflicts Sleep on one target with 90% accuracy; if the target is already Confused, inflicts Sleep automatically and also leaves a 3-turn Drowsy field that slows all grounded foes.
hook: The moon made into a moth — one of the most atmospheric kin in the game; collectors will feel privileged to own one.

name: Solarwren
concept: A dart-quick little dawn-bird of the Sunvault Climb; it carries a single stored sunbeam in its throat-pouch that it can release as a blinding flash, then races away before foes recover.
visual: Tiny sparrow-like bird; warm cream and tangerine plumage; throat pouch glows amber; wings tipped with gold; very small, very fast-looking, tail cocked like a spring; wide bright eyes; reads as a bright flick at 16px.
hook: A tiny bird carrying a sunbeam in its throat — an absolutely charming image.

name: Solarwarden
concept: A proud dawn-herald raptor that arrives before sunrises-that-never-quite-come; it projects a warm Solar/Light field that supercharges allies' next moves and clears hazards from the field with a single wing-beat.
visual: Large hawk-like bird; sweeping wings of layered gold and cream feathers; chest is polished brass-bright reflecting back any light source; head bears a halo-crest of radiating feather-spines; piercing amber eyes; commands the battle canvas at 48px.
signature_idea: First Light — removes all hazards from ally's field, boosts allies' next special move by 50% once each, and cures Burn/Freeze status on all allies.
hook: A dawn-herald that shows up and immediately cleans the field — the utility-pivot players will build entire teams around.

name: Spandrif
concept: A sea-surface spark-skimmer found along the Dimglass Coast; it surfs the light reflecting off the waves, skating on a cushion of radiant energy too fast for the eye to follow.
visual: Flat, stingray-like body no thicker than a wafer; translucent cream with amber light-veins; two whip-thin tail-filaments streaming behind; no obvious face — just two amber dot-eyes on the leading edge; nearly invisible edge-on, obvious from above at 16px.
hook: It skims light off ocean waves — even the biology sounds cool.

name: Spanwhirl
concept: A grown coastal radiance-glider that spins to create a strobing disc of light that scrambles enemies' aim while its allies manoeuvre freely.
visual: Larger, smoother manta-ray shape; body is pearlescent white with dynamic amber light-trails streaming from wingtips as it banks and tilts; the stroboscopic edge-pattern is visible as overlapping arcs at 48px.
signature_idea: Strobe Spin — lowers all opponents' accuracy by one stage and grants ally evasion +1 for 2 turns; if used in sunlight or with a Solar ally active, accuracy drop is two stages.
hook: A living spinning strobelight — the accuracy-manipulator players will use for safe set-up turns.

name: Vespling
concept: A honey-wasp of living light that nests in the crossroads signpost; it stings rivals with a burst of concentrated radiance that disrupts Dark-type abilities and leaves a burning clarity status.
visual: Wasp-bodied insect, but its body is amber and white glass with a soft glow inside instead of chitin; wings of pure translucent light; a fine bright stinger; alert, sharp-eyed; striped with warm yellow and warm white; reads as a glowing wasp at 16px.
signature_idea: Radiance Sting — inflicts Glare status (Dark-type moves deal 50% less damage from target for 3 turns) and lowers the target's Special Defense by one stage.
hook: A counter-pick specifically against the Hollowing's kin — players will understand its purpose the moment it works.

name: Duskbell
concept: A chime-sprite shaped like a single hanging bell that travels the Lanternway spokes; when rung by the wind it produces a tone that removes entry hazards from the path ahead.
visual: Classic bell-shape, polished brass with a soft amber inner glow and a tiny clapper-tail dangling below; two short round arms; a sweet face pressed into the bell-face like a relief carving; hangs and sways in the air; unmissable silhouette at 16px.
hook: A living bell — the moment you hear its chime sound effect, you'll want to carry it everywhere.

name: Duskcarillon
concept: A full carillon of five light-bells that orbit in a ring around a central glow-core; it orchestrates the battlefield with chiming tones that grant allies speed, heal minor wounds, and chime-blast foes.
visual: Five brass bells of decreasing size orbiting a radiant amber core like a mobile; the whole assembly gently rotates and chimes; fine brass chains connect each bell; a faint face visible in the central glow; kinetic and distinctive at 48px.
signature_idea: Carillon Peal — boosts all allies' Speed by one stage, removes all entry hazards on the ally's side, and deals moderate Light-type special damage to all opponents (the 'melody' deal).
hook: A flying set of bells — the sound design and the orbital visual together make it one of the most characterful kin in the dex.

name: Wispwane
concept: A guttering will-o'-wisp of the Coldfog Marches — a Light kin slowly drained by the Hollowing, now barely half-lit; it drifts erratically, luring rivals toward the coldfog while leaking residual radiance.
visual: Small floating orb of pale light, but the glow is sickly and flickering; half its body fades into dark-grey shadow; a pained face barely visible in the dim half; dark mist trails from its underside; haunting and sad at 16px.
hook: A kin that is visibly sick — players feel an immediate urge to 'rescue' it, which is emotionally resonant.

name: Wisprestored
concept: When a Wispwane is loved and re-kindled, the Hollowing's taint burns away and it blazes back as a radiant wisp of pure light — joyful, fast, and full of a renewed warmth.
visual: A now-healthy glowing orb, bright amber-white, streaming a long comet-tail of light-motes; a beaming face visible in its core; no dark shadow remains; moves with joyful swooping arcs; reads as a blazing meteor-head at 48px.
signature_idea: Rekindle — restores 50% of the user's HP; if the user was affected by any status condition, it is cleansed and the user gets +1 to all stats for 2 turns.
hook: The kindling evolution IS the narrative — recovering a drained kin back to full brilliance is the game's whole theme in one line.

name: Glinthorn
concept: A gem-encrusted cave-tortoise of the Cinderhead Mine whose crystal-studded shell deflects pickaxe blows and lantern-light equally, making it very difficult to see in the dark.
visual: Sturdy round tortoise; shell is dark charcoal-grey peppered with protruding crystal-shards that catch and scatter light; face is tucked under a crystal-rimmed brow-plate; four solid clawed legs; reads as a spiky dome at 16px.
hook: A crystal-studded tortoise that is basically camouflage in its own habitat — the idea of adaptive mimicry using light itself is cool.

name: Glintbulwark
concept: An ancient gem-fortressed tortoise whose shell has grown a full crystal cathedral across its back; it can project a hardlight dome around allies and then draw all enemy attacks to itself.
visual: Massive tortoise; the shell is now a full crystalline fortress with spires and arch-windows glowing amber from within; the face has a serene, patient expression framed by crystal flanges; heavy, immovable stance; awe-inspiring at 64px.
signature_idea: Crystal Fortress — draws all attacks to this kin for 2 turns (Taunt-equivalent) while simultaneously reducing incoming damage by 40%; afterwards raises own Defense by one stage.
hook: A tortoise with a glowing crystal fortress on its back — one of those designs where the player immediately says 'I want that one'.

name: Halowren
concept: A wren-small bird of the Lanternway hedgerows that perches on lamp-posts and sings a frequency that confuses Dark-type kin and soothes frightened allies; the traditional good-luck bird of Vesperholm travellers.
visual: Tiny rounded wren-bird; warm cream and amber plumage; a small halo-ring of white light hovering above its head at all times; bright black button-eyes; a clear, open beak mid-song; 16px reads as a round bird with a floating ring.
signature_idea: Halo Song — boosts all allies' Special Defense by one stage and inflicts Confusion on the primary opposing kin; secondary effect: the Confusion cannot be snapped by damage for 2 turns.
hook: A lucky omen bird that sings away confusion and doubt — textbook 'cosy game mascot energy' for the Lanternway stretches.

name: Prismcub
concept: A round-eared ice-bear cub of the Pale Vault Glacier whose fur is threaded with prism-crystal filaments; it tumbles through snowdrifts leaving miniature rainbow trails in its wake.
visual: Chubby bear cub with snow-white fur laced with fine crystal-threads that catch light in rainbow refractions; a big round nose; small triangular ears; wide trusting eyes; stumbles more than walks; irresistibly cute at 16px.
hook: A glittery rainbow bear cub — the purest concentrated 'kids will love this' design in the batch.

name: Prismantus
concept: A fully grown glacier-bear whose crystal-fur has solidified into great diamond-hard prism-plates; it slams opponents with rainbow-refracting claws and can freeze the air around it into a blinding prismatic storm.
visual: Large polar bear; thick layered prism-crystal plates replace the fur on its shoulders and back like natural armour; claws are translucent crystal-blade; fur in gaps is still white; dignified and powerful; beautiful and formidable at 64px.
signature_idea: Prism Slam — physical Light-type move that deals damage and has a 30% chance to inflict Dazzle (foe accuracy -2) from the rainbow flash; boosted by ice terrain.
hook: The wholesome cute cub grows into a crystal-armoured powerhouse — a satisfying arc for players who raised it.

name: Emberveil
concept: The Constellation Warden of the Ember star-anchor — a phoenix-like radiance-raptor that was half-extinguished by the Hollowing, and once fully relit burns with a purity of light/fire that marks the restoration of the first constellation.
visual: Large, soaring raptor-form; a body of white-hot radiance at the core fading to warm tangerine at the wing-edges; tail-feathers are long ribbons of flame-light; a crown of curled fire-glass spines on the head; majestic, awe-first at 64px.
signature_idea: Dawnfire Pyre — a powerful Light/Ember combined strike that sets a 4-turn Radiant Dawn field (all allies gain +1 Sp.Atk; Ember moves of allies gain STAB regardless of type).
hook: The living proof that the first constellation has been restored — players will remember exactly when they earned it.

name: Veilsong
concept: A legendary dreaming-heron that roosts at the Starwell post-Crown; it calls once at dawn and once at dusk, and every kin in earshot recovers fully from the hardships of the long night.
visual: Tall, impossibly slender heron; feathers of deep midnight-blue on the wings shading to pure silver-white at the chest; a long sweeping tail of moonshard plumes; a slender neck bearing a luminous halo; every feather's tip is a tiny star-point; godlike presence at 64px.
signature_idea: Starwell Song — fully restores HP of all allied kin currently active plus the next kin sent in, and clears all active negative status conditions, field hazards, and stat drops from the ally's side.
hook: A kin whose call heals everything — the support-player's ultimate trophy, earned at the Starwell post-credits nook.

name: Mirrox
concept: A Crystoll Vault spur kin — a fox of living mirror-glass that perfectly reflects the silhouette of the last kin it saw; opponents can never be sure which kin they're actually facing.
visual: Sleek fox body; entire surface is polished mirror-silver that reflects the surrounding area; face is a slightly curved reflective oval with two small amber eyes that are the only real colour; a bushy mirror-tail; shimmering, uncanny, beautiful at 32px.
signature_idea: Looking-Glass — copies the last move used by any kin on the field (ally or foe) and uses it at boosted 1.3× power; cannot copy signature moves.
hook: A fox made entirely of mirror — the existential uncertainty of fighting your own reflection is a delightful gameplay and narrative idea.

name: Skyweavelet
concept: A mote of the Skyweave itself given semi-sapient form — a thread-sprite that weaves small patches of the celestial fabric back together wherever the Hollowing has frayed it, arriving at the Crossroads ahead of each constellation relight.
visual: Tiny humanoid woven entirely from luminous thread; body is a loose tangle of glowing filaments in soft cyan, gold and white; legs and arms are thread-loops; a face of two bright white dots in a small thread-loop oval; carries a spool of golden thread on one wrist; whimsical and unique at 16px.
signature_idea: Skyweave Stitch — removes all field hazards from both sides of the battlefield AND prevents hazards being placed on the ally's side for 2 turns; if used before a relit-area encounter it gives the whole party +5% exp.
hook: It is literally mending the sky — the game's lore made playable in a tiny, charming form. Players who love the story will feel this kin IS the journey.

name: Mothdim
concept: A small grey moth whose wing-eyes were once luminous but are now flat and lightless — ashen circles where the glow used to be. It flutters through coldfog seeking the warmth it can no longer feel.
visual: Coin-sized moth, chalk-grey wings with faded circular eye-markings that hold no light; segmented dusty body, antennae curled downward; at 16px reads as a tiny winged oval.
hook: A moth whose eye-spots have gone dark — instantly melancholy, immediately recognisable.

name: Nullmoth
concept: A palm-sized moth draped in velvet-grey wings that shed fine null-dust — a powder that drains faint light sources on contact. Its dead lantern marking on each hindwing is unmistakable.
visual: Slate-grey wings with a stylised snuffed-lantern motif on each hindwing — the lantern arch and pane visible but the flame glyph hollow; body wrapped in soft ashen fuzz; dull violet undersides.
signature_idea: Null Dust — entry hazard that dims incoming Light-type moves for 3 turns
hook: The snuffed-lantern wing pattern is the emblem of the Coldfog Marches — instantly iconic.

name: Voidmantle
concept: A large, crepuscular moth whose wingspan fills a doorway. Its wings are so saturated with null-dust that they absorb the ambient glow from nearby kin, leaving a sphere of unnatural dark around it. An apex predator of light.
visual: Huge moth, wings deep charcoal edged in ghostly silver-white trim; six dead-lantern symbols across both wings; a feathered thorax like a burial shroud; compound eyes a milky, sightless grey.
signature_idea: Shroud Drift — spreads Null Dust field, forces opponent switches on entry
hook: A moth that eats light itself — awe-inducing at the right stage of the game.

name: Cindersob
concept: A small creature shaped like a charred ember-hound pup — the hollowed remnant of a once-warm hearth companion. Its body is ash-black with faint orange cracks where embers still smoulder inside a hollowed chest.
visual: Small four-legged hound of black char, ribs faintly visible as orange-glow cracks; a wisp of cold smoke from a snuffed tail-flame; dull copper eyes; silhouette reads as a small dog at 16px.
hook: A puppy that is clearly the ghost of a warm hearth-dog — heartbreaking and immediately sympathetic.

name: Embergone
concept: The snuffed final form of a proud ember-kin lineage — a tall hound whose once-brilliant coat is reduced to cracked obsidian shot through with dying ember veins. It runs in silence, trailing no warmth. The hollow in its chest is the shape of a lost flame.
visual: Lean upright hound, obsidian-black body with orange-amber hairline cracks radiating from a dark chest hollow; ears still flame-tapered but dull copper; tail a dead cinder-stump; eyes a faint dying coal-glow.
signature_idea: Cinder Grief — special Dark move that deals bonus damage equal to missing ember-warmth; ignores type resistances on a 'remembered fire' mechanic flavour
hook: Named for what it lost — kids will feel the tragedy in the name before reading a word of the dex entry.

name: Flutterwane
concept: A tiny will-o'-wisp no bigger than a fist, its glow cycling between warm amber and drained grey as if the Hollowing pulls at something it refuses to release. It blinks in and out of visibility like a guttering candle.
visual: Teardrop wisp shape, half its body bathed in warm amber-white, half in cool ashen grey; the divide is not a clean line but a flickering blurred edge; tiny trailing tail of mist.
hook: A kin visibly fighting its own hollowing — warm and dark at once, genuinely moving.

name: Wispwane
concept: A wisp caught between the Skyweave and the Hollowing — half its body radiates pale golden light, the other half swirls with cold dark vapour. It is the living boundary between what Vesperholm was and what it is becoming. Neither side has won yet.
visual: Elongated wisp with a clear left/right split: the light half is warm ivory-gold with a faint inner shimmer; the dark half is deep indigo-void with null-mist tendrils; the division is a crackling seam of sparks.
signature_idea: Waning Pulse — hits as both Dark and Light simultaneously; deals reduced damage but cannot be fully resisted by either type
hook: The one kin that embodies the whole game's conflict in its body — kids will argue about whether it's dark or light.

name: Liminalux
concept: The resolved form of a wisp that survived the Hollowing's full pull and did not fall entirely dark — nor entirely light. It exists as a stable chimera, its body a sphere of coexisting radiance and void. Its presence calms both lit and hollow kin.
visual: Large orb-being, one hemisphere bright bone-white with a golden core, the other deep void-black with a violet inner light; a belt of crackling silver sparks rings the equator; two long pale tendrils drift like arms.
signature_idea: Equilibrium — raises own SpA and SpD simultaneously; also halves the opponent's most recent type modifier
hook: A kin that resolved the game's central conflict in its own body — the reward for finding it feels earned.

name: Greysnuff
concept: A stocky hound-shaped husk with a lantern cage where its ribcage should be — the lantern is dark, the bars corroded. It paces the marsh-edge, sniffing for a flame it will never find again.
visual: Barrel-chested four-legged husk, deep grey fur gone to ashen bristle; a rusted iron lantern-cage visible on its chest where ribs show through; dark hollow eyes; stubby tail.
hook: A dog that literally carries a dead lantern in its chest — unsettling but pitiable.

name: Hollowarden
concept: A massive husk-hound whose lantern-chest has grown into an iron cage the size of a barrel, chains draped from it like a guardian of the unlit. Other hollow kin orbit it as if it were a dead sun.
visual: Huge four-legged beast, iron-grey bristled body, enormous rusted lantern cage dominating the torso with heavy chains dangling; skull-faced muzzle with a single faint ember in one eye socket; size commands the screen.
signature_idea: Iron Dark — physical Dark move that leaves Null-chains on target, reducing their speed by one stage
hook: The apex lantern-hound that guards the marches like a warden of a prison that has no keys.

name: Duskling
concept: A small dusk-rabbit with ears that glow a very faint violet — not enough to light anything, just enough to prove it was once brighter. It huddles in hollow reed-clusters and startles at sudden sounds.
visual: Rounded rabbit-form, soft grey-lilac coat, ears with the faintest internal violet tinge (nearly invisible); wide silver eyes; short puffball tail; sits very low, cautious posture.
hook: Looks like a normal cute rabbit — then you notice the ears barely glow, and the sadness sets in.

name: Duskvane
concept: A mid-size dusk-hare, its ears now elongated and hollowed — they were once light-conducting but the channels are dead, like unlit corridor-windows. It moves in long silence through the coldfog.
visual: Lean upright hare, ash-grey with long hollow-channel ears (dark windows running their length like stained glass with no light inside); tail now a short drooping plume of dark mist.
hook: The ears-as-dead-windows motif grows through the line — haunting visual storytelling.

name: Umbralong
concept: A tall, antlered hare-stag whose rack of antlers is shaped from solidified null-mist — they cut cold arcs through air. It walks in perfect silence, leaving no footprints on the blighted marsh. A creature the Hollowing has refashioned into something new.
visual: Upright powerful stag-hare, deep charcoal coat, imposing curved null-antlers of dark crystal; ears replaced by swept-back crystal ridges; eyes a calm void-violet; long powerful haunches suggest great physical force.
signature_idea: Null Rack — physical Dark move; the crystalline antlers ignore half the target's defense
hook: A shadow-stag that the Hollowing inadvertently made into something formidable — not evil, just irrevocably changed.

name: Galesnuff
concept: A small spark-eel that once crackled with storm-energy; the Hollowing crept into its coils and extinguished most of the charge — but not all. It sparks erratically, the electricity now dark-tinged and unpredictable.
visual: Elongated eel form, steel-grey with black band markings; residual sparks arc in dark indigo rather than white-yellow; tiny dim eyes; the tip of its tail ends in a shorted black electrode stump.
hook: An eel whose electricity has gone dark — the visible malfunction makes you root for it.

name: Voidcharge
concept: A large storm-eel whose hollow core charges with compressed dark-static — the null and the lightning fused into something that doesn't belong to either. It inhabits the Hollowfen Stillworks, coiled around dead machinery that still twitches from its field.
visual: Thick serpentine eel, deep-void black with dark-indigo and gunmetal lightning bolts running its length; a corona of null-static surrounds it; the eyes are overcharged — blown out, white-then-dark; imposing, coiled at rest.
signature_idea: Dead Circuit — Storm/Dark hybrid special move; charges for one turn then discharges; has a 30% chance to inflict both Static and Dim (new Dark status: reduces Special Attack) simultaneously
hook: The Stillworks boss — a power-plant creature running on energy it was never meant to hold.

name: Frostsnuff
concept: A small ice-mole whose bioluminescent nose has been extinguished by the coldfog — it now digs blind, navigating by null-sense alone. Its frosted fur is shot through with dark mineral staining.
visual: Compact mole-form, pale icy-white fur stained in grey-black veins from null exposure; the distinctive shovel-paws are large; a pink-grey nose where the glow should be; one eye faintly luminous, one dark.
hook: Half-blind, half-hollowed, still digging — stoic and sympathetic.

name: Hollowrift
concept: A massive subterranean beast — part frost-bear, part coldfog creature — that has hollowed out the marsh's underground passages and lined them with null-ice: ice that does not reflect light, only absorbs it.
visual: Heavy bearlike form, ridged null-ice plates armoring its back and shoulders like a carapace; white fur gone grey-blue; paws leave frost-black prints; breath is not visible because its warmth has been extinguished.
signature_idea: Null Ice — summons terrain that heals Dark/Frost types each turn; counters Solar field effects
hook: A glacier-bear that the Hollowing has turned into a cold fortress.

name: Moonsnuff
concept: A small owl whose moon-disc facial feathers have gone dark — the concentric rings that should reflect moonlight are matte and dull. It hunts in absolute silence, using null-sense where Lunar kin use dreamlight.
visual: Compact round owl, feathers deep charcoal with a pale circular face-disc whose concentric rings hold no shimmer; talons faint-grey; a crescent marking on each wing is filled in to a half-moon of shadow.
hook: An eclipse owl — the moon-face gone dark is instantly evocative.

name: Eclipsowl
